chapters.title: Chapter 3130 Integration! III
paragraphs: After Noah cleared the False Oasis and had his Will delved into the Faeburned Sources of Existence, he was able to confirm a few things.

One was that even though it was hard to get through Existence Based Defensive Abilities of Faeburned Existences at the Paracosm Stage with pure Existential Extremity Authorities alone, these types of Existences also couldn't drastically dominate those utilizing Existential Extremity Authorities- especially those who focused on their Existential Dominium Soul!
The main point of power of the Faeburned Existences was their mind, where they could elude and cause the existence of lesser beings to see entirely what they wished.
But as Noah confirmed with how he was able to see through their restructured reality, a strong Dominium Soul was enough to stand toe to toe with these Existences!
So he affirmed that the Legions of Sanctus Populi and even his own people would not be entirely wiped out when they faced Faeburned Existences.

Unlike the System of Existence of the Devouring Worms that was extremely unfavorable to be paired up against them, the Faeburned Existences held a bit more equality in terms of the differences of their Existence!
Then, the next question was...how would Noah integrate the strongest parts of this Source of Existence into himself?
The mind.
The soul.
Across the months since Noah had come across Mana, the Soul remained one of the titular things that remained important in all paths.
A strong soul could overcome many things as his Soul that was at the forefront of a terrifying Lineage and had undergone countless changes and transformations was an extremely strong point.
If it could be made even stronger...
Noah's mind buzzed as the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Cheats and Entropy came to a stop, the Ascendant Existential Summons surrounding them in the flaming skies.

Noah's Soul was probing and proving the Faeburned Sources of Existence he had already attained as he saw their Souls twisted in unique methodologies- their very existence coursing their energy across these pathways to bring to effect their alteration of the surrounding existence.
For Noah to replicate these pathways, he would have to distort his current Existential Dominium Soul and try to imitate the Faeburned Source of Existence!
|Should not be entirely hard since Lumen has already been incorporated into my Existence...|
His obsidian pupils and the dazzling white gold suns within them shone with gorgeous brilliance as Noah's will began to move!
|You have begun the process of imitating the Weavings of Existence of the Faeburned.|
|Your distinction as the Weaver of Existence stands proudly and carefully in the alteration of your Existence.|
|Your Distinctions advise you to allow the current integration of another Source of Existence to complete for the greatest possible boons and opportunities.|
|Oh?|
He was about to start twisting his soul, but the last prompt came that caused Noah to look deeply into the white gold storms of Lumen swirling across his existence!
His very existence and Lineage were still being altered as more and more weavings of Lumen were revived by him- with Lumen even being the thing that led him into this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
Did it reach a precipice to grant another boon at this moment?
As Noah began to question, a dazzling colorless light began to rise from his winged figure.
The bright light of Quintessence that he was seeing a similar colorless sheen of from the Sanctus Empress who exceeded the Paracosm Stage!
And alongside it, a blinding blue light blared.
|Quintessence and Infinity see a pathway within your elevating Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor Lineage.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity steer the olden qualities of Lumen that only those of the highest Purity could attain.|
|In the dredges of scattered memories of the Source of Existence that the Lumen Emperor stemmed from, Bastions of Shields of Existence have been glimpsed.|
Yes.
As the Blood of Lumen was produced more and more across Noah's existence, so did the memories of the Lumen Emperor.
What Noah uncovered regarding what was chasing him was only at the cusp.
Far past this, there was the question of where the Lumen Emperor came from.
He was from another Source of Existence, so naturally, this Existence had to be anchored within an Omniverse.
At this moment, Noah's weavings had barely begun to catch glimpses of Lumen from an austere Omniverse.
The one where the Lumen Emperor stemmed from!
From there, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity sought to bring out more of their power that made them so unshakable.
HUUM!
His body began to pulse like a churning engine.
Tendrils of white and colorless brilliance covered the winged figures of his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones!
|An endlessly regenerating defensive Barrier of Existence.|
|A Quintessential Bastion of Defense for your Lineage.|
His blood roiled as if were surging lava.
Thick and heavy, it coursed across his existence rapidly while his Heart pumped!
And moments after...
BUZZ!
The space above him distorted as a halo of light formed.
It blazed with blue, gold, and colorless brilliance.
It seemed like a single ring of light- a halo of light that had three colors constantly rotating above his head!
|The Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen is being designed by the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Infinity and Quintessence.|

|Before your Existence can be tainted by any outside influence, the Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen will block up to 200% of the determined damage of Existence Based Attack that would have been capable of eradicating you.|
|You have gained 3% Absolute Omniversal Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.|
|Members of your Lineage will gain a Lesser Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen.|
|Members of your Lineage have gained 1% Absolute Omniversal Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.|
His people didn't have to do anything before they were granted such shockingly ridiculous gains.
But even more so than all of this, his inclusion of Lumen into his existence and Lineage had truly reached a terrifying precipice!
|Your Lineage holds a grand history.|
|Your Lineage supports a great number of existences.|

|As the integration of Lumen stabilizes and resonates within your Existence, your Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor Lineage is reaching out towards the distinction of an Autarchical Existential Omniversal Lineage.|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3131 Integration! IV
paragraphs: |Autarchical...|
Noah said this single word with Luminous eyes as he thought of the Sanctus Empress.
Of the Imperium Autarch that stood above the Imperium.
His name and distinction weren't merely for show, as he designated himself as the Imperium Autarch.
But the Sanctus Empress...also had a similar distinction.
The Sanctus Autarch!
Above Paracosm were the leaders of Lineages across the Omniverse.
The Eonic Uterra sitting above the Omniversal Pillagers.
The Imperium Autarch.
The Sanctus Empress.
The distinction of Autarch was an utterly heavy one as it was not just utilized for the Autarch Stage above the Paracosm Stage!
It was also the named distinction of the Omniversal Authorities standing above Greater.
Autarchical Omniversal Authorities!
To understand just how heavy their distinction was, one had to at least grasp what this word meant.
Autarchical meant self-ruling. Dictatorial. It was something that defined itself and its boundaries in a manner that forced others to accept it and work around it!
It defined its existence...and others had to work around it.
It was why even though Sanctus Autarch was badly matched against the Devouring Worms, she was still able to affect them and push them back with her Autarchical Authority!
And now, Noah's Lineage was going towards attaining such a distinction as it would define itself and have everything else work around its rulings!
In the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
Noah had wondered whether he could stretch time further within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain now that he would have 30 days within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
Could he stretch a single second into a day three times after every 24 hours passed within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record?
The answer was a hard no as this capability remained anchored to the only true relative Omniverse Noah stemmed from- and not the Eonic Omniverse Record he was currently in!
And as of now, not even an instant had passed within the relative Omniverse Noah stemmed from.
But, since the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain still had the Innate time dilation factor of 1:3 sustained by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself- this boon still applied.
So within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, Noah would be capable of experiencing 90 days instead of 30 that were the run time of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record!

Noah nodded at this boon as his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist standing at the center of the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain erupted with brilliance, a Halo of colorless, gold, and blue blooming above his head and beginning to spin as he wasn't the only one.

The Sanctus Empress vibrated with colorless radiance as she turned her head to Noah and the figure of Sona beside him who had a similar, but slightly less dazzling halo of light beginning to spin above her as well!

Sona and Noah had shared bodily fluids too many times as the Lineage of the Existential Omniversal Emperor had long since been shared, and the minute traces of Lumen bloomed within her just like it would bloom in all others following Noah's banner.
So above her head.
Above the heads of Barbatos, Aurelia, Adelaide, and others who were welcoming the Sanctus Empress and pertinent Elder Queen Mothers to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Above the heads of Henry, the Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, and many others!
A flashing Lesser Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen bloomed and began to spin as their bodies held an Existence Based Defensive Ability innately from this moment onwards!
And within Noah's mind, the weavings of Infinity churned even faster as this capability was even more defined.

|If the Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen is ever broken, the unfathomable brilliance of Infinity will burn to regenerate the weavings of its existence after five seconds. If its Defensive capabilities are only reduced to where even 1% remains, the full Halo of Lumen will regenerate fully within 2 seconds.|
Terrific Defensive capabilities bloomed for a Lineage that was reaching out towards the Autarchical Existential Omniversal Lineage.
Just how much more powerful would Noah's Lineage be once it had reached this distinction fully?

|You continue to be full of surprises, but this seems astute for the man who rose out of nowhere to now be dealing with the crux of the matters of our Omniverse. Tell me, how can the Sanctus Populi be of use here?|
The Sanctus Autarch didn't question why an overpowering Lineage was flowing through Sona.

Even as Sanctus Princess Emilliana and the Elder Queens gasped when they saw it as they knew what it indicated- that Sanctus Princess Sona had fully and truly given all of herself towards this Entity in front of them, they still couldn't help but be shocked!
That apathetic girl? The one that at the Teleios Stage was already thrashing Teracosm Stage Elder Queens? She had allowed a man to-
|Free your imaginative heads and listen.|
Sona's eyes squinted towards her Sister and the Elder Queens with distaste as she probed the Halo of light spinning above her while giving the floor to Noah.
Noah, who smiled at this moment and voiced out.

|To stand against the Devouring Worms, we have to gain a better understanding of the different Sources of Existences out there. The first ones are the Faeburned Existences...and there seem to be a great deal of them that are thirsting for Blood. We have a day of guaranteed safety, but it doesn't mean we cannot be active- we can use this time to be even bolder, as after the Sanctus Legions are reoriented, they can set off with my Quintessential Legions to conduct joint operations.|
WAA!
His Quintessential Commanders were hungry.

He had been buffing them with millions of Fruits of Existence as he distorted Causality with the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, and they now had Lumen flowing within them as battling against other types of Existences could yield fantastical results!

The line between stages of power deferred as it could be crossed or ignored entirely depending on the type of Existence they faced, with Noah wanting to put them on the field so they could enjoy their own Existence as well.
He was the Protagonist, yes, but it didn't mean he had to do everything himself and deprive others of any fun or purpose!
Towards his words, the Sanctus Autarch nodded as he gazed towards Noah and the figures of all of his people who were looking at the Halos above them with varying levels of shock.

|Very well. We have only come across each other in this brief period of time, and we must now come together for the sake of the People. The Sanctus Populi will ensure unity as this alliance will not be anything like what the Imperium was proposing. As of this moment, consider the Sanctus Legions an extension of the sharp blades of the Quintessential Legions.|

These shocking words were uttered by the Sanctus Autarch as they made the Elder Queen Mothers buzz in shock, but this Entity at the Autarchical Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm who didn't express much on her face thought very far ahead compared to them!
First was the fact that she was freed of the chase of the Devouring Worms that wouldn't let up.
And then there was the fact of the possible solution against the Devouring Worms that would save the masses of the Populi.
All of it depended on this man in front of her.
Even though she was immensely powerful, she put aside any pride and truly looked at the circumstances and how she could be of greatest aid to her people.
To the Sanctus Populi!

Her character was a unique one as this same mindset of hers caused her to rush out to save a Legion of her people being massacred by the Devouring Worms, but she in turn endangered herself and the masses of remaining Quintillions of Entities within the Sanctus Populi!
No single Entity was perfect.
Just like Noah, even this Entity at the height of her power was flawed.
But when it counted...she made thorough and heavy decisions, and the one she had just made now...gave Noah free rein to command the Legions of the Sanctus Populi!

chapters.title: Chapter 3132 Integration! V
paragraphs: Noah's existence was calm as he continued to receive feedback and information about many things, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist nodding at the Sanctus Autarch as he voiced out.
|Very well. Let's organize and prepare as the first differing Source of Existence to go against...are the Faeburned Existences!|
Plans were made.
Weavings of Existence began to flow with great strength and valor.
And in the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, time began to flow.
Above an earth painted red with dense vegetation, flaming skies filled with serenity could be seen.

Within these flaming skies, Legions of many entities moved forth as in one area, the visage of Lilith, Ayame, Erikson, and a few other prominent Scions of the past could be seen at the forefront of one Quintessential Legion.

In another direction, the Cimmerian Architect, Ishtar, and Sargon led another Legion, and similar compositions of leaders could be seen with Genesis, Aurelia, and many other prominent figures leading the way!
At the very forefront though, a Quintessential Legion larger than most was accompanied by multiple Legions of the Sanctus Populi as this...was led by Henry.
Beside him, the Emperor Penguin and Kazuhiko could be seen as the latter grasped his Katana while staring towards the figures of Elder Queens and Sanctus Princesses.
"What do you think of the new group joining us?"
The question was filled with interest as Henry raised his brows and gazed over while replying.
"A unique one. Matriarchal it seems with the Princesses and Queens leading Dragon Knights. Are you having any designs, Uncle? Their culture seems somewhat different."
Henry tried to steer Kazuhiko away, but this Quintessential Samurai only smiled while grasping the hilt of his Katana!
"No designs...no designs at all. Just looking around and admiring. Because if I don't have the strength to back it all up..."
His gaze turned serious as he looked ahead.
Their Legions had been flying across the crimson skies for the last hour as at this point, they could feel a prickling sensation of their very Dominiums as they knew the enemy was near!

"You're right." Henry nodded with shining eyes as above his head, a colorful Halo of blue, gold, and colorless brilliance spun that granted him and all those following the Quintessential Legions a heavy feeling of protection!
"Father has already cleared the way with all the information we need and more. Now, let's not disappoint."
HUUM!
Henry's visage began to glimmer with brilliance as it acted akin to a trigger.

Behind him, others began to light up with power until all Quintessential Legions seemed like flickering singularities of magnificence from afar, and opposite them- intricate Legions of the Faeburned Existence surged!
The difficulty of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record had drastically increased as ahead of them, like flickering stars of light, dots littered the skies.
Long ears, an aurora of wings, and eyes that showed their tremendously strong souls.

The Faeburned Existences appeared with intricate Legions this time around, and far above this whole battlefield...Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence was staring at this scene with calm eyes.

This was the extension of the region where he had first encountered the Faeburned Existences, where the further in he went- he only came across more groups of Faeburned Existences that were being assembled!
And the result lay before him as his task today was to observe and command a battlefield where Entities from different Sources of Existence battled.
He noted the position of the Colorless brilliance of the Sanctus Autarch as Legions of the Sanctus Populi followed behind her.
He noted his Son who at this moment brought his hand down commanding, and the Quintessential Legions began to move.

Opposite them, Faeburned Existences pulled on the strings of golden glimmering bows that pulsed with the terrifying aura of an Existence Based Attack- the arrows knocked on these bows being released at this moment as a rain of crimson gold light surged forth!

The bellow of the Quintessential Commander, Henry, echoed out.

Thereafter, more of them followed as they...didn't put up any defenses whatsoever!
The only thing they held was a spinning Halo of brilliance above them.
It was this Halo that granted them confidence!

Noah smiled at this scene as beside his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy held an even more devilish smile as his eyes were on the Sanctus Autarch who waved her hands and caused a colorless glow of light to permeate across the Legions of the Sanctus Populi.
"Now, what would happen to the weavings of the Sanctus Populi when the brilliance of the Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen is shown?"
Noah talked to himself.

He watched as the rain of arrows from the Faeburned Existences thundered down, the colorless glow of the Sanctus Autarch bouncing them off as her gaze became colder when she saw the effectiveness of these attacks compared to her terrifying power!

And here...
BZZT!
The reality of a rain of Existence Based Attacks bouncing off the bodies of Noah's people was shown- the Halos above them simmering brightly as they valiantly surged towards the Faeburned Existences!
Entropy's devilish smile became even more distinct as his voice echoed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 3133 Integration! VI
paragraphs: While the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor observed the weavings of the battlefield and made many decisions based on it, he wasn't the only one.
There was an Entity at the forefront of the battlefield whose hair shone with a colorless glimmer.
Her eyes seemed like an infinitely spinning colorless singularity as her entire figure looked like a porcelain treasure that had to be protected!
Yet she was the one with the most power here, and even though her eyes faced ahead...her Will was spread throughout as everything fell under her senses.
There were a great deal of things to pay attention to on this battlefield. The new types of Existences ahead of them.
An extension of her Lineage- one of her many daughters, Sona, and the changes she had undergone.
Those granted the distinction of Quintessential Legions.
All of these were unique things to pay attention to, but none of them more so than the man responsible for why they were even in this place.
As if she had eyes in the back of her head, the Sanctus Autarch stared straight at just some of the bodies of the Existential Anomaly she had come across.
And the same question she had asked herself multiple times since she saw one of his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones rose in her mind once more.
|Does he really not know?|
Did he not know?
Truly?
As an Entity that had touched upon the minute specs of Autarchical Authority and what it meant, she was able to see from this being...an Autarchical Base had already formed.
Colorless in brilliance.
Unfathomable in the number of possibilities it could unfold.
And yet...his own strength and power was unique, but it did not utilize any Autarchical Authority!
His Existence did not probe or pull on his already formed Autarchical Base as it simply lay there...doing nothing!
Initially, the Sanctus Autarch had thought that maybe this being was purposefully not utilizing his Autarchical Authority to test himself.

So he was finding unique ways to alter the surrounding Omniverse as without utilizing Autarchical Authority, he transferred a large number of people into a Record of an Omniverse where tike would flow freely for 30 days while outside of it, only an instant would pass!
Such an action was feasible by expending a certain amount of Autarchical Authority.
But even if she did this, there was nothing she could gain within 30 days that would change the current state of affairs.
Nor could she jump onto an Eonic Omniverse Record that held Entities just as powerful as her.
This was something one had to gain access to through unique means as this being had seemingly done just that through his unearthing of Lumen!
And yet, his Autarchical Base never moved.

As more time passed, as she talked to him as if she were talking to a peer, she became more and more baffled as she came to the conclusion that truly...he did not even seem to know that his Autarchical Base was already there!
But this was so unbelievable that she continued to ask herself.
Did he truly not know?!

Yet he continued to achieve things that Autarchical Authority could accomplish, the latest one being the alteration of Existence and Lineage in a manner that formed a halo of defensive brilliance above all of his people!
Looking at it, the Sanctus Autarch could understand its weavings, but it wasn't something she could accomplish easily.

She could see tendrils of Lumen and a heavy concentration of his own Bloodline forming a barrier of Existence, and she could straightforwardly do the same thing with her Autarchical Authority as even though the enemies were of a different Source of Existence- she was able to defend the Legions of the Sanctus Populi by spreading out her authority.
But this being has achieved such a feat passively, and based it on his Lineage.
All without the utilization of any Autarchical Authority.
Frankly, it frustrated her as she found that at this moment, she couldn't sit still without this question being answered.
If he knew and he was only playing around, that was that.
If he didn't know...as unfathomable as this was, he had to know.
The Sanctus Autarch waved her hands to clash against ten Paracosm Equivalent auras, her Elder Queen Mothers defending against multiple other entities with this power as the Sanctus Autarch...blinked.
A blink of her eyes.
And in the next moment, another version of herself appeared in the distant crimson skies- right in front of two of the bodies of the Existential Anomaly in question.
Both of their brows rose in synchrony as if to show how a single Will controlled them, with one showing a hint of surprise while the other had a look as if this was to be expected!
The Sanctus Autarch stared at both of them, her eyes showing immeasurable calm as she asked.
|Do you truly not know?|
HUUM!
A simple question.
One that the Sanctus Autarch had been asking herself again and again, and she simply asked it out loud this time!
Yet Noah stared at her quizzically as he replied while tilting his head.
|That is as obscure as one can be...what don't I know?|

His reply only caused the eyes of the Sanctus Autarch to squint and look at him even closer, especially the figure of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence as she spoke out succinctly!
|You already have an Autarchical Base of Existence, yet it remains untouched and untapped. Do you truly not know?|
HUUM!
The question was explosive, causing Noah's mind to buzz as his Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation stirred!
He stared silently at the Autarch as he could see she was utterly serious, his gaze becoming stern as he replied with a question.
|What do you mean?|
The always placid expression of the revered Sanctus Autarch showed incredulity as she pointed all around Noah.

|Its brilliance is gushing out all around you as it is not directed. If any other Autarch were to see it blatantly like this, they may be tempted to obtain such an Autarchical Base of Existence themselves as your fortune is unfathomable for not having come across the Imperium Autarch and his Advisors or the Eonic Uterra and his Abominations. Any other Autarch seeing what you have wouldn't even bother to wonder and ask questions like me as they would have already devoured you whole...|
The words were succinct.
Noah's mind worked fast.
There were many things among her words he didn't know full well about, but the latter parts of her words were clear!
Any Autarch that had seen him would want something that even he didn't know he had.
And which Autarch had seen him recently?
Not long after this thought came.
BOOM!
The skies above shattered.
The overwhelming pressure of crimson gold wings encompassed everything and pressed down.
It was the pure unadulterated pressure of a terrifying Autarch!

chapters.title: Chapter 3134 What is known and not known! I
paragraphs: Autarchical.
One may not be able to fully grasp what this meant until they experienced it themselves- until such a power was directed against them.
Any Entity that had begun to grasp Autarchical Authority was already terrifying enough, but if there was one who would go as far as to sneak attack you?
This was an even grander terror!
The skies shattered.
An aurora of wings spread out and blanketed everything as the center point of all of this pressure was Noah and his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones.
Luckily, it just so happened that another body of the Sanctus Autarch was nearby- her expression changing greatly as she raised her hands and punched out towards the approaching pressure!
At the moment of impact though, Existence had already been changed.
The figures of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence and Entropy felt their surroundings change as below them, a marbled floor bloomed and stretched out.
It extended for a single light year in all directions as thereafter, it rose up to form vertical crimson marbled walls and ultimately, a marbled roof covering the top entirely!
It seemed and felt like an enclosure- a box, or a prison made of shining crimson marbled walls!
When Noah's aura spread out around it, only the realism could be felt around this enclosure as it did not seem like an illusion.
It seemed real.
It felt real!
|It is real.|
The voice of the Sanctus Empress echoed out with a somber expression as if she could grasp what Noah was thinking.

When an Autarchical Authority established something, it was bound to be terrifying. When an Autarch stemming from a different Source of Existence geared towards the mind and soul established something...the imaginary became indispensable from reality!
And at such a moment, a singularity bloomed above this cage of Existence as a sweet voice echoed from it.
|I don't know how you found this Eonic Omniverse Record. I don't know how you accessed it. But I do know...you will not come out of it in one piece. |
WAA!
The voice was truly sweet.
It was accompanied by the appearance of a woman with flaming crimson robes wrapped around her, a flaming crown spinning above her head as an aurora of wings stretched out behind her!
Her ears were pointy and extended as her fair face held a sense of fascination and fanaticism while she stared at Noah, her hands constantly moving as she weaved her Autarchical Authority!
|Our Autarchical Bases would have dried up and cracked with another 1,000 Eons in here, but with that...Oh, so many things are possible! Come...let me have a taste. Let me see the possibilities!|
An eruption of heavy Authority cascaded as the Faesinged Queen appeared with fervor.
Her appearance confirmed the words that the Sanctus Autarch stated- whether Noah knew them to the full extent or not!
At this time, dozens of prompts crashed all around Noah as he prepared with utmost solemnity.
Beside him, the Sanctus Autarch bellowed out as her figure glimmered with colorless brilliance, a thousand colorless palms forming behind her as she struck up!
At the same time, the authority of the Faesinged Queen crashed down.
|An unfathomably heavy Authority seeks to disrupt your outlook of existence.|
|The effects of foreign Existence Manipulation are being actively resisted.|
|The effects of Memory Manipulation are being actively resisted.|
|The effects of Psionic Equilibrium Distortion are being actively resisted.|
His Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen shone with irresistible radiance.

But the Faesinged Queen truly displayed the terror of an Autarch as she didn't go straight for attacking his existence, but she sought to pull and influence his own weavings to experience an entirely different existence that what was unfolding around him!
Reality distorted.
In the next moment, the flames and fantastical waves of mana disappeared.
The Sanctus Autarch disappeared.
Noah's eyes squinted as he saw himself standing on the stands surrounding a tennis court.
It...was a scene from his home world.
From the weavings of his memories!

The Faesinged Queen had such terrifying capabilities as she wasn't able to pull out Noah's weavings or memories, but she laid down multiple existence influencing attacks that would influence Noah himself to see something that would lower his defenses!

Beside the stands surrounding the tennis court where Noah was sitting, a young man came to sit beside Noah and snickered while looking at his gaze that was focused on a young woman who was serving on the court.
|No matter how much you stare at her, she isn't going to come within an inch of a guy like you. You realize that, Noah?|
The girl of the court.
Blonde hair. Blue eyes. A dazzling figure.
Claire.
Noah's first crush.
His eyes were calm as he turned around to see the figure beside him who wasn't focused on the match occurring, but his eyes were more so focused on Noah than anything else.
An old bully in his college days.
Noah looked at this figure who had said the same thing to him all those years ago, but this time, his reply was very different.
|You've made me mad, O Faesinged Queen.|
HUUM!
The surrounding reality shook.
Noah's humane body instantly simmered with a colorless brilliance as an instant later, it was overlapped by a dark crimson radiance.
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence.|

The distorted reality changed as the figure of Noah's old bully shifted, the image of a radiant Faesinged Queen appearing as her hands were thrust out towards Noah and seemingly ready to break the brilliance of his Halo!
But Noah's gaze remained irrefutable and cold.
|The Advent of the Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form has been triggered.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence and Entropy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Infinity has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence, Entropy, and Protagonist.|
An array of prompts cascaded down while the surrounding reality began to burn- a heavy flow of Existence surging around Noah as he rebuffed a genuine Autarch!

|No matter how much you stare at her, she isn't going to come within an inch of a guy like you.
You realize that, Noah?|
The girl of the court.
Blonde hair.
Blue eyes.
A dazzling figure.
Claire.
Noah's first crush.
His eyes were calm as he turned around to see the figure beside him who wasn't focused on the match occurring, but his eyes were more so focused on Noah than anything else.
An old bully in his college days.
Noah looked at this figure who had said the same thing to him all those years ago, but this time, his reply was very different.
|You've made me mad, O Faesinged Queen.|
HUUM!
The surrounding reality shook.
Noah's humane body instantly simmered with a colorless brilliance as an instant later, it was overlapped by a dark crimson radiance.
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence.|

The distorted reality changed as the figure of Noah's old bully shifted, the image of a radiant Faesinged Queen appearing as her hands were thrust out towards Noah and seemingly ready to break the brilliance of his Halo!
But Noah's gaze remained irrefutable and cold.
|The Advent of the Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form has been triggered.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence and Entropy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Infinity has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence, Entropy, and Protagonist.|
An array of prompts cascaded down while the surrounding reality began to burn- a heavy flow of Existence surging around Noah as he rebuffed a genuine Autarch!

chapters.title: Chapter 3135 What is known and not known! II
paragraphs: |The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Extremity has fused with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence, Entropy, Infinity, and Protagonist.|
Yet another prompt rose in front of Noah's eyes as obsidian brilliance became overlapped on his current body.
Above him, the Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen spun and gushed down unique weavings of Existence as the intrusive hands of the Faesinged Queen couldn't get close!
Her head tilted as her crimson eyes became clear, almost as if she couldn't believe the scene in front of her.
And she....wasn't the only one.
BOOM!

The furious figure of the Sanctus Autarch ripped apart a portion of the breaking veil of the tennis court, expecting to see the worst inside of this very real illusion as she understood the power that had come down greatly!
After all, even she was affected when a false but very real reality unfolded, and she just broke out of it!

He may not have known about his Autarchical Base nor how to communicate with it, so if a genuine Autarch were to attack him right now- much less one from a different Source of Existence...his survival was questionable.
So she used brute force and droves of her Autarchical Authority to break apart the weavings binding her as when she came across Noah's figure again...
Her pupils dilated at the scene of his gold, Blue, and colorless Halo spinning gloriously above him while his winged figure stopped the advancement of the hand of a genuine Autarch!
This...!
This could be done?!
BOOM!
The Sanctus Autarch blinked.

And her figure instantly changed and transformed into a massive colorless tree, hues of verdant brilliance beginning to shine as of her millions of blooming branches, over half formed into a hand that smashed itself on the face of the Faesinged Queen and pushed her away from Noah's figure!

The form of the massive Tree that was the Sanctus Autarch then stabilized the current weavings of Existence, ensuring that they were not changeable hereafter as she looked like a titanic colorless Omniversal Tree!
The base of her trunk was beside Noah as she voiced out while gazing at him.
|Leave this place! I will ascertain her power and whether I can defe-|
Her words did not finish.
Because as her will gazed at him, she saw anger and defiance as she realized with frustration that she didn't need to speak any further.
At the same time, Noah's figure gained multiple more points of light- figures of himself appearing inches from him before they were absorbed by his body!
The wings on his back and feet began to enlarge.
His entire visage began to enlarge.
To his right and left, magisterial floating winged eyes bloomed into existence, Nine obsidian pupils on each one as white gold brilliance lay deep inside!

|The advent of the Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form is being brought forth from the fusion of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones of Quintessence, Entropy, Infinity, Protagonist, Extremity, Cheats, Summoning, Manadynamics, and Tyranny.|
Many things had changed in the hours that passed within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record and the days within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
Tyranny attaining the First Phase of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority was one of them as joining other prime authorities of Noah...
BOOM!
Caused the first coming of the Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form of Noah as at this moment, a blinding light shone from his visage!
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Heavy Orchestral drums and horns boomed in the background.
When the blaring light faded, Noah's glorious figure was revealed once more.
The wings on his feet and back...radiated a colorless brilliance.

His lower half held colorless Emperor's Briefs as his chest was laid bare- with a dazzling eye holding rotating Nine pupils splitting out at the center of his chest in addition to the eyes on his head and two winged floating eyes to his left and right!
Below him, colorless lights gathered and formed into eonic chains- chains so heavy that they shook the surrounding space.
His hair...

His hair was tinged with a stellar sparkling colorless luster as when the Sanctus Autarch and Faesinged Queen looked at him...they doubted as to whether they were not seeing someone utilizing Autarchical Authority!
But both the Sanctus Autarch and the Faesinged Autarch could see the fantastical Autarchical Base of Existence emanating from this being...remained untouched.
At most, it began to flicker a bit more radiance that just drew them in.
What the hell was this?
|Ascendant Chains of Existence float below you ready to distort Causality.|
|Ascendant Eyes of Existence incorporating the current weavings of your Omniversal Organs are ready for your command to distort Existence.|
|64 Seconds are granted for the Transformation of the Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form based on your currently fused Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones and Existence.|
|In this state, there is no cost of resources to anything you wish to do under your currently definable existence.|
|In this state, your Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities can better express their extremes and advance towards the next Phase of Ascendancy.|
|During the current transformation, Quintessence is taking the lead.|
His gaze was chilly.

He locked onto the figure of the Faesinged Autarch who blazed with crimson flames that burned the branches pushing her away, her eyes simmering with deadly lights of curiosity as in the next moment, the Eye to Noah's left blinked!
And...
All light in the surrounding reality faded.

The eye to his right then blinked as in front of the face of the Faesinged Queen, a colorless singularity boomed out and knocked her figure backwards- more of the surrounding reality being distorted as she was smashed onto the crimson walls she enacted in the distance!
BINK!
The eye on Noah's chest flashed.
And the figure of the Faesinged Autarch instantly became bound by colorless chains as she was dragged out from the indentation her gorgeous figure made!
Yet...
|Haha...|
A laugh escaped from her figure that was bound by coiling colorless chains, her flaming hair dancing gloriously as her smiling face was revealed.
|It doesn't hurt, big guy.|
CRACK!
Her crimson tainted hands vibrated as some of the Colorless chains began to break.
|Such power, such capability to alter Existence....if you paired it with just a little Autarchical Authority, I would not be your match.|
The rest of the Colorless chains holding her were fractured and torn off as around her, a cyclone of flames began to surge!

|But I am glad I kept information about you away from the other two Anchor Existences in this little Eonic Omniverse Record ...even if this will be a little bit harder, I don't think I'd be able to share you!|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3136 What is known and not known! III
paragraphs: A terrific set of words were uttered as from them...
|Your existence has come across a fundamental concept of Existence!|
|The idea and weavings of Anchor Existence are being analyzed.|
Anchor Existences!
These words flowed out from the weavings of the Faesinged Queen as she referred to the other two leaders of different Sources of Existence within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
The Sunwinged Leprachanus and the Satyrus Nymph!
|Details of the Anchor Existences of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record have been theorized.|

|In the context of Eonic Omniverse Records, Anchor Existences are those that have the ongoing weavings and livelihood of the Eonic Omniverse Record bound to do. The moment their Existence is destroyed, the Eonic Omniverse Record they were in begins to break down and unfold over time.|
|The succession of Anchor Existences in relation to Eonic Omniverse Records is unknown.|
|The concept of Anchor Existences in the context of your true relative Omniverse is unknown.|
A glimmer of this concept was introduced.
And yet Noah's weavings theorized and uncovered a great deal just as the Faesinged Queen mentioned it!
Even as her surroundings flickered and changed greatly.
The storm of flames changed form.
Around the Faesinged Queen, Nine winged Faeburned Autarchical Minions bloomed.

Becoming surrounded by them, the Faesinged Queen smiled sweetly as her crimson eyes became even further tainted with a colorless radiance- a typhoon of colorless flames beginning to gather on the flaming crown above her head.

|My Omniverse dying, I can understand. The Anchor Existence- Nay, what did they call him? The Omniversal Ankyra of my home could not be there because he perished while serving a greater purpose? My strength not being sufficient enough at the end is my own fault. But to be locked in here awaiting a silent but assured destruction? This, I cannot stand!|
HUUM!
interminable brilliance raged around her.
Her wings gradually melded the crimson and colorless auras together as they stretched out and bathed the walls of the crimson cage she enacted.
|They said this is mercy? Locked in a false record of my Omniverse was the most they could do? Haha...NO!|
BOOM!

The Nine Faeburned Autarchical Minions enlarged as if they were pumped full of existence, their hands burning with dazzling weapons as the Faesinged Queen raised her hand and swung it towards Noah and the Sanctus Autarch.

|No. With that Base of yours...with such a pristine Autarchical Base- I can reverse this, young friend. So sit tight. I don't want to hurt even a smidgen of that Base as it would be best if you come willingly. Give up, and you will save the lives of many others. Is it not such a noble cause? Is it not worthy of your distinguished existence? Come...for this battle is all but assured, so why struggle?|
This whole time, she never stopped her manipulation of Existence as constantly, Autarchical Authority sought to influence and infect the minds of Noah and the Sanctus Autarch.
The gaze of the Sanctus Empress changed as Noah's visage, surging with interminable Existential waves of light, glimmered with brilliant light as his voice echoed out.
|I wouldn't be so sure about your victory.|
The eye on his chest flashed.
And instantly, the surroundings within the enclosed space flickered as millions of condensed colorless fireballs bloomed!
Towards the oncoming Faeburned Autarchical Minions.
Towards the Faesinged Queen herself.
But even as Noah did this, he was dissecting the words the Faesinged Queen had uttered as within them, he could feel Existential truth!
They were not lies or deceit.
And yet she talked about her Omniverse dying.
About an Omniversal Ankyra perishing!
Ankyra. A word meaning to secure. To protect. To shield. To anchor!
Such an Entity fell...and this was connected to the death of her Omniverse?
Too many dazzling concepts and possibilities floated in front of Noah as the millions of colorless singularities in the form of fireballs cascaded down.
And they...never stopped as while their barrage continued, even more continued to bloom and surge towards the coming Faeburned Autarchical Minions and the Faesinged Queen herself!
Yet her gaze remained immovable as ever before, her hands gathering immense waves of power as the colorless singularities thundering down all around her evaporated the moment they came near her body.
|I've told you.|
|It does not hurt.|
WAA!
Colorless wings of light began to appear and gather around her body as with immeasurable coldness, she stared at the Sanctus Empress.
|You all do not understand pain, so I will teach it to you. I will show you what it means to lose everything you love. And I...will get started with you. |
Thousands of colorless feathered Wings had formed around her as they looked like unfathomably powerful projectile weapons.
And they were all directed towards the Sanctus Empress at this moment!
|Your presence is not preferred nor required here. So please...perish.|
BOOM!
Utmost brilliance unfolded.
It was a heavy battle, but it wasn't the only one!
Outside of the crimson walled enclosure.
The other body of the Sanctus Empress had an expression of rage as around the battlefield in the skies, the Legions of Faeburned Existences had suddenly doubled.
Even more disastrous, a Faeburned Existence emanating waves of power at the Autarchical Stage appeared opposite her!
It seemed as if a bloodbath would soon occur as how could they get out of this?
The moment such a question arose...
|O Father...|
HUUM!
Towards the front of the battlefield, the visage of the Son of Osmont spoke while raising his right hand up.
|...I am honored for the access.|
His hands were raised upwards as, at this moment, something the size of a small world blinked into existence above them.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
OOOOH!
A booming roar echoed out from it as interminable waves of authority thundered down, and they were followed by invisible Legions that even the Sanctus Empress had to squint to discern!
It was an invisible Legion.
And it was only the tip of the iceberg as the Son of Osmont kept his hands raised high!

chapters.title: Chapter 3137 What is known and not known! IV
paragraphs: Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen.
This was the term that flowed across the mind of the Son of Osmont as he gained the access to view them and command them!
The Light of Lumen had passed through his Father and throughout all of their blood, but even more of it coursed through the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

The changes his father has undergone were as stellar as always, but the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...the Son of Osmont believed that if all of its data were to be broken down, its advances and qualitative changes may even exceed his father!

So when it appeared above and released the Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen that were made from the weavings of his father's defeated enemies and now an integration of Lumen, he knew that this wasn't all.
And moments after...
HOONG!
A horn of war was blown as neat rows upon rows of white gold Automatons appeared.
Blazing metallic gold wings behind them, and humanoid muscular bodies that made them look like glistening ancient titans!
Their hands seemed malleable as they already shifted into an array of armaments ranging from swords, spears, flails, hammers, guns, cannons, and more!
Above their heads, A Halo of blue, gold, and colorless luster rotated as the profound glow of Lumen covered every part of their bodies.
The Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen.

Each of them emanated a pressure equivalent to something at the peak of the Teracosm Stage- but even this outburst of power shouldn't be entirely trusted as what they could defend against and dish out in damage was not something anybody understood yet!

Beside them, the majestic figure of Hyperion could be seen along with thousands of Enders of Extremity- their bodies blazing with white gold flames as parts of their figures seemed experimented on- a metallic sheen emanating from their limbs as they boomed with ferociousness.
These were the products of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

Products that it churned out itself within its magisterial Aletheian Havens, with resources under its own banner and the millions of Fruits of Existence it held access to as Causality was constantly distorted.
And now, Henry gained access to command them as well.
The Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen and the Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen.
At this moment, The Son of Osmont brought his hands down commandingly as he felt the connection and weavings of command linked to all of these Legions.
And they were let loose across the changing battlefield!
HUUM!
Brilliance unfurled.
But this wasn't all.
The dazzling Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed remained floating above everything in the crimson skies as at this time, its size began to enlarge by thousands of miles.
It expanded more and more until its shadow covered nearly half of the whole battlefield, its shadow bringing with it immense pressure as in the eyes of Henry...
In the eyes of the one granted access as the Commander of this battlefield...prompts began to rise.
|Offensive features of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed are being activated.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons are being activated.|
Around the circular and now massive Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, massive cannon-like cylinders instantly formed all around and pointed themselves toward the Faeburned Legions.
Each one shone with either a majestic cerulean brilliance or a murky crimson radiance, the glow of Manadynamics and Entropy running rampant!
|Existential Ammunition Generation has been scaled infinitely.|

|Ballistokinetic Combat has been activated, with every released projectile of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons containing a portion of the weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Bombardment will now begin.|
HUUUM!
The massive cerulean and crimson cannons hummed, and in the next moment, catastrophe unveiled itself.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

Unfathomably heavy shots of massive singularity looking projectiles began to shoot out of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons, each one containing a mixture of the colors shot out of the cannon along with a blinding white gold radiance!
They began to rain down a bombardment, and they never stopped shooting as the first one landed right in front of a Legion led by a Teracosm Stage Entity, and...
WAP!
The thrown out projectile exploded with glorious radiance, expanding out in a gorgeous circular shape before retreating and converging into nothingness soon after.

And the area of effect its simple expansion and retraction covered...left behind only glimmers of ash and twinkling condemned Sources of Existence that were drawn towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed in the distance!
The bombardment rained down everywhere as in front of a Legion led by a Paracosm Equivalent Faeburned Existence...
WAP! WAP!
A dense number of projectiles swerved directly above him and around him with purpose.

The weavings of existence protecting the terrifying Paracosm of this being vibrated as the projectiles expanded and contracted- each impact eating up the authority of existence as the Paracosm Faeburned Existence could only defend and be pushed back while roaring out with saddened fervor!

Around him, any Teracosm Equivalent and lower powered Entities were being utterly shredded, the only thing left behind for them being twinkling Sources of Existence that were pulled up towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
It was a scene that caused even Entities like Ayame, Aurelia, Erikson, the Cimmerian Architect, and many others to pause and gaze upwards in shock as they thought to themselves...
'The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed could do this as well?!'

Even those who had been living inside of it were shocked as at this moment, across the shimmering boundary like layer of the circular looking Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, more Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons arose like deadly cylindrical mountains, some of them beginning to shine with the allure of Dreams, Avalon, Gravitation, Relativity, Continuity, Genesis, Penumbra, Helios...and even more.

A dense number of Phaser Kanons of different authorities rose and began an endless bombardment- causing even the inhabitants of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed to question the land they lived in as when they stared at the now frantic legions of the Faeburned that were scrambling in shock, they couldn't help but pity them!
Each projectile carried with it a percentage of the weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
What did it feel like to be smashed by a portion of the weight of an Omniversal Seed? The answer to this question...was one that nobody would seek to know!

sentences.text: Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen.
This was the term that flowed across the mind of the Son of Osmont as he gained the access to view them and command them!
The Light of Lumen had passed through his Father and throughout all of their blood, but even more of it coursed through the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

The changes his father has undergone were as stellar as always, but the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...the Son of Osmont believed that if all of its data were to be broken down, its advances and qualitative changes may even exceed his father!

So when it appeared above and released the Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen that were made from the weavings of his father's defeated enemies and now an integration of Lumen, he knew that this wasn't all.
And moments after...
HOONG!
A horn of war was blown as neat rows upon rows of white gold Automatons appeared.
Blazing metallic gold wings behind them, and humanoid muscular bodies that made them look like glistening ancient titans!
Their hands seemed malleable as they already shifted into an array of armaments ranging from swords, spears, flails, hammers, guns, cannons, and more!
Above their heads, A Halo of blue, gold, and colorless luster rotated as the profound glow of Lumen covered every part of their bodies.
The Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen.

Each of them emanated a pressure equivalent to something at the peak of the Teracosm Stage- but even this outburst of power shouldn't be entirely trusted as what they could defend against and dish out in damage was not something anybody understood yet!

Beside them, the majestic figure of Hyperion could be seen along with thousands of Enders of Extremity- their bodies blazing with white gold flames as parts of their figures seemed experimented on- a metallic sheen emanating from their limbs as they boomed with ferociousness.
These were the products of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

Products that it churned out itself within its magisterial Aletheian Havens, with resources under its own banner and the millions of Fruits of Existence it held access to as Causality was constantly distorted.
And now, Henry gained access to command them as well.
The Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen and the Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen.
At this moment, The Son of Osmont brought his hands down commandingly as he felt the connection and weavings of command linked to all of these Legions.
And they were let loose across the changing battlefield!
HUUM!
Brilliance unfurled.
But this wasn't all.
The dazzling Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed remained floating above everything in the crimson skies as at this time, its size began to enlarge by thousands of miles.
It expanded more and more until its shadow covered nearly half of the whole battlefield, its shadow bringing with it immense pressure as in the eyes of Henry...
In the eyes of the one granted access as the Commander of this battlefield...prompts began to rise.
|Offensive features of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed are being activated.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons are being activated.|
Around the circular and now massive Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, massive cannon-like cylinders instantly formed all around and pointed themselves toward the Faeburned Legions.
Each one shone with either a majestic cerulean brilliance or a murky crimson radiance, the glow of Manadynamics and Entropy running rampant!
|Existential Ammunition Generation has been scaled infinitely.|

|Ballistokinetic Combat has been activated, with every released projectile of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons containing a portion of the weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Bombardment will now begin.|
HUUUM!

BOOM!

BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3138 What is known and not known! V
paragraphs: The battlefield was brilliant and filled with heavy bursts of light.

The introduction of new Legions stabilized everything while the endless bombardment of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed only tipped the scales, and the Quintessential Commander given charge to oversee it all felt a surge of emotions as he turned up to gaze at the enclosure of a crimson Domain burning with Autarchical Authority.
His father was facing the strongest enemy within this space while others may wonder, he affirmed within his mind that, as always, he would be okay.
He would only focus on the job he was given as without further ado, the Son of Osmont moved!
Inside an enclosed Domain burning with Colorless Autarchical Authority.
It seemed like a weaving of existence where colorless brilliance constantly burned and unfolded, with every single Entity shining word glorious colorless radiance!

One was a Faesinged Queen surrounded by nine Faeburned Autarchical Minions, her figure moving with fluidity and purpose as she tried to eradicate the Sanctus Autarch while suppressing another Entity also burning with colorless radiance.
Colorless wings of light raged around her like sharp knives, swinging down onto the figure of the Sanctus Empress rapidly as her countless branches dodged and struck back with fervor.
Colorless buds on her huge tree form would erupt and bloom into flowers that smashed away the projectiles of sharp wings while also seeking to entangle the Nine Faeburned Autarchical Minions!
BOOM!
At such a juncture, the Faesinged Queen cut down Droves of colorless branches and reached out towards the figure of Noah, which was constantly causing a unique scene in this space.
All light would disappear as one of his floating eyes flashed, and light would return in the next moment as attacks smashed into the body of the Faesinged Queen and her Minions that pushed them back!

The floating eyes beside him and the one on his chest continued to distort Causality and probability as even after a few seconds passed, the Faesinged Queen never made any headway to come even inches closer to Noah anymore.

A constant bombardment of an Existence Based Attack that devoured all light and redirected it in the form of an attack occurred anytime she came close, the released output smashing her or any of the Autarchical Minions backward as no progress was made!
Such a reality was a fantastical one as it was an Existence that had not attained the Autarchical Stage actually keeping at bay one who had achieved it.

The fusion of nine Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones was actually so distinguished that its output of authority- while not being effective in heavily injuring an Autarch, could at the very least push them back and control how they moved across the battlefield!
Noah analyzed all of this and more while the battle unfolded, his mind constantly going back to the words of this Entity whose existence was growing colder by the second.
She had talked about many things, the more prominent ones being those regarding the concept of an Omniversal Ankyra.
A pillar of defense of an Omniverse!
An anchoring force that aided in the continuation of weavings of Existence of an Omniverse.
In this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, the Faesinged Queen was an apparent Omniversal Ankyra.
The Sunwinged Leprachanus and the Satyrus Nymph that Noah had yet to meet were also along the same lines with this distinction!
Were they all to perish, would the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record close soon after?
BOOM!
The impact of colorless brilliance gushed out all around Noah as he spammed out attacks endlessly, light and darkness flipping at the blink of his eyes as his mind continued to observe all weavings.
Apart from the word talking about an Omniversal Ankyra, the Faesinged Queen had also spoken about another party.
They.
Them.
They put her and the Sunwinged Leprachanus and the Satyrus Nymph here!
They said it was an action of mercy!
It meant that the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record was a unique record of an Omniverse utilized by others that Noah gained access to through the weavings of Lumen.
Through the Deus Ex Machina and other ridiculous actions of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist.
BOOM!

His Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen simmered as the fair hand of the Faesinged Queen was rebuffed yet again even after she tore through thick colorless branches of the Sanctus Empress to arrive inches away from him once more.
And her figure was then bombarded by colorless blasts as she was pushed back once more, her expression showing increasing coldness and rage!

|You have a unique contraption outside of here that I can always try breaking if you keep denying me. I can do many things in this Eonic Omniverse Record as how long do you think you can keep me away?|
WAA!

|I've scouted where your forces stem from and observed the Absolute Domain of Existence that I nor any others would be able to cross into. That seems to be fading away within a bit over half a day as what will you do then? When you have no layers of protection?|
She was rebuffed time and time again while facing a being who didn't even have Autarchical Authority!
She sought other paths as her Minions came to surround her, knocking back the attacks of the Sanctus Empress as the Faesinged Queen paused her relentless attacks that got her nowhere.
|I will spare your people. I will leave that contraption out there alone. All I want is you...friend. Don't make me resort to other means.|
Almost as if she was pleading.
Her gaze was cold as after seeing she wasn't successful in doing what she wanted, her plans had to change!
Noah's fused form glanced at her coldly as hundreds of thousands of thick colorless chains began to surge around him like billowing snakes.
They surged forward like a tide, the Faesinged Queen looking at them calmly as they began to shatter the moment they neared her and her Minions.
|I cannot hurt you, and you cannot even get close to me. Since you would prefer the more difficult route...we shall go towards that, O Osmont!|
HUUM!
The enclosed crimson Domain began to shake and crumble.
The visage of the Faesinged Queen began to distort and disappear!

chapters.title: Chapter 3139 What is known and not known! VI
paragraphs: Seeing that she wasn't getting her way, the Faesinged Queen actually began to make her exit while leaving behind very clear threats!
But the reality of her words still remained as truly, Noah's current stage of power could not truly and unequivocally damage an Autarch.
Bind them, keep them at bay, or protect himself- yes.
But he couldn't get past the unfathomable Autarchical Authority of these beings as he had barely just managed to take down Paracosm Stage Entities!
BOOM!
The Autarchical cage they were in cracked and splintered.

As if shards of glass were falling, the scene of the battlefield outside came into light- the magisterial bombardment of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed continuing at this moment as in synchrony...

OOOH! The Paracosm Stage Equivalent Faeburned and Teracosm Stage Equivalent Faeburned began to pull back and retreat from this heavy reality, the rest of their Legions seeming to follow as if they received a command within their very souls!

Yet the massive Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed hovered over them with its immense shadow, continuing to shoot out deadly blasts from its Ascendant Existential Extremity Phaser Kanons towards the retreating enemies.
At this point, the visage of Henry raised his hands and bellowed.
|HO!|
The Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen and the Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen came to a halt.
Hyperion and the terrifying Quintessential Enders of Extremity came to a halt.
Against the retreating enemies, the Quintessential Commander gave the order as they watched the bombardment of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that seemed insatiable to chase after them!
The bodies of Noah and the Sanctus Empress in the form of a massive Tree became clear to all.

Noah was surrounded by flickering colorless radiance, with his form causing his Legions to look up at him in awe as The Illusory Quintessential Legions of Lumen and the Quintessential Automaton Legions of Lumen stopped in space and kneeled towards his direction respectfully!
Yet Noah's gaze remained on the flickering brilliance of the Legions of Faeburned Existences as even he needed to regroup and take a moment to prepare.
Near his body, the trunk of the massive colorless tree faded away as the figure of the Sanctus Empress revealed itself, Noah speaking towards her while keeping his gaze in the distance.
|What do you know about the distinction of an Omniversal Ankyra?|
The Pillar of an Omniverse.
Being asked about this and recalling the words of the Faesinged Queen, the visage of the Sanctus Autarch was stern as she spoke.
|Mere whispers of fantasy from the Watchers...|
The Watchers!
An organization preceding the Sanctus Populi that was shredded apart by the Imperium.

|The Autarch of the Long Watch...from his last weavings before he perished, he spoke of the weavings of a distinction beloved by the Omniversal Authorities. Of a being who gained the recognition of Autarchical Omniversal Authorities and could influence multiple of them with ease. Of a being holding paramount access to the Intersects of the very Omniverse itself as they are the Omniversal Ankyra.|
WAA!
A terrifying description.
Someone beloved by the Omniverse itself!
Noah heard these words as he turned to look at the Sanctus Autarch closely, his expression inquisitive as she continued.

|I dismissed his theories and weavings initially, asking how the weavings of the whole Omniverse could lay on the shoulders of such an Entity. How ridiculous it was that if such an Entity perishes, then all of the Omniverse goes towards a path of destruction in time? But the Autarch of the Long Watch remained steadfast, speaking of lines of succession of Omniversal Ankyras over the eons, and that only when a successor was never distinguished would things fall apart. But that rarely happens.|
She said this because the Faesinged Queen had stated that the Omniversal Ankyra of her Omniverse had fallen, and this led to her whole Omniverse falling thereafter.
So what had gone wrong within her Omniverse for a succession to never occur- of course, this was all keeping in mind that the words of the Autarch of the Long Watch were to be believed.
|What else did the Autarch of the Long Watch say?|
Noah asked with increasing somberness as the Sanctus Autarch replied.

|There wasn't much I inherited from him apart from these memories. But from his scattered weavings, he stated that very likely, our Omniversal Ankyra was but a single one. The same one who decimated his weavings and put him in the state he was in at that moment.|
|The Imperium Autarch!|
HUUUM!
A terrifying possibility arose.
The one loved by the Omniverse.
The Anchor of Existence.
The Existential Ankyra- may actually be the Imperium Autarch!
Once more, it all revolved around Autarchy.
Noah's mind buzzed as all information weaved within him, his mind focusing on the thing that drew the eyes of Autarchs who saw him.
An apparent Autarchical Base of Existence that he didn't even know of but was supposedly inside of him.
Or it was something he already knew of, but others saw it very differently!
Regardless, he had to find out exactly what it was and how to tap into it, his gaze remaining on the Sanctus Autarch as he voiced out.
|Before the Faesinged Queen comes running back, I need to learn more about Autarchical Authority.|
The Faesinged Queen's threats were immensely valid as next time, she may not return alone.
So he looked towards the only Autarch on his side as he continued.

|Autarchical Omniversal Authority...why didn't you use one? I also wish for exposure to this to better see the path forward, and what you all may be seeing that I cannot. And if we want to take down the foreign Autarchs in here...we will have to resort to unique means.|
His words caused the eyes of the Sanctus Autarch to shift and gaze towards her own Legions with shining eyes before she ultimately turned towards Noah and replied.

|I will show you why. But...what possible unique means could there be to combat and defeat some of the hardest to erase entities in existence? As astounding as you may be, I do not foresee you attaining Autarchy in the next few days...or however long we have until the Faesinged Queen makes good on her threat.|
Her words what practical.
What could Noah possibly do?
Towards such a question, Noah only raised his brows as he spoke succinctly.
|A straightforward method is what I've just done right now.|
He showed his hand that emanated a fantastical colorless luster as he continued.
|A fusion. Not with myself, but an ally Autarch. If my weavings and their weavings were to be combined...|
