Noah's mind buzzed as all information weaved within him, his mind focusing on the thing that drew the eyes of Autarchs who saw him.
An apparent Autarchical Base of Existence that he didn't even know of but was supposedly inside of him.
Or it was something he already knew of, but others saw it very differently!
Regardless, he had to find out exactly what it was and how to tap into it, his gaze remaining on the Sanctus Autarch as he voiced out.
|Before the Faesinged Queen comes running back, I need to learn more about Autarchical Authority.|
The Faesinged Queen's threats were immensely valid as next time, she may not return alone.
So he looked towards the only Autarch on his side as he continued.
|Autarchical Omniversal Authority...why didn't you use one?
I also wish for exposure to this to better see the path forward, and what you all may be seeing that I cannot.
And if we want to take down the foreign Autarchs in here...we will have to resort to unique means.|
His words caused the eyes of the Sanctus Autarch to shift and gaze towards her own Legions with shining eyes before she ultimately turned towards Noah and replied.
|I will show you why.
But...what possible unique means could there be to combat and defeat some of the hardest to erase entities in existence?
As astounding as you may be, I do not foresee you attaining Autarchy in the next few days...or however long we have until the Faesinged Queen makes good on her threat.|
Her words what practical.
What could Noah possibly do?
Towards such a question, Noah only raised his brows as he spoke succinctly.
|A straightforward method is what I've just done right now.|
He showed his hand that emanated a fantastical colorless luster as he continued.
|A fusion.
Not with myself, but an ally Autarch.
If my weavings and their weavings were to be combined...|

chapters.title: Chapter 3140 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! I
paragraphs: A possibility!
This was what Noah saw as when he voiced it out, the Sanctus Empress blinked a few times as if pausing to make sure she heard correctly.
When she saw Noah's face remain placid and entirely serious, her expression became a pondering and inquisitive one as she wanted to ask.
Was such a thing even possible?
How would it work with the wide gap in their Existence?
And even if they could somehow do it, how would they retain stability in a fused form? Who would take the lead?
There were many things she wanted to ask, but having gotten a sense of who this being in front of her was and how he did things, she didn't bother with any of this!
She gave it more thought as ultimately...
|Depending on the methodology of how you plan to do this, I am on board.|
Depending on what method he used to do it.

Noah's weavings churned as from his body, the colorful lights of one Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone after another began to flash as he brought his transformation to an end, his eyes bright as he looked around and gave a command to his Legions below.

In glorious formations, they began to make their way back towards the safe zone behind them, the towering Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed still shooting out blasts towards enemies that could no longer even be seen in the distance!

His forces also made their retreat as they would absorb what they obtained on this battlefield today, and Noah himself needed to ascertain a few things as before the protection of the Safe Zone entirely faded, he had to come to a solution for what could be coming!
|Let's go.|
He spoke to the body of the Sanctus Empress beside him as his figure disappeared towards the blazing Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
In an isolated area that looked like a domain made of white gold clouds.
Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist appeared beside a situated figure of Sona who was surrounded by intense flows of Existential Extremity Authorities.
|You didn't need my help after all, how are things progressing?|
She asked as her surroundings calmed and her figure began to slide the vibrant Empress Robe off her shoulders.
She had constantly been changing over the past hours as her hair shone with a golden blue brilliance, the hues of green barely visible as she seemed to be getting colder and colder.
But her beauty only became more graceful as every part of her curves screamed wonder!
Noah nodded calmly as his golden Emperor's Robe also slid off.
|Some good, some bad. But overall a few pathways are presenting themselves. One of them with the Sanctus Empress in the lead.|
Sona raised her brows while floating closer towards Noah, her fair hands lifting up his chin as she asked with shining eyes.
|You're not having any designs on Granny Empress, are you? You would break the hearts of a dozen Paracosm Dragon Knights who have only been capable of looking at her from a distance...|
Her eyes shone sharply as she asked such a question; Noah grabbed her hand and pulled her closer as he shook his head.
|Who do you take me for? I'm an honest and decent man. Now, let's get you Paracosm and finish the emergence of new Omniversal Organs...|
A brilliant light erupted between them.
A veil descended in the surroundings as a unique style of Cultivation unfolded in this isolated space!

And a distance away from this space, within the same Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence appeared with the figure of the Sanctus Empress in an isolated Domain filled with a verdant grassland with a central tree that was budding with hundreds of Fruits of Existence.

The Sanctus Autarch looked towards this tree calmly as a colorless brilliance still surrounded her hair, her visage being extremely unique to look at as her eyes seemed like unfathomable voids of colorless brilliance.
When looking at both of them, one would notice the similarity of colorlessness between Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence and the Sanctus Empress!
But the two were on entirely different stages as in front of Noah, a few prompts regarding the fusion of his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones finished passing through.
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has made great strides towards the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist has made great strides towards the Second Phase of Ascendancy...|

The fusion of his Clones wasn't just to provide him with a body that could utilize endless resources for battle, but it was also a tool for Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities to advance even further!
|After an indeterminate number of hours, your existence will be ready to fuse Nine Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones once again.|

His eyes simmered with brightness as he looked through all of the details of his existence, The figure of the Sanctus Autarch waving her hands and causing a Quintessential Fruit of Existence to be plucked from the resplendent tree ahead of them as she asked.
|What is this methodology of yours? To bring together the existences of two entirely different people.|
Her words were calm and thoughtful ones that sought answers.

Holding the unique Fruit of Existence in her hands, she was even further intrigued about everything regarding this force blazing with Quintessence as she turned to stare at the visage of the man behind it all.
And he...sat down on the verdant grass below their feet while pointing to the spot in front of him, his magnetic voice ringing out.
|We resonate and get the weavings of our Existence on the same wavelength. We gain an understanding and trust between each other. Let's start with...your name?|
The Sanctus Autarch stared at him for a full second.
Her eyes pulsed with immense radiance as it was only moments later that she looked at the verdant grass below her and sat down, her lips parting to utter her reply.
|Claire. Claire Kindsworth.|
WAA!
A burst of colorless brilliance erupted as she sat down, her figure and Noah's sitting opposite each other as the mention of her name caused Noah's eyes to squint and shine with boundless brilliance!
Ever so briefly.
An instant later, this brilliance faded as he nodded and stretched out his hand.
|Resonance is a tricky thing...but can produce wonders when done right...|
Around him, Quintessence began to blaze as his figure burned with colorless flames.
Within its depths, the concept of Fusion began to burn as the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor stared straight at the Sanctus Autarch!

chapters.title: Chapter 3141 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! II
paragraphs: The fusion of two Existences.
It wasn't an entirely new concept to Noah as many moons ago, he had combined with Hyperion while they were seeking to break the shackles of Reality a while ago!
But it was a whole different ordeal when it involved someone as distinguished as the Sanctus Autarch.
Someone at the Autarch Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
To even stand a possibility of achieving this...
|The weavings of Quintessence urge the Existential Extremity Authority of Fusion towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity level.|
|The weavings of Quintessence urge the Existential Extremity Authority of Fables towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity level.|
Yes.
Noah theorized at least these two factors were needed.
Fusion was self-explanatory.
Fables was another step entirely.

As Noah felt the blissfully verdant grass beneath him filled with life, as he felt the beat of his Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation, as he felt the pulsing vibrations and strings of existence itself flowing and connecting everything around him, he continued to speak.

|For a Resonance of Existence, a great amount of understanding is required. Who you are. What you stand for. What choices exactly forged the current you...what your Fable was, is, and where it's going.|
He stared calmly at the figure of an Autarch ahead of him as his body flashed with vermillion flames.
With blue flames.
With dazzling colorless flames.
His Distinctions continued to evolve and advance as the eyes of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity truly opened while he asked the Sanctus Empress to reveal her story!
Her Fable!

This dazzling woman surrounded by a glow of tremendous authority and colorless brilliance looked at him with a distant gaze, almost as if thinking of her decision over and over again before her hand rose up to meet Noah's outstretched hand- their palms coming inches away from each other as a burst of colorless singularity formed between them!
HUUM!
Invisible waves of light buzzed, pushing and pulling back and forth as if a heavy stellar object was coming to fruition between them!
|My Fable...is not something immaculate or grand by any means. But I will show you.|
Noah felt a tug of a part of his consciousness.
And he let it flow freely towards the spinning colorless singularity between them, a scene began to unfold.
A scene showed a devastated Plane of Existence.

Within it, Imperium Legions moved with purpose, gathering the forces of those they conquered and splitting them into designated spots where they would be categorized and then subsequently sorted to wherever the Imperium sent them.

The scene moved in particular to show a girl in chains, a locket on her neck that she clutched, and her eyes blank as she stared into a distant skyscraper where a powerful aura at the Paracosm Stage was being bound down- a woman burning with brilliance reaching out towards the girl in chains below as around her, Martial Kings bound her with even more chains.

Horrifically, a Martial Emperor seemed maddened as he was missing an arm, half of his face scorched as he bellowed out towards the chained Paracosm Stage woman, ripping apart her clothes before he began to disgrace her.

|That day, they came and burned everything that held any trace of connection to The Watchers. I knew nothing of it, but it seemed my mother had found something. Something that allowed her to attain the Paracosm Stage, but this...was nothing before the Imperium.|
WAA!
|I watched her be disgraced by men in front of my very eyes, and I...I was...|
Before Noah, the figure of the Sanctus Empress buzzed as if she was remembering repressed memories she did want to revisit.

|I was but a slave. A remnant of what used to be. I was pulled away as my mother was being ravaged- sent off to a mining Plane of Existence that held unique Existential Metalloids utilized for the Vessels of the Imperium.|
|That...was the beginning of my Fable.|
HUUUM!
Noah's mind buzzed as tens of years of history flashed past his eyes.
In front of him, prompts flashed again and again as he experienced the Fable of the Sanctus Empress!
|You are experiencing the Fable of a distinguished character.|
|The understanding of the Entity known as Claire Kindsworth is rapidly increasing!|
An array of prompts came and went.

Noah saw dozens of years go by as a girl in chain mined Metalloids, her Sequor Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm affording her the capability to break apart the unique stones of the Plane of Existence she was stationed in to survive!

|It wasn't until 148 years later that an accident occurred- the locket that my mother left me was broken by a whip thrown by those who enslaved me. Only then did the Inheritance of the Autarch of the Long Watch that my mother had found become infused into me. Utilizing a unique function of this Inheritance, I obtained the temporary strength of a Teracosm Stage Entity- killing the Warden that always watched over me and many others before silently slipping away. And then...I hid while planning.|
The scene showed a young woman escaping to the fringes of the Omniverse.
As far away from the Imperium as she could!

|Remembering those I left behind filled me with guilt, and my drive for revenge made me want to strike back against the Imperium. And so...I sought to increase my force. To increase my power as I knew what I alone could do was limited. But, after the memory of the Imperium Knights ravaging my mother, after the abuse among men that I myself observed as a slave, my trust in men was at its lowest. But I also understood not to put a single general label on every man, so to reconcile...I promised myself that the force I formed would include both men and women, but the women would be leading and controlling everything within it!|
WAA!
Noah's mind buzzed as the creation of the Sanctus Populi bloomed within his mind.

|Saving those who were chained by Imperium and increasing our forces with the factor of time, the force I grew increased more and more as over the years, my heart let go of revenge and simply wanted to be a tool to reduce the pain of others. Someone to help those unfortunate and enslaved by the same chains as me. Years came and went and here we are today.|
Tens of thousands of years of living floated past Noah's eyes.
And they didn't seem to end as eventually...
|Your understanding of Claire Kindsworth has reached a critical level!|
|The conditions for fusing understood Existences are being drafted.|
|A new weaving of Existence is coming to fruition!|
|An Existence Based Auxiliary Ability is being drafted to existence, Quintessence taking Fables and Fusion at the forefront to achieve it!|
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! III & IV

chapters.title: Chapter 3142 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! III
paragraphs: Their palms were inches away from each other as between them, a singularity spun with saddened fervor.
Noah's weavings of Existence flowed into it, and the weavings of the Sanctus Autarch- Claire Kindsworth, flowed into it!
|The concept of Fables has been pushed to the Ascendant Existential Extremity Distinction.|
|The concept of Fusion has been pushed to the Ascendant Existential Extremity Distinction.|
|The Existence Based Auxiliary Ability, Existential Unity Manipulation, has been born.|

Between them, the singularity exploded out with authority as waves of gold and white light permeated across this region, Noah's weavings of Quintessence burning brightly while taking grand steps forward!

|The fusion and Resonance of one's Fable will Innate unity. Quintessential understanding and trust between the two parties will ensure a Resonance percentage and longevity of the fusion itself. The cost to carry out such a unity of existence is constantly changing and dependent on the parties carrying out, but it is a cost that can be shared.|
The prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes as in front of him, the Sanctus Autarch blinked while speaking towards him inquisitively.
|That is a summary of my story. But what about you? Who are you, Noah Osmont?|
Who was he?
Noah only smiled at such a question as his weavings of Existence entered the fray of the Singularity between the two of them.
|I am but a man who isn't even 30 years of age...but what I have achieved in the last few years since I touched upon Mana...that is something else entirely.|
His Fable.
It was an unfathomably grand one as he lived and did within months what others did in eons!
He showed glimpses of it to the woman in front of him as her eyes began to flicker with radiance.
The few glimpses she saw caused her pupils to constrict as she gazed at Noah as if he were some monster, yet at the same time, her understanding of him increased!
DUM!
The beat of Noah's heart was heard by her.
Felt by her.
DUM!
His grandiose aura.
His stellar authority.
The Sanctus Empress felt the colorless aura around him that could fool one for an Autarchical Authority as she truly understood what it stood for.
|Quintessence...|
HUUM!
The moment she understood this simple fact about Noah.
The moment she understood Quintessence!
|The Existence Based Auxiliary Ability, Existential Unity Manipulation, has activated to conduct a preliminary test.|
Colorless brilliance bloomed around them.
A spark of Resonance was initiated.
At the base, their stories were being artificially synchronized.
Their Fables were utilized as the Anchor to base a temporary but stable unity!
The eyes of the Sanctus Empress were stern as she looked at this being in front of her.
By all means, she was more powerful than him.
But he held a different form of power. Something that even she didn't have.
He was a man.
A man could be deceptive.
A man could be manipulative. A man could unleash a great deal of destruction and pain!
But not all men were the same. So...could she trust this man in front of her?
Gazing into his eyes and feeling his Fable flow across her mind, The Sanctus Empress was at a crossroads when the man before her spoke succinctly!
|A leap of faith...that's all it takes.|
WAA!
A leap of faith.
The Autarchical Authority of the Sanctus Empress buzzed as after immense consideration, she closed her eyes and opened herself up.
She took a leap of faith.
Waves of dazzling brilliance erupted thereafter as the Singularity between their hands...collapsed.

And this collapse pulled their two hands closer until their palms touched, their bodies warping in the next moment as Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence and the body of the Sanctus Autarch were pulled into each other!
BOOM!
A beam of cylindrical colorless light erupted between them as their figures became overlapped onto each other!
|An Unfathomable fusion of existence is taking place.|
|The weavings of Existence of an Autarch flow and merge with your Existence.|
|The concentration of power is not entirely in your favor!|
There was always a question of who would be in control when two sides merged.
Within a fusion, which Existence would take the lead- or would the two that became one move in synchrony?
Grand questions. Questions that, more often than not, had unpredictable answers!

|The Existence of the second party is grand and filled with inviolable Autarchical Authority.|
A body bathed with unfathomably potent Quintessence bloomed.
Initially, it held Noah's devilishly handsome visage as gradually...the features began to shift more slender.
More...feminine.

Glimmering locks of dark hair flowed past his shoulders. His chest enlarged and became bountiful as curves began to be amplified, an alluring visage that would make any woman lose confidence beginning to appear!
The face full of dark hair seemed blinding with utter grace and coldness, the eyes so captivating that even the surrounding reality was trembling.
The fair skin was so utterly flawless and without any blemishes.

A transparent white robe wrapped around the blessed curves of his figure as he...looked like a Maiden descending from eons past! A Maiden that would make others angry just at the sheer beauty that was being expressed!
Golden wings shone brightly from behind as paired with the blue, gold, and colorless Halo above...it seemed like an untainted being had come down.
This form seemed about to become cemented when the alluring face of this visage became stern.
Something deep within him stirred.
|Your Fable is Quintessential.|
|Your Existence cannot have its nature altered.|
HUUM!
The feminine form began to reverse.
The blessed chest and wide hips disappeared, a burly and muscular visage coming to fruition as the image of a devilishly handsome man bloomed.
The bulging muscles gradually became toned as the Invictus Dominium Wings behind and on the feet pulsed with radiance!
Muscular but toned. Rough, but slightly more defined.
His features were about the same, but his face carried a faint trace of arrogance and refinement as it was utterly suave.
Like a noble that women would cry if they saw him in the hands of another, he raised his hand and looked at its fair brilliance.
His hair danced wildly as at this moment, a colorless Authority began to rise around him.
And...it was not entirely Quintessence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3143 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! IV
paragraphs: |An Unfathomable Action!|
|The fusion of two entirely distinct Existences, of existences with a huge gulf of power, of existences with entirely different weavings...has preliminarily succeeded!|
His whole body felt like it was buzzing.
His body? Was it his body? Who exactly was he at this moment?
He was...
"You fucking monster."
His mind buzzed with a thought that didn't stem from him.
And he quickly found its source as tucked away within the center of his existence was the unfathomably vast consciousness and will of the Sanctus Empress!
It was unfathomably powerful, and yet somehow during this Fusion...it was the thing suppressed between their two existences.

In a wondrous area of contained stability, the very existence of the Sanctus Empress felt like a Seed that was fused throughout Noah's existence- as if Noah was a massive container that was fully capable of holding her in!

"How could your existence possibly get this big? You haven't attained Autarchy...you haven't been baptized by Autarchical Authority...by any Autarchical Omniversal Authority. What...what can make such a thing possible?"
The Sanctus Autarch couldn't maintain her calm.

Part of her had expected to share a semblance of control during this testing of fusion due to her sheer standing and power- never did she expect that her Existence would not take the upper hand whatsoever!
And at this moment, since her Existence was fused with Noah, she felt his thoughts freely as their minds resonated.
"Other people cultivate the common Stages of Existential Dominium Realm. I cultivate something else entirely. I..."
HUUUM!
His thoughts had to come to a stop.

The mind of the Sanctus Autarch also buzzed as her contained consciousness within Noah rubbed her eyes at the sight of dazzling golden blue bordered words- prompts that began to flash in front of Noah's eyes.
|A new authority has been detected within your Existence.|
|The authority had been identified as Autarchical Authority- something only attaining after one anneals their existence to an extreme precipice!|
|The authority is not yours, and yet it is.|
|The authority is normally gained by someone whose existence has undergone tremendous change to allow for their very Source to not implode when this authority courses through them.|
|Your Existence is beginning to handle Autarchical Authority naturally.|
The words caused the Sanctus Autarch to be flabbergasted.
What the hell was this?!
While a part of Noah's existence buzzed with incredulity, the part controlling everything felt this foreign new sensation!
The sensation of a colorless Authority that Noah could swear he had always been using...and yet not.

Under his Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen, he raised both hands as one hand flowed with Autarchical Authority, and the other flowed with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence.
Both...felt nearly identical as Noah could only say that there seemed to be a missing piece for the dazzling colorless authority of Quintessence.
A missing piece that prevented it from erupting with as much fervor and grandiosity as Autarchical Authority!
But the new authority Noah was feeling...was truly something else entirely.
|Your Existence has deemed Autarchical Authority safe for circulation.|
It was deemed safe.
And the moment this occurred, Noah's heart pulsed and drew in this Autarchical Authority for no other purpose than to circulate it.
His Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation...drew in Autarchical Authority!
|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart has drawn in Autarchical Authority!|
HUUM!
His heart felt like it was being squeezed and compressed.
It felt as if it had taken in something it could not handle as it could explode at any moment!
And yet an instant later...
DUM!
Like the heavy beat of a drum that even startled the Sanctus Autarch, his heart became bathed in colorless flames as it beat and began to expand!
|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart is advancing in stature and distinction.|

|The Ejection Fraction of your heart has now exceeded 1,000% as you constantly pump and refine authority across your existence and Extremes- the Autarchical Authority flowing through you being spread to every cell within your Existence.|
DUM!
An ejection fraction of 1,000%!
A normal human being who hadn't touched Mana had an average of 50-70% as their Ejection Fraction! As their volumetric fluid that was ejected from their heart chambers with every contraction.
Yet Noah...held an ejection fraction of 1,000% as truly, his heart should have exploded into fine dust long ago!

|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart will beat at a rate of 600 beats per minute, with every beat being equivalent to 10 Trillion Beats of an Exemplary Entity's rate of refinement of existence at the apex of the Paracosm Stage.|
|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart is advancing to a grander distinction of an Omniversal Organ.|
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Like an endless and very rapid drum, his heart beat.
It was so rapid that within moments, the many beats joined together to resound into a single heavy sound every single second!

A single sound that contained an unfathomable number of beats within it. Beats that were equivalent to 10 Trillion Beats of an Exemplary Entity's rate of refinement of existence at the apex of the Paracosm Stage- each one!
It caused an unbelievable eruption and reinforcement of Noah's existence to unfold as this was only the initial step.
His heart was the first.
But its action meant that Autarchical Authority...now coursed across Noah's existence- and at an immeasurably rapid rate at that.
|The Weavings of your Existence burn with the essence of Autarchical Authority.|
|The Weavings of your Extremes burn with the essence of Autarchical Authority.|
|You have gained access to an authority far advanced from your Extremes.|
|Your Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities take advantage and fill themselves to the brim with this authority.|
His whole existence cheered.
His weavings cheered!
His eyes...
|The Eyes of Deorcnysse burn with an eclipsing brilliance and begin to advance.|
Another Omniversal Organ began to advance. Alongside it...
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse is altering its intricate weavings and undergoing a change.|
His Heart.
His Eyes.
And ultimately...Autarchical Authority flowed towards his Wings.
On his back and on his feet, his gloriously gold wings became tainted with a fantastical colorless brilliance!
His Invictus Dominium Wings began to burn!

chapters.title: Chapter 3144 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! V
paragraphs: HUUM!
Reality distorted as if a buzzing hymn was playing out.
A hymn of glory and utter adulation!
The gold grandeur of his Invictus Dominium Wings increased as they expanded rapidly, enlarging until they encompassed the whole Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain!

In another region of the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, Noah's figure was dual cultivating with Sona as at this time when Autarchical Authority was coursing across his existence, he brightened up like an emerging star and released a heavy burst of authority that caused the visage of Sona to seethe with multicolored brilliance right after.
Paracosm.
The unfathomably pure aura of Paracosm bloomed from her as on her forehead, verdant wings began to sprout!
It was the emergence of a second Omniversal Organ for her.
At the same, Noah's chest became illuminated as the outline of his lungs could be seen.
They pulsed with multicolored brilliance as they showed signs of a fourth Omniversal Organ forming within Noah's body!
It was an astounding progression of events, but all of this was occurring on the sidelines.
What took center stage at this moment were the wings.
The glorious wings enlarged across the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, but they didn't stop there.
Their brilliance flourished across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as their halcyon luster- as their golden brilliance began to flash with a pristine colorless grandeur.
Within Noah's mind.
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings overwhelmingly draw in the coursing Autarchical Authority.|
|Causality is twisting and distorting in the most unfathomable way.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia feels the Autarchical Authority flowing through you.|
|The Four Components of Aitia lay themselves bare before you.|
|Efficiency burns with change.|
|The Component of Material makes itself known to you.|
|The Component of Formal makes itself known to you.|
|The Component of Final makes itself known to you.|
The Four Components of Aitia.
They made themselves bare before Noah's eyes as even this was just the cusp!
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings is taking on too much Autarchical Authority!|
Behind his back and feet, the colorless wings burned too brightly.
The distance they covered was too vast, and what they were currently doing was too much!
"Hey, what are you doing? Be careful!" Within his mind, the voice of the Sanctus Autarch rang out hurriedly.
She could feel the Autarchical Authority within her Existence be squeezed out with fervor.
She could feel an immense amount that she wouldn't even utilize for a powerful last minute attack be eaten up every second!
And the result was something nobody expected as in the next moment...
BOOM!
It felt like something broke.
Within the Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings, four blazing singularities moved by themselves as they were the Four Components of Aitia.
They moved rapidly while expanding under the immense light of Autarchical Authority, eventually smashing into each other simultaneously as they disappeared into a single point of a singularity!
From this point of singularity, incandescent colorless light began to shine.
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia is a unique Omniversal Authority|

|Among Omniversal Authorities, there are those holding the key as an Accedere Omniversal Intersect that if properly understood and studied, they could lead one across the intricate pathways of the Infinite Intersects towards the weavings of Autarchical Omniversal Authorities.|

The blooming information only became a hint of the background as from the single point of singularity where the four components of Aitia smashed into each other, a sensation of a distorting black hole leading towards an immeasurably grand palace formed.
In that place...
|Causality flows all the way back to an Autarchical Omniversal Authority.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia is an Accedere Omniversal Intersect that makes up an intricate part of an encompassing Autarchical Omniversal Authority!|
|This Autarchical Omniversal Authority peers down on your incursion at this moment.|
WAA!
From the heavy point of singularity.
It felt like an apathetic collection of weavings was gazing at Noah's existence, a magisterial burst of colorless brilliance erupting as Noah's Invictus Dominium Wings flashed to grasp it!
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings see a grand future.|
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings seek an unfathomable peak.|
|A Maximus!|
The grandeur of the Colorless light was heavy.
Too heavy as forcefully, the tips of Noah's Wings curved inwards and sunk into the Singularity!
Such an action caused Noah's figure to freeze along with the existence of the Sanctus Autarch.
As if their consciousnesses were brought along a ride they shouldn't have been able to see!
|The ushering of Invictus Maximus had been brought forward.|
Their very existence froze as in the next moment, heavy scenes began to play out in their minds.
The first one showed Noah floating in space, bright colorless wings stretching out for light years as in his hands was a single colorless singularity.
From this singularity, streams of nine cylindrical lights flowed out as they formed nine dazzling colorless portals that had different labels above them!
|$@%@# Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|¥£¥¥♤₩ Eonic Omniverse Record.|
Each one seemed to be a gateway of an Eonic Omniverse Record as moments later, Noah's visage multiplied as his bodies all went towards these dazzling colorless portals!
This scene then faded as another one came.
A scene that showed an utterly massive Devouring Worm staring down at Noah, its segmented body callous as its eyes were filled with heavy dread and apathy!

Its countless sickles and wings buzzed as from behind it, a sickle pulled out a humanoid figure to present to Noah as a wailing voice emanated from it as it moved this humanoid figure threateningly before Noah.
|BEND!|
HUUM!
The scene shifted again.
This time, the visage of the Sanctus Autarch could be seen.
Her colorless hair lay bloodied gold as a man surrounded by golden brilliance grasped her head and applied pressure, her body trembling as his voice boomed out!
|You cannot kill an Ankyra, young thing.|
The scene shifted yet again!
This time, an endless swarm of Devouring Worms could be seen moving like an endless black cloud.
Ahead of them- the subject of their chase...was none other than an incandescent Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

It felt like an apathetic collection of weavings was gazing at Noah's existence, a magisterial burst of colorless brilliance erupting as Noah's Invictus Dominium Wings flashed to grasp it!
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings see a grand future.|
|The Ascendant Existential Invictus Dominium Wings seek an unfathomable peak.|
|A Maximus!|
The grandeur of the Colorless light was heavy.
Too heavy as forcefully, the tips of Noah's Wings curved inwards and sunk into the Singularity!
Such an action caused Noah's figure to freeze along with the existence of the Sanctus Autarch.
As if their consciousnesses were brought along a ride they shouldn't have been able to see!
|The ushering of Invictus Maximus had been brought forward.|
Their very existence froze as in the next moment, heavy scenes began to play out in their minds.
The first one showed Noah floating in space, bright colorless wings stretching out for light years as in his hands was a single colorless singularity.
From this singularity, streams of nine cylindrical lights flowed out as they formed nine dazzling colorless portals that had different labels above them!
|$@%@# Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|¥£¥¥♤₩ Eonic Omniverse Record.|
Each one seemed to be a gateway of an Eonic Omniverse Record as moments later, Noah's visage multiplied as his bodies all went towards these dazzling colorless portals!
This scene then faded as another one came.
A scene that showed an utterly massive Devouring Worm staring down at Noah, its segmented body callous as its eyes were filled with heavy dread and apathy!

Its countless sickles and wings buzzed as from behind it, a sickle pulled out a humanoid figure to present to Noah as a wailing voice emanated from it as it moved this humanoid figure threateningly before Noah.
|BEND!|
HUUM!
The scene shifted again.
This time, the visage of the Sanctus Autarch could be seen.
Her colorless hair lay bloodied gold as a man surrounded by golden brilliance grasped her head and applied pressure, her body trembling as his voice boomed out!
|You cannot kill an Ankyra, young thing.|
The scene shifted yet again!
This time, an endless swarm of Devouring Worms could be seen moving like an endless black cloud.
Ahead of them- the subject of their chase...was none other than an incandescent Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3145 A Glimpse of Invictus Maximus! VI
paragraphs: A myriad of shocking scenes pulsing with distortions of Causality played out!
The most recent one showed an endlessly expanding cloud of Devouring Worms chasing the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- as if it were the only flickering point of light amidst endless darkness.

From the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, Colorless beams of light shot out like celestial stanchions of brilliance that smashed into the dark clouds of Devouring Worms, hindering portions of them and stopping them in place, but even more surged in like an endless tide.
WUUU!
Their wails radiated emotions of immense want and need- needs that had to be met regardless of anything and everything as they moved with obsession!
BOOM!

Ahead of the path of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, existence tore apart as an utterly massive Devouring Worm appeared, its sickles winding down to entrench itself onto the vibrant Seed as before it neared...
WAA!
Magisterial colorless feathery wings bloomed.
Feathery colorless wings that converged towards the back of a single man, these feathery wings blocking the oncoming sickles as...
BZZZT!
It was as if metal met metal.

The terrifying sickles of the Source Devouring Worm actually couldn't pierce these immeasurably bright wings, but the expression of the devilish man holding these wings was that of sternness and rage!
This scene then faded as another one came.
It was dark.
So immensely dark that one had to resort to their eyes to see anything.

Within an area of the Omniverse that was filled with an ever-present darkness, one could actually see millions upon millions of humanoid figures floating silently under the cover of darkness, their eyes filled with shame and terror as each one was quiet!
At some point, their eyes rose in alarm as from afar, they saw the twinkling lights that looked to be the weavings of Existential Extremity Authority.

The faces of the few million beings covered under the shade of darkness changed at such a scene as at the forefront, a verdant gold haired Emilliana gritted her teeth, pushing off the shattered asteroid and going towards the twinkling lights of Existential Extremity Authority!
"Stop it! Stop the utilization of Existential Extremity Authority!"
She was shouting, but even her shouts were silent as if she didn't want to be heard!
Ahead of her, a few hundred figures shining with Armaments of the Imperium showed terror on their faces as they didn't stop, shooting towards her even faster.
Her face changed at such a reality as she turned around and shouted.
"Scatter!"
It wasn't long since her words were uttered that...
WUUU!
A wailing sound could be heard behind the escaping Imperium Knights as clouds of darkness came with them.
Shouts of terror echoed out as millions began to scatter.

Those with Existential Dominium Bodies exploded out faster with the sheer force of their physical attacks, and they sought refuge deeper in the darkness of the Omniverse as they moved as if their very lives were on the line!
The twinkling lights that were the terrified Imperium Knights reached and saw the scattering Entities as one shouted out.
|Please, we just-|
SQUELCH!
The usage of his intent was like a beacon along with his Existential Extremity Authority- an obsidian spear-like sickle instantly piercing him and causing his existence to shrivel to nothingness!

Droves of Devouring Worms then appeared all around as they released feelers that sensed any disruptions of existence, their bodies randomly shooting out right after whether they felt something or not as they simply tried their luck.
And this random choice yielded results as a few hundred headed directly towards the scattering mass of Entities.
Seeing such a reality with her eyes, Sanctus Princess Emilliana held her tongue as she wanted to shout to everyone....please do not utilize your Existential Extremity Authorities.
But what she feared the most occurred.
Seeing the terrifying Devouring Worms nearing their positions, the fear within the hearts of some could not be pressed down as around them, brilliance instantly blared.
Some gold.
Some purple.
The light of Existential Extremity Authorities wrapped around them and caused their bodies to shoot out faster, but the moment this occurred...
WUU!
The Devouring Worms appeared right beside them and struck as if they were given the direction of exactly where they were!
And once one domino fell...
HUUM!

Others began to blare with Existential Extremity Authorities as they surged out even faster to different directions, and the Devouring Worms that were randomly searching in the darkness...their blank obsidian faces felt extremely devilish at this moment as they turned into streaks of light that went to feast towards twinkling lights!
Sanctus Princess Emilliana gritted her teeth at such a reality as she continued deeper into the darkness of the Omniverse. Her eyes seemed to be burning with regret as her eyes trembled.
Why didn't they listen?
And why did she bother to try and save others by leaving that safe haven?
Why?!
Existential Extremity Authorities were useless.
Utilizing them even drew in the Devouring Worms as they had to come up with a different method of fighting!
That man was perfecting it.
He was close.
They just had to-
WAP!
The scene faded away.

The illusion of constantly expanding colorless wings showed themselves before Noah's sight and the sight of the Sanctus Autarch whose eyes were streaming with golden tears, booming words echoing out of their Existence at this moment!
|Causality stretches itself across the weavings of the Omniverse itself.|
|What may happen. What will happen. What has happened. Everything can be twisted and distorted if the right tool is utilized.|
|Invictus Maximum is a tool that can bend the weavings of Causality across the staunch Autarchical Authority to achieve the most-|
BOOM!
An explosive force erupted within Noah.
The wings on his back nearly tore as colorless blood gushed out!
|Too much Autarchical Authority is being cycled while the core Source of the Invictus Dominium Wings has still not achieved a critical state.|
...! The Invictus Dominium Wings went too far, too fast.
They weren't ready for the shocking authority that allowed Noah to see what he had just seen, nor could such a state be sustained for long!
So regardless of what this tool thought, Noah gave a command as the surging of the Autarchical Authority was slowed down.
His colorless wings healed instantly as his mind buzzed from what he had just seen.
Within him, the Four Components of Aitia flowed freely once more as they circled around a central singularity.
A doorway.
|The Duru of Autarchy has opened within your Existence.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3146 The Atlas of Existence! I
paragraphs: Duru.
An ancient word that could mean gateway or doorway.
A gateway towards Autarchy had opened...but Noah only gazed at it sternly as this wasn't the stage he enacted.
He had to pioneer his own path forward as after the Invictus Stage...would he truly head towards the same thing as everyone else?!

When he could see that binding oneself to a single source of Existence could make one extremely powerful within the bounds of that Existence, but it may be entirely useless within the bounds of another Source of Existence.
No.
What he sought was something else entirely. HUUM!
|You have turned your back on the pathway of Existential Extremity Authorities!|
|You have denied the weavings of progression of your Natal Omniverse!|
The Duru of Autarchy trembled.
Noah didn't decimate or destroy it off entirely, but he was truly seeking something else!
So he ignored the easy pathway that had formed within his Existence.
He focused on himself.
On his Body.
On his Origin.
On his Soul.
They were currently within the Invictus Realm, and it was time for them to exceed this.
Invictus was Unconquerable.
Undefeated!
What came after it had to contain the myriad Sources of Existence as it could not be bound to just one!
Noah's mind buzzed as he remembered the glimpse of Invictus Maximus.
He took his hands that surged with the Autarchical Authority as instead of leaning on it and following its straight path, he would utilize it to aid his already stellar path.
BZZZT!
The colorless Autarchical Authority turned sharp and purposeful.
"What are you doing?!"
The hurried voice of the Sanctus Autarch echoed out as joined with Noah's existence, she could feel his intentions as she did not believe them!
But Noah remained silent as he recalled the Nine blinding portals among the scenes shown by the glimpse of Invictus Maximus.
And he thrust his hand into his chest as Autarchical Authority split into Nine sharp points, piercing into his brightly burning Existence as if they were carving it into Nine parts!
The stage after Invictus.
Noah's mind already boomed with its identity as his intent echoed out with mad grandeur!
|Atlas...|
He bellowed the word out as it reverberated across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
In his existence, Nine Holes were carved out across his Dominium Soul, Dominium Body, and Dominium Origin at the same time.

The holes seemed to be akin to an empty void, but they began to circle and undulate as, while withstanding immense pain, Noah's Will gathered and placed everything regarding Existential Extremity Authorities into one of these holes!
At the same time, a single singularity bloomed at the very center of these holes as within it...what could be summed up as what made Noah was forced into it.
Who he was.
His Records.
His Existence.
His Will.
All of it was contained at the center of gloriously spinning holes as the first one...began to glimmer with colorless brilliance!
And at the same time this occurred...
"That...that...!"
The shocked voice of the Sanctus Autarch buzzed within Noah's mind as she noticed something.
"That is no Autarchical Base!"
Her mind seemed to be in denial as the thing she and the Faesinged Queen had considered to be an Autarch Base...the Sanctus Autarch no longer believed it to be the case.
She could see it before.
While fused with Noah and coursing with Autarchical Authority, she felt it even more now.
What they thought to be an Autarchical Base...she felt it move within Noah's existence and settle onto the central area where everything seemed to be gathering.
The Nine circular holes of the void surrounding it seemed to become firm and immovable at this moment as 8 remained utterly silent- looking small and unfathomably vast at the same time.

Meanwhile, the ninth one held colorless brilliance that showed clouds of colorless light gathering around it, a beam shooting out from it and going towards the unstable Duru of Autarchy that Noah left alone but did not deny!
Whatever he did stabilized at this moment.
|The Atlas of Existence has been formed within the bounds of Noah Osmont.|
HUUUM!
Booming sounds of glory emanated out from Noah as an instant later, every shred of authority disappeared from his body.
His wings remained colorless, but they felt like they had lost their luster.
His body attained calmness and an immovable presence.
|The Atlas of Existence has Nine Mundis of Power. Each Mundi can contain within it the basis of a Unique Source of Existence and its standard Realm of Progression.|
|The First Mundi of Power has been designated as the Natal Source of Progression- Conceptual System of Existence.|
The Atlas of Existence!
Within it, there were nine circles of singularities surrounding a single unfathomable one- the very core of the Atlas itself, and these nine circles were termed Mundis of Power!
Mundi was a word closely related to the center of a world or a system.
And on the First Mundi of Power, the weavings of everything about the system of progression relating to Existential Extremity Authorities were placed in!
All Existential Extremity Authorities. All weavings of the influence of Omniversal Authorities.
Everything within this System of Progression was placed into this container- this Mundi of Power as now, Noah had the freedom to enact eight other Systems of Power.
This was the power he was opening up.
|The Types of Sources of Progression or Systems of Existence that can be placed in the Atlas of Existence have strict requirements of complexity and uniqueness.|
|Simple, Simpler, or Similar Systems of Existence may be assimilated into an already existing System within the Atlas of Existence.|
|Sufficient understanding and core grasp of the System of Existence is required before such a System can be placed within the Atlas of Existence.|
Wondrous weavings of the new construct that Noah laid down within himself bloomed as something utterly fantastical was coming to fruition!

The more time passed, the more this fantastical construct became solidified as every ounce of an aura within him dissipated, the only thing left behind being the inner brilliance of the Atlas of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3147 The Atlas of Existence! II
paragraphs: An unimaginably grand reality was being weaved forth.
One that had too many moving pieces and was ultimately the culmination of a profound set of choices coming together!
The Atlas of Existence.
Holding Nine circular Mundis of Power, this Atlas made it so that Noah could grasp multiple Systems of Existence- multiple Sources of Existence different from the one he stemmed from!
And the Atlas was bound to specific rulings as if something was too simple or similar to an already existing System of Power...
|The Lumen System of Existence has been deemed to be alongside the same weavings as the Conceptual System of Existence.|

|Much of its core Source is still undiscovered as there isn't a sufficient enough Source to consider Lumen a full System of Existence, but all weavings of its power are relegated to the First Mundi of Power.|
If something was too similar to an already existing System of Power or too simple, it would only get assimilated into an already existing System!

In this manner, the remnant weavings of Lumen that Noah was unearthing became grouped up with the Conceptual System of Existence of Existential Extremity Authorities- since truly, these two shared very similar workings and origins.
|A Lead Factor is required for each System of Existence within a Mundi of Power.|
|The First Mundi of Power contains multiple strong Lead Factors capable of taking the reigns and direction of progression.|
HUUM!
Inside the only filled circular singularity.
Amidst the swirling colorless brilliance within the First Mundi of Power, bright weavings erupted within as a profound moment arrived!
|Under a moment of Synchrony, three Lead Factors emerged within the First Mundi of Power.|
|The Lead Factors of Quintessence, Infinity, and the Protagonist are the relegators of the Conceptual System of Existence within the First Mundi of Power.|
His body trembled.
A heavy boom echoed out within the First Mundi of Power as within it, the tendrils of light of Quintessence, Infinity, and the Protagonist burned brightly!
They coursed with much more interminable power than before as...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
Three glorious prompts side by side.
The Lead Factors of the Conceptual System of Existence stepped up as there were three instead of one!
And even the profound weavings of Lumen did not take the lead as within the Atlas of Existence, one of the first Nine Circles within it radiated a profound and ancient aura.
|The Boundaries of the Progression of Realms are not a factor for you with the Atlas of Existence.|
|You cannot be designated to a specific realm as you may fit the margins of some but not others.|
|You have exceeded the Limitations of Stages of Power with the Atlas of Existence. Henceforth, your Major Distinction is Noah Osmont, Owner of the Atlas.|
WAA!
His body stabilized.
Within it, Nine circles moved around a single central base as if anyone were to see them, their very existence might break from sheer shock!
Only a certain will that was fused with him was able to get a glimpse as even this...
"What have you done..."
Even this Entity asked in a stern tone as she couldn't fathom what had just happened fully!
She was fused to him.
So as all of this occurred, she faintly sensed changes occurring within her Existence as well!
But she couldn't fully ascertain them as for this, she would need to be...
"Separate."
She would need to not be fused with him so tightly.
She heard his intent as within the span of an instant, a colorless light flashed, and her figure reappeared before Noah again.
His features became more masculine and robust, the Sanctus Autarch feeling his gaze on her as he voiced out. "How do you feel?"
WAA!
A simple question.
But the eyes of the Sanctus Autarch flashed as she felt as if the man before her was distinctly different from the man she was seeing not too long ago!
No aura leaked from him as even with her standing as an Autarch, she felt like she was standing opposite of an ancient Entity she didn't fully understand.
"I feel..."
She sensed the changes within her as shockingly, she could see a...branding of nine circles within the very center of her Existence!
It felt pristine and ancient, seemingly almost like a branded tattoo in her Existence of the shocking Atlas of Existence that Noah held in his!
She gazed at this thoughtfully as she replied while looking at Noah.
"I feel like I have obtained a grand possible opportunity."
Yes.
It seemed to be merely a branding, but her Autarchical Authority was flowing towards it as Noah's figure opposite to her nodded!

He raised his hands and looked at himself along with the dull Colorless wings behind his back and feet- His image emanating a profound air of mystery as the lack of colors and tendrils of light only made him that much more of an enigma to others.
"Yes. The fusion between us seems to not be an issue, and surprises were brought forward due to it..."
Surprises.
One of the major ones was a glimpse of Invictus Maximus as it showed Noah scenes of possibilities that may or may not come to fruition!
Then, there was the emergence of the Atlas of Existence.
There was the first filled circle spinning calmly with colorless authority as this was the First Mundi of Power within the Atlas!
This was not by itself as a distance away...there was another consequences that remained.
Within him, the Duru of Autarchy floated simply.

And a constant stream of colorless Autarchical Authority flowed towards Noah's First Mundi of Power. It bathed the System of Existence within this circle of the Atlas as this was the gateway of Existence that Noah refused to follow and be admitted to the same path of simple Autarchy!

sentences.text: An unimaginably grand reality was being weaved forth.
One that had too many moving pieces and was ultimately the culmination of a profound set of choices coming together!
The Atlas of Existence.
Holding Nine circular Mundis of Power, this Atlas made it so that Noah could grasp multiple Systems of Existence- multiple Sources of Existence different from the one he stemmed from!
And the Atlas was bound to specific rulings as if something was too simple or similar to an already existing System of Power...
|The Lumen System of Existence has been deemed to be alongside the same weavings as the Conceptual System of Existence.|

|Much of its core Source is still undiscovered as there isn't a sufficient enough Source to consider Lumen a full System of Existence, but all weavings of its power are relegated to the First Mundi of Power.|
If something was too similar to an already existing System of Power or too simple, it would only get assimilated into an already existing System!

In this manner, the remnant weavings of Lumen that Noah was unearthing became grouped up with the Conceptual System of Existence of Existential Extremity Authorities- since truly, these two shared very similar workings and origins.
|A Lead Factor is required for each System of Existence within a Mundi of Power.|
|The First Mundi of Power contains multiple strong Lead Factors capable of taking the reigns and direction of progression.|
HUUM!
Inside the only filled circular singularity.
Amidst the swirling colorless brilliance within the First Mundi of Power, bright weavings erupted within as a profound moment arrived!
|Under a moment of Synchrony, three Lead Factors emerged within the First Mundi of Power.|
|The Lead Factors of Quintessence, Infinity, and the Protagonist are the relegators of the Conceptual System of Existence within the First Mundi of Power.|
His body trembled.
A heavy boom echoed out within the First Mundi of Power as within it, the tendrils of light of Quintessence, Infinity, and the Protagonist burned brightly!
They coursed with much more interminable power than before as...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist has attained enough authority to step into the Second Phase of Ascendancy.|
Three glorious prompts side by side.
The Lead Factors of the Conceptual System of Existence stepped up as there were three instead of one!
And even the profound weavings of Lumen did not take the lead as within the Atlas of Existence, one of the first Nine Circles within it radiated a profound and ancient aura.
|The Boundaries of the Progression of Realms are not a factor for you with the Atlas of Existence.|
|You cannot be designated to a specific realm as you may fit the margins of some but not others.|
|You have exceeded the Limitations of Stages of Power with the Atlas of Existence.
Henceforth, your Major Distinction is Noah Osmont, Owner of the Atlas.|
WAA!
His body stabilized.
Within it, Nine circles moved around a single central base as if anyone were to see them, their very existence might break from sheer shock!
Only a certain will that was fused with him was able to get a glimpse as even this...
"What have you done..."
Even this Entity asked in a stern tone as she couldn't fathom what had just happened fully!
She was fused to him.
So as all of this occurred, she faintly sensed changes occurring within her Existence as well!
But she couldn't fully ascertain them as for this, she would need to be...
"Separate."
She would need to not be fused with him so tightly.
She heard his intent as within the span of an instant, a colorless light flashed, and her figure reappeared before Noah again.
His features became more masculine and robust, the Sanctus Autarch feeling his gaze on her as he voiced out.
"How do you feel?"
WAA!
A simple question.
But the eyes of the Sanctus Autarch flashed as she felt as if the man before her was distinctly different from the man she was seeing not too long ago!
No aura leaked from him as even with her standing as an Autarch, she felt like she was standing opposite of an ancient Entity she didn't fully understand.
"I feel..."
She sensed the changes within her as shockingly, she could see a...branding of nine circles within the very center of her Existence!
It felt pristine and ancient, seemingly almost like a branded tattoo in her Existence of the shocking Atlas of Existence that Noah held in his!
She gazed at this thoughtfully as she replied while looking at Noah.
"I feel like I have obtained a grand possible opportunity."
Yes.
It seemed to be merely a branding, but her Autarchical Authority was flowing towards it as Noah's figure opposite to her nodded!

chapters.title: Chapter 3148 The Atlas of Existence! III
paragraphs: The fusion to an Autarch brought too many things forward- allowing Noah to undergo changes and take actions that would have in no way been possible so early.
Yes.
It brought a lot of things forward!
This was the only thought one could have if they looked into Noah and saw his Atlas of Existence.

If one looked closer to the First Mundi of Power that held everything to do with his Natal Source of Existence- and the Duru of Autarchy that seemed to be a gateway within him, allowing for the flow of Autarchical Authority to flow into the First Mundi of Power!
It caused his existence to experience an ongoing sense of elevation as it related to this System of Power, with even Noah himself...finding it hard to quantify exactly where he was at currently.
He truly didn't fit into any of the Demarcations of the Dominium Realms as he was neither in the Paracosm Stage nor the Autarchical Stage!
As the owner of the Atlas of Existence, he was something else entirely.
But he needed time to realize and understand everything, as well as what his next steps should be in the direct utilization of the Atlas of Existence.
He turned his head towards the thoughtful Sanctus Autarch as he spoke.
"Our fusion should be able to last as long as the capacity of our Existence remains high. Depending on how my strength scales in the near future, we may still need to do this to face what is coming."
The Faesinged Queen.
The other two Omniversal Ankyras of this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record!
As he spoke about them, the Sanctus Autarch seemed to have many things in her mind as she held her chin while she replied.

"She won't come back any time soon. She'll need surety that the next time she moves, she will actually be able to obtain what she wants. As for her reaching out to the other two major Autarchs of this Eonic Omniverse Record...she may very well lean into this, as unlikely as it may be. After all, greed trumps everything."

She wanted the so called Autarchical Base within Noah for herself, and greed almost always won over reason as her going to the Leprachanus Existences and the Satyrus Nymph was bound to be the last resort!
At her words, Noah nodded and looked at his wings.
They moved like a limb behind him as he brought to the sharp, feathery point of his right wing in front of him, the dull, Colorless glow on it reflecting in his pupils as he spoke.

"Yes, my wings do not sense any heavy movements in the near future, which may give us hours or even days after the timer of this safe zone runs out. After that...something is already in the works. Don't count out the Faesinged Queen locking hands with the other two Omniversal Ankyras just yet..."
His Invictus Dominium Wings...could they even have this identity anymore when he was so far past what Dominium stood for?

The glimpse of Invictus Maximus was a fantastical glimpse, but his wings had still elevated even though they hadn't attained that supreme stage just yet- and from them, he could tell of the ongoing weavings of Causality around him and others!
He could tell that his own weavings wouldn't enter the frays of cause and effect of his enemies in the near future.

It was the beginning of the formation of shocking perceptivity from Noah as from the Duru of Autarchy, Autarchical Authority continued to flow into the First Mundi of Power and raised up everything to do with his existence, where he expected the finalized boons of the transformations within the next few days!
"We have a few days...let's use them to the fullest before everything unfolds."
His magisterial wings snapped behind his back as he spoke, the Sanctus Autarch nodding as she came out of her thoughts and focused on his figure.
"Yes. Before that...can you explain the actions you just undertook? This branding on my Existence..."

Her eyes were inquisitive as she still couldn't help but look at him as if he were a monstrous existence, Noah's burning pupils becoming sharp as he replied to her while moving to quantify many things about himself!
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was vast, with its inhabitants being too numerous to count as there was much to do.
There were Legions to be forged and upgraded constantly as Noah's own Existence elevated.
There were Havens to forge, Armaments to mass produce, and Fruits of Existence to exponentially grow en masse!
There was truly a lot to do, and given the time, Noah would utilize it fully.
Like this, seconds turned into minutes.
And minutes turned into hours.

Time continued to pass until the safe zone that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had returned to had the thin barrier begin to dissipate, and even then...no Legions of the Faeburned Existences led by the Faesinged Queen came!
Within the far corners of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
In the bounds of Existence that seemed to be colored fully gold, mountains of gold rose and fell in gorgeous sequence.
Iridescent jewels, dazzling gems, radiant armaments, and unique constructs...all things full of value and could be distinguished as supreme Loot were gathered in abundance!
In the depths of such a place, the Faesinged Queen walked across a golden sea of jewels calmly as she looked ahead on a bejeweled throne shining with dark gold radiance.
Her gaze was that of utmost calm as she stared ahead, the entity wrapped in dark gold radiance buzzing at this moment as his heavy voice echoed out.
|For the uptight Faesinged Queen to visit me in this hellhole...I wonder what it could be for.|
HOO!
As he spoke, hazy outlines of sacks of golden brilliance and treasure buzzed around him, with the eyes of the Faesinged Queen becoming sharper from the sense of oppression emanating from this being!
His power did not stem from the mind or body.
He was an Entity whose strength stemmed solely from the uncountable number of treasures he held!

chapters.title: Chapter 3149 The Atlas of Existence! IV
paragraphs: Sunwinged Leprachanus.
This was a title, as well as a type of Existence that was afforded the highest peak of power for the Source of Existence of Leprachanus.
Their very existence cultivated wealth; with the more wealth that one held and accumulated, the stronger one became!
Their Authority was known as the Authority of Opulentia!
The Faesinged Queen hated many things about the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, but she hated this Entity the most purely because of his power.
Being stronger than both her and the Satyrus Nymph, this Entity wantonly did what he wished since they were locked in here as apart from his wealth, everything else about him was horrid!
She looked at him seated on his bejeweled throne, his massive figure looking short and stout as behind his back...the dark gold glow of countless Suns formed his wings.
Sunwinged.

He genuinely had trillions of suns making up the structure of his wings as within these suns, The Faesinged Queen knew there were countless mountains of treasures hidden within those miniature suns as she kept her eyes straight into the two Luminous suns that were his eyes as she replied.
|An Intruder in the depths of this Eonic Omniverse Record. He doesn't seem to be one of them as he seems to be an Explorer or something that inadvertently arrived here.|
|Oh?|

Her words roused the attention of the Sunwinged Leprachanus as he moved his face out of the dark gold veil. The features of his face could be seen as golden rings hung from his ears and nose, his bright lips laced with light as they smiled ear to ear as he replied.
|Why is this of importance? They're likely not bound to this Eonic Omniverse Record like we are as they can leave at any time. Why waste any breath on this? What makes you come to see me about them?|
His eyes swirled with a treasured light of brilliance as he asked, and the Faesinged Queen silently simmered in her thoughts before she replied.

|One of those who entered has an unblemished Base of Existence. Untouched. Unused. They know it as an Autarchical Base as their System of Existence leans more on the Conceptual Manipulation of Existence.|
WAA!
The moment these words were uttered, the visage of the Sunwinged Leprachanus flashed and appeared inches away from the Faesinged Queen.

An action that caused the Faesinged Queen to tremble slightly, but she controlled herself and staunchly looked ahead as the Entity opposite her smiled ear to ear, his hot breath blowing over her face.

|Autarchical...a Source of Existence one arrives after advancing Conceptual extremes to the utmost. If there really is an Unblemished Autarchical Base, an Unblemished Base of Existence...you could have used that against your Base of Existence to escape this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record. If that is the case...why are you here? Don't tell me a doll like you was too weak for him...|
His hand rose as his rough fingers caressed her smooth cheeks.
Veiling her disgust, the Faesinged Queen continued calmly.

|He has enough means as someone who was able to randomly appear within this Omniverse Record. I tested him, but he proved to be difficult even though he has yet to touch his Base of Existence. He also has an Autarch beside him. A fair dainty female...someone you could get your hands on.|
She waved her hands as she spoke, showing the image of Noah and the Sanctus Autarch as seeing them, the massive Sunwinged Leprachanus only became brighter as a raucous laughter boomed from him!
|Haha, you know me well, but this still doesn't...|
|His Autarchial Base is so unique that it would be big enough for you and I to share, and even have left over for the Satyrus Nymph.|
Immense silence descended.
The bejeweled rings all over the face of the Sunwinged Leprachanus bobbed and weaved as they made a unique sound, his rough face shining with a splendor of gold as seriousness set on it.
He seemed to have thought a great deal about the words of the Faesinged Queen before he replied.
|You believe even the Nymph is necessary to take down these two?|
His eyes lingered on Noah and the Sanctus Autarch.
And the answer from the Faesinged Queen was one of heavy affirmation.

|Yes. When you see him for yourself, you will understand. But his Base of Existence...even if there were five of us in here, it would still be enough for all of us to share and use to get out of here.|
The reality was set.
The visage of the Sunwinged Leprachanus nodded.

|Well, even if we were to escape and get out there again, we would likely have to hide from the eyes of those wankers again. Those so called Protectors of Existence...Oh well. A life on the run is a fun one. All right, I'll need a few days to prepare; you go ahead and tell the Nymph.|
|A few days?|
The brows of the Faesinged Queen rose as the massive figure of the Sunwinged Leprachanus turned around and smiled.

|Yes, I shall increase my wealth even more and have my Opulentia Authority at its peak before breaking out of here. To do that, it seems my Lineage will have to be reduced once again...but this time for good. Ah!|
He shook his head as if he felt great sorrow, and yet his face had a deep smile of amusement and greed!
The Faesinged Queen heard his words and gazed at him with clear disgust, to which he turned around and scoffed while moving towards the many golden mountains stretched out around this region.

|Oh don't be such a hypocrite. Only the three of us could possibly leave as if we succeed, all others have to be left here. And after we are gone, so will our roles be gone as artificial Ankyras as this Eonic Omniverse Record will perish soon after. Why does it matter if I kill them all now for greater wealth or let it all rot in here over time? You have to be smart Little Fae, otherwise...|
HUUM!
His body buzzed as it shone with an incandescent dark gold authority.
In such a heavy atmosphere, he smiled again while waving his hands!
|Go on now, I'm over here getting giddy at going against Autarchical Authority. My Opulentia has not had something like that in so long...I wonder how this Source of Existence compares?|
Greed buzzed around him as with a glimmer of dark gold brilliance, he disappeared!
The Faesinged Queen looked at this scene with calm before she also took a step and disappeared in another direction.
A few days.
This was how long the Intruder would have before the full weight of three Omniversal Ankyras came unto him!
