chapters.title: Chapter 3161 Momentary Peace! II
paragraphs: Sitting side by side with their legs dipped into the golden waters of a pool, the figures of Lilith and Ayame remained filled with power and serenity as, at this moment, Lilith gazed at the suns of Helios far above while asking slowly.
"When was the last time you talked with him? From the Records you've shared with me, you moved together with him across Dissolution and Helios..."
A light of interest was flickering in her eyes as what she asked caused Ayame to shake her head while replying with a smile.

"I haven't personally spoken with him these past days. He feels like the same man I got to know briefly back then, but now...he also just feels too far away. I don't think I could look at or speak to him like I used to. It's...hard to explain. But..." As she was answering, she turned her eyes to the Daughter of Hatred as she asked sharply.

"...this is the third time you've asked about him. Are you...interested in our great Emperor? He's already got his Harem around him, and I don't know how messy it is right now...or if he's just as capable in handling the emotions of everyone in that whole web as he is in terms of his power."
The collection of women around the True Emperor of Quintessence!
Who knew just what emotions they felt on a day-to-day basis and exactly how the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor took care of them.
'Well, he does have a lot of Clones...and dilated time so...'
Ayame had this thought in her mind as beside her, the Daughter of Hatred laughed while waving her hands.

"I was his enemy all the way back then. It truly just seems like yesterday- I was stronger than him, held Legions under my banner, and so on. The grandiose Dimensional Hellion Ruler! The Dimensional Deceiver! Haha, it all seems worthless now. He came out of nowhere and ate everything up."
Her gaze seemed reminiscent as she thought about the Desolate Mausoleum and the Dimensions under her banner.
She shook her head as she answered Ayame's question.

"No, I don't see myself entering his grand Harem, but of course, I've never stopped being curious about the man who bested me and is currently leading this whole ridiculous circus of freaks and monsters. Like...what the hell is even going on in his mind? Even this tournament he's starting tomorrow- how is he able to just think of doing something like that while around the Omniverse, the threat of the Devouring Worms that treat every ounce of power we have built so far as useless is waiting."
"Is he just that confident that he will overcome this just like everything else? Is he planning everything for what is coming in the future...or does he make it up as he goes?"
Ayame calmly watched Lilith continue to speak as both of their feet waded across the golden waters.
Her gaze was far as Ayame couldn't help but shake her head while looking at her friend.
She may be telling the truth regarding the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor, but she didn't see the fascination she showed just while speaking about that man.
So she tried to offer a solution as but on another Quintessential Fruit of Existence.
"You could always just ask him. Send your thoughts across your Lineage and he'll probably bring a Clone of his before you."
Lilith turned to stare at her as if she were crazy as she shook her head while rising from the golden pool.

"Why would I do something like that? What would I even say to him? We are currently at entirely different places. No...I'll do what I set off to do not too long ago. I'll seek for a seat of power that would distinguish me as a Ruler once more. For this...let's put our all into the coming tournament."
HUUM!
The eyes of the Daughter of Hatred burned with a glorious competitive light as Ayame smiled and nodded at her words.

"Yes, yes. Come on, The Healthcare Branch of Dr. Hall's Practice of Life now has Students capable of giving Existential Massages and Pedicures. Let's relax a little tonight before the business of tomorrow..."

Ayame pushed the Daughter of Hatred who was absorbed in her thoughts towards another location as these two beings, just like many millions and billions and trillions of others within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...lived their own lives.
Amidst all the wars.
Amidst all the conflict, upgrades, and elevation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
A wondrous culture and civilization continued to advance within it in different forms of entertainment, businesses, and rituals.
Dr. Hall's Practice of Life had multiple branches extending to different sides of medicine that many entities came under his banner to work on.

There were those who became fanatics of the Armaments that could be made within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as they lived within Forges, there were those taking the example of the True Emperor of Quintessence and were seeking the essence of cooking- many chefs rising to see how many different delicacies could be made from domesticated fantastical animal species made from breeds of Dragons or Phoenixes...and more!
All of this lay in the slightly deeper surfaces of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as truly, it was full of life.
Within it, hours passed.
And a tournament began!
OOOH!
Roars of excitement boomed out within a portion of the Aletheian Haven of Genesis.

A white gold sea stretched out all around as at its very center, two figures with raging influences of Greater Omniversal Authorities were clashing, and tens of thousands of miles all around, small white gold thrones by the millions surrounded the sea to form a massive arena!
On the millions of seats were some of the more prominent Entities within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

Around the circular white gold thrones forming the arena, there was a portion with even more regal thrones, and at its very center, a massive throne where the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor sat on could be seen!
He watched the ongoing Tournament as on a throne near him, the Sanctus Autarch looked at the battle before her while voicing out.
|I was going to ask why you would do this tournament when you should already have a gauge on who would win, but I see why now.|
She spoke with Autarchical Authority as Noah smiled at her words, nodding as he replied grandly.
"Yes, in the midst of apocalypses and wars, people have to have something to release their stress on. I'll make sure Dungeons and Tournaments become more mainstream..."
Apart from everything else occurring, Noah still had other plans for development among other things!

chapters.title: Chapter 3162 Exit and Entry! I
paragraphs: A white gold sea of an arena vibrated as combatants fought above it for supremacy, the vibrant figure of Little CaCuLaTan currently fighting against Bubbles- or formerly the one taking the identity of the Blue Slime!

An array of Entities fought within this tournament, ranging from those who had been with Noah the longest like Kazuhiko and the Emperor Penguin, to Weavings of old Records like Commander Feng, to the Primogenitor of Steel, all the way to weavings of Lumen like Piety.
Each one sought to make their mark as nearly all the powerful entities of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed participated!
Nearly all.
The Sanctus Autarch turned her head further to the side of Noah's throne as she squinted while asking the graceful figure of Sona.
"Why didn't you fight for such an opportunity?"
One of her many daughters.
She was exceptional in many ways, yes, but did she truly believe that she didn't need something that could advance one towards Autarchy?!
Sona blinked a few times as she shook her head towards the Sanctus Autarch while replying calmly.
"I don't need it."
She didn't need it.
She really said such words that stumped the Sanctus Autarch as in between them, Adelaide and Barbatos exchanged glances as if they knew something others didn't, while on his throne, Noah only smiled!
Far away from the ongoing tournament, within a portion of the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence stood before another body of Sona, his chest splitting open to release an icy gold blue heart tinged with tendrils of colorless light!
The heart that Sona had given away to him not too long ago.

Being with him during his advancements, especially the advent of the Atlas of Existence and subsequent entry as the Laborer of such a construct...this Omniversal Organ of Sona carried weavings of a Seed that were even more pristine than simple Autarchy!
|I was looking for anomalies to assemble into the Initiative this whole time when it seems I really should have stopped after finding you.|
Her eyes glowed with brilliance as she accepted the vastly altered Omniversal Organ that was much too different compared to when she gave it away.

With it, she could confidently say that her titles of a genius and Anomaly meant nothing if she couldn't assimilate it to arrive at Autarchy and even adopt the uniqueness that Noah was taking with him across his journey.
It sank into her chest as instantly, their surroundings turned freezing cold, glacial waves of authority surging all around as radiant Dignity filled with a colorless brilliance unfolded.
The heart of hers was no longer what it was before.
What it was now...
|The Existential Autarchical Dominium Seed...|
HUUM!
A Seed.
She didn't need the Seed of Existence from Noah to attain Autarchy because truly, he had given her a Heart in the form of another Seed that would undoubtedly sprout to something even grander!
BOOM!
From the depths of Sona's Existence, a colorless light began to explode and vibrate outwards.
Time passed.
The tournament lasted a whole day as many Entities gave their shot, glorious battles wading through the eyes of many as a myriad of concepts were displayed to the fullest.
Everyone strove for the title of champion, but it all shockingly came down to four beings!
The matches occurred simultaneously as it was Kazuhiko against the Emperor Penguin, and on another part of the Arena, Commander Feng was facing the relentless attacks of the Daughter of Hatred!
The Commander has stanchions of golden Pillars surrounding him and smashing toward the Daughter of Hatred strategically, his eyes glowing coldly as he spoke out.

|Your drive and emotions may be high, but that is not everything in existence. Just because you think you deserve something, does not mean it is yours to attain. Even when you imitated me before, you failed...|
His words would cast doubt in the heart of any common Entity.
But for one that had lived for millions of years.
For one that had endured, manipulated, and deceived...they were whispers of nothing!
HUUM!

The authority of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities stacked in between two massive demonic horns, crimson tendrils of an extremely pure authority guiding all of them as a sonorous will was carried along with it.
|You were a great man then, and you are a great man now. But when it comes to the drive between us...I truly don't know if that is anyone that could compare to my Hatred.|
Hatred.
It was such a pure concept that paired with the genuine emotion and core being of Lilith, the Greater Omniversal Authority of Hata boomed out at the forefront!
This Authority that was yet another Intersect amongst Omniversal Authorities was pulled out by her deep Hatred as it thundered down onto the figure of Commander Feng!

On the other part of the Arena, the combatants that had knocked out Piety and Tiamatherion were facing each other as their history traced truly far back into the Records of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor.
Kazuhiko, from Noah's home world.
The Emperor Penguin- the First Spiritual Beast of the Source of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

A storm of Obsidian Katanas swung forth constantly in a barrage of attacks that carried the influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority with each strike, while behind the illustrious Emperor Penguin, a massive golden axe glinting with pride was grasped in its flippers as it swung away everything coming forth.
|Who said my Axe could be blocked?!|
|Who decided that your defenses are impervious?!|
BOOM!

Katanas were being knocked down and shredded as the concept of Pride was pulled out to its utmost, the boon of the purity of their Lineage that these two beings had which allowed them to triumph over others being roughly the same between them as their battle was a tough one.
But eventually, a victor was decided.

In the other arena, the visage of a tantalizing Demon stretched her hand out towards a knocked-down Commander Feng; this Record filled with countless thoughts as it actually turned out to be its loss.

On the other battlefield, the dark-haired Kazuhiko grasped the flippers of the Emperor Penguin tainted with blood- this prideful beast letting out a harrumph as it let it be known that things were not over!
OOOOH!
The millions observing in the surroundings cheered as only two Entities were left in the Arena.
A dark-haired man holding a katana.
And a demoness that couldn't even believe she was there!

Katanas were being knocked down and shredded as the concept of Pride was pulled out to its utmost, the boon of the purity of their Lineage that these two beings had which allowed them to triumph over others being roughly the same between them as their battle was a tough one.
But eventually, a victor was decided.

In the other arena, the visage of a tantalizing Demon stretched her hand out towards a knocked-down Commander Feng; this Record filled with countless thoughts as it actually turned out to be its loss.

On the other battlefield, the dark-haired Kazuhiko grasped the flippers of the Emperor Penguin tainted with blood- this prideful beast letting out a harrumph as it let it be known that things were not over!
OOOOH!
The millions observing in the surroundings cheered as only two Entities were left in the Arena.
A dark-haired man holding a katana.
And a demoness that couldn't even believe she was there!

chapters.title: Chapter 3163 Exit and Entry! II
paragraphs: Atop a white gold sea.
Two figures stared at each other from a distance as a rising silence echoed out all around them.
The cold eyes of Piety who was knocked out a few rounds before burned with competitive spirit.
The shining eyes of the Cimmerian Architect who was knocked out by Commander Feng burned with intellect!
The Primogenitor of Steel was somber at not being able to advance after falling to someone who should be his junior in age and wisdom- the Emperor Penguin!

But within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, power was guaranteed by the purity of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor Lineage...and this was mainly affected by how close one was to Noah.
Power was guaranteed by the resources within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, and such resources were much freer in the hands of those closest to Noah!
Thus, even ancient entities and records of past weavings like Oppenheimer, Commander Feng, or the Primogenitor of Steel were knocked out in the rankings of power.
Following this mindset, the friend of the True Emperor of Quintessence who was with him since his homeworld was understandable to be where he was.
But Lilith?
She was not close to the True Emperor, nor was her purity in Lineage as pure as others!
So how did she reach here?
"You're thinking too much."
WAP!
The battle had already begun.
Kazuhiko divided into a thousand Clones shrouded in darkness as dozens of Clones instantly surrounded the Daughter of Hatred whose body exploded with nefarious crimson smoke soon after!
The battle fully unfolded under the eyes of all.
Weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities unfolded.
The Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halos of Lumen on both of them shone brightly in the first ten minutes before both shattered and became inactive.
Swords hummed.
Horns bloomed.
A certain Phoenix watched Kazuhiko with a calm gaze even though her fists were clenched.
The visage of Ayame watched the Daughter of Hatred as at a certain point, she rose from her seated throne and bellowed out in support!
Hatred went against pure skill and proximity to Noah as everyone saw the overwhelming potency of such an emotion, but at the end of the day...
SHIING!
A clear blade of an extremely sharp katana came to press against the neck of the Daughter of Hatred after a whole hour of exhaustion.
Her eyes shone vehemently with defiance, but the reality did not change nonetheless.
The rankings on the Banner of Quintessence shifted greatly today, with this tournament giving chances to many as the Queens of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed did not participate!
She thought...she thought!
|VICTOR!|
HUUM!
A booming feminine voice echoed out across the white gold sea.
|KAZUHIKO!|
The name echoed out across Planes of Existence and Havens, the skies splitting open to reveal an incandescent colorless green Seed of Existence that rained down over Kazuhiko's head.
Lilith rose up while gazing at this descending treasure with a gaze of yearning, but she ultimately turned away as this was not hers!
She was close to grasping something, but sadly, her Hatred was not enough.
She-
|VICTOR!|
The booming feminine voice ushered out again as the cheers that were about to begin halted.
In the skies above, a crimson colorless Seed of Existence erupted down and began its descent as...
|LILITH!|
WAA!
The Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor had defeated three Autarch Equivalent Existences himself.
His son and the Sanctus Autarch had defeated another two!

For this tournament, two Seeds of Existence came down as the visage of Lilith fell to her knees- tears streaming past her cheeks as she raised her hand towards the dazzling colorless crimson Seed of Existence!
It was a scene gazed at with scrutiny by many, where in the far distance- the visage of Guinevere, Lancelot, and many others connected to the Nine Dimensions shone brightly.
But the deed was done.
Two shining stars rose from the tournament within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, and from it, two new Autarchs were welcomed within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
The Autarch of Hatred, and the Autarch of the Sword!
Silently, a past Sanctus Princess also attained a realm similar to Autarchy.
This wasn't to mention the Son of Osmont whose power had reached unprecedented levels as the first produced Autarch within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
And all of this still left behind two Seeds of Existence obtained from the Commanders of the Faesinged and Satyrus Nymph Legions.
For the days to come, the changes that would continue were many- and the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor fully utilized these days to prepare!
The tide of time continued to flow as the days passed within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
Until...
|No succession of Omniversal Ankyras exists within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, and its lifeline has been sustained for as long as it could be absent any Ankyra.|
|The Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record has begun its descent into an endless slumber.|
Two prompts flashed before Noah's eyes as he held a shining Seed in his hands- the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, while he looked out to a crumbling Eonic Omniverse Record around him.
He was given days. And he truly utilized these days.
His Wings.
His Heart.
His Eyes.
His Lungs.
They were either elevated Omniversal Organs or entirely new ones, and this was in addition to the Atlas of Existence and its wonders that he had explored in the last days.
"It is time."
HUUM
A terrifying unseen authority vibrated around him as in an instant, his visage disappeared.
He made an exit from one place, and he was making an entry in another.
A Place that was frozen in an instant of a moment as in such a space, Imperium Legions and swarms of Devouring Worms waited!
But as Noah left the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
As things crumbled in the minutes that followed towards Oblivion.
HUUM!
The weavings of the entire Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record trembled as an utterly terrifying consciousness spread out across it.
A consciousness whose weavings seemed surprised initially as it held utterly unique power and standing of Existence!
|This...What did this?|
It seemed more like a question filled with curiosity.
But the intent ringing out alone caused what remained of the Eonic Omniverse Record to shatter and crumble right away!

chapters.title: Chapter 3164 The Worms of Existence! I
paragraphs: It was moments after Noah left.
As if even though the inde6scribably unique weavings of all Artificial Omniversal Ankyras were gone, his departure further allowed things to fall apart!
It was at this time that a terrifying will descended and swept out across the dying Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, this will only being able to catch a glimpse before everything collapsed.
|Interesting.|
A single other glorious blaze of their will.
And after that...
BOOM!
The Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record was no more!
An instant of time.
This was how long some supremely powerful beings could take a moment of time and expand it- with a True Emperor having done just this within a battlefield filled with chaotic entrants!
|Stay together!|
HUUM!
A bellow came out from Exarch Shavronne as her hair whipped around gloriously, the Legions of the Imperium lining up around her and the other Exarchs to minimize the damage as much as possible.
But at the same time, she already sent word out as she knew they needed stronger Exarchs here.
The Exarchs closely situated around the Imperium Autarch himself- Exarchs holding that same level of power!
She had to call for such forces as their enemies were just that powerful.
The enemies were just that tricky!
What she didn't like was the fact that the Entity connected to the unearthing of Lumen disappeared along with the forces of the Sanctus Populi.
Even though in the surroundings, massive Sentinels of Lumen continued to appear amidst incandescent white gold storms of flames that were greedily being taken in by the Devouring Worms.
Their Paracosms were immeasurably powerful, with the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium carrying with it something that other people may not even understand.
The Omniversal Authorities raging around them were abundant as many of them either held Codexes of Extremity in their hands or equipped on their bodies!
But even all of this...
SKEEE!
|Rubbish!|
Was being pushed back as even the Exarchs found themselves on the losing end against the Devouring Worms!
This couldn't be allowed to continue.
They-
WAP!
The thoughts of Exarch Shavronne came to a halt.
She wasn't the only one.
Other Exarchs.
Martial Empress Yelena.
Imperium Knights in all ranges of the Dominium Realm.
Even the buzzing figures of the winged Devouring Worms filled with piercing sickle-like limbs.
Everybody came to a stop as their gazes were pulled towards a single area.
An area where the one who was unearthing the weavings of Lumen had disappeared...this being reappeared after what seemed like the passage of a mere instant.
And yet...his mere presence felt magnetic.
Ecstatic.
Unfathomable!
It felt like the aura of an Entity far distinguished from them, and yet they couldn't sense even a strand of Existential Extremity Authority around him at this moment!
Adorned in white Emperor's Robes, his figure seemed like it had just stepped out of an eonic painting as he exuded a sense of profound beauty.
A Halo of brilliance spun above him as when one looked at him, there was another feature that caused their eyes to feel as if they were cut by a knife of time and Causality!
His Colorleess wings on his back and feet.
Feathered and wrapped in tendrils of colorless light, they caused one's eyes to flicker and feel like their very existence was being ground down!
What was most obscene of all was something that Exarch Shavronne and other Exarchs felt closely that caused their gazes to become immeasurably somber.
They felt their eyes forcefully be pushed down whenever they stared at this being.
As if his sheer glory...was too much for them.
As if after catching a glimpse...they couldn't continue to look on anymore!
If they went against their gazes being pushed down, their very existence began to tremble as if they were already in battle!
This...
This....!
The mouth of Exarch Shavronne opened wide in shock as she had only felt a similar sensation on one other being.
A being she respected with all her heart.
A being who was the reason she was currently where she was!
How could this Entity before her...emit such an aura as well?!
Especially after disappearing and reappearing in an instant?!
It was such a baffling sensation that she didn't even want to believe was possible, but the surprises didn't end there.
He seemed unfettered at all the gazes he alone pulled as next, space fluctuated around him as other auras that were nowhere near as terrifying appeared.
But they produced just as much shock as each of them was surrounded by a colorless brilliance!

Someone they knew of real well appeared to his right, surrounded by colorless radiance and seeming filled with wisdom- it was none other than the Sanctus Autarch who appeared here right before the Devouring Worms came.
But ridiculously, she was currently not the only being emitting the glorious aura of Autarchy.
Around the being whose glory was supposedly so heavy that it was hard to gaze at him for longer than a moment...
The visage of Sona appeared.
Icy blue and gold tendrils of light danced around her head as a colorless brilliance also surrounded her.
And the surprises only continued as figures they didn't even know of or see before appeared with the blazing aura of Autarchy!
A young man surrounded by golden hues of surging destiny, golden robes covering his figure as a sea of colorless light seethed beneath his feet.
A man holding two katanas bathed with colorless flames, his dark hair dancing wildly as he seemed filled with drive and excitement for just being here.

A woman with the enticing allure of a demoness with two colorless horns inscribed with crimson tattoos on her head, dazzling crimson wings erupting behind her as her blessed and curved figure already caused most weaker Entities to feel weak in their knees!
But there were more.
The first unearthing of Lumen.
The Last Guardian of Lumen appeared, its white gold brilliance being so potent that it rivaled that of an Autarch.
And then, there was one more blazing aura of colorless grandeur that represented the last Entity to devour a remaining Seed of Existence.

This Entity attained this opportunity for no other reason other than shooting a shot- going before the True Emperor of Quintessence and asking if he had any other remaining Seeds of Existence hidden away that he could take!
Purely because of this.
Noah had laughed and changed his plans as the last Seed of Existence was given to none other than the Young Master Erikson.

Adorned in white and blue beach wear, his toned muscles and tanned skin shone with a colorless radiance as in his hands, two slippers burning with colorless flames seemed ready to strike out at any moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 3165 The Worms of Existence! II
paragraphs: It was a dazzling line up!
And wondrously, every single one radiated an aura of Autarchy aside from the central figure that many couldn't even gaze at for too long.
The Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor, followed by the Sanctus Autarch, Henry, Sona, Kazuhiko, Lilith, Piety, and Erikson!
A total of eight Entities estimated to be at the level of an Autarch appeared as the Exarchs of the Imperium wondered whether the current reality was an illusion first.
But their auras were irrefutable.
And they weren't the only ones who saw them and reacted as in the next moment.
WUU! WUU! WUU!
The wails of the terrifying obsidian Worms boomed out as their bodies were visibly vibrating.
Vibrating with an unimaginable and intense fervor!
These Entities were extremely mysterious as even their thoughts could not be easily discerned, and yet at this moment, all those here could definitively say that they sensed from them...excitement.
Their very bodies seemed to buzz with excitement as the thousands of Devouring Worms here...all turned their unfathomable intent toward a single location.
Towards the entity that had appeared first and was currently surrounded by multiple Autarchs.
They all seemed irresistibly pulled towards Noah's visage as like a swarming tide, they charged towards him while ignoring everything else!
|Oh boy...|
The large figure of Erikson whistled as he raised the flippers in his hands, his bare feet glinting with purple brilliance as he swung the slippers forth.
|The probability of you all reaching him...is infinitely close to zero!|
HUUM!
The slipper bloomed and expanded- covered by an austere colorless authority that sought to achieve its aims!
He wasn't the only one to move.
Stanchions of colorless golden light bloomed around Henry and barreled out like celestial Pillars of light while the Daughter of Hatred brought her hands to her chest as if she were praying.
And far above, a crimson rift tore as a massive illusory image of a demonic entity bloomed.
Stanchions of colorless golden light bloomed around Henry and barreled out like celestial Pillars of light while the Daughter of Hatred brought her hands to her chest as if she were praying.
And far above, a crimson rift tore as a massive illusory image of a demonic entity bloomed.
81 hands bloomed on it as its horns bloomed with colorless majesty, his face showing utmost fury and Hatred as wondrously...this image was of none other than Hatred himself.
From the memories of Lilith.
From the weavings of her Father.
An illusory construct formed above as a disastrous flood of authority gushed out towards the incoming tide of Devouring Worms!
The Sanctus Autarch, Kazuhiko, Piety, and Sona also moved as everything accumulated into an array of colorless brilliance that sought to block off every single Devouring Worm coming for Noah!
The impact was deafening.
BOOOM!
It felt like Existence itself was being smashed into and ground into a paste.
The attacks of the Autarchs were powerful, causing the swarm of thousands of Devouring Worms to actually be halted- but this was all.

Their advancement could ultimately not be hindered as in the face of these terrifying Autarchical Authorities, various parts of their bodies opened jaws shimmering with endless abyss as they devoured the surrounding authority- the blockage gradually being weakened while these Worms themselves...did not receive any viable observable injuries!
It was a terrifying reality as the center of the swarm faced a more concentrated attack, cracks forming on the massive illusory slipper of Erikson until it was punctured through!
An obsidian Devouring Worm rushed out from there to continue its advance toward the being that caused its whole body to tremble with excitement.
It had to devour him.
It had to!
Every part of what made it screamed out such a thought as deep within it, this need had long since been passed back towards the Source Worm.
Its sight held nothing else but Noah as compared to all others; he seemed like a radiant singularity of a panacea that others could not even compare.
His existence...Oh, his existence!
WUUU!
The wails of the Devouring Worms only became more pronounced as at this moment, the foremost one was captured closely in the eyes of Noah.
He saw it.
He analyzed it.
And he felt his Atlas of Existence churn.
|A new type of Existence has been discovered by the Atlas of Existence.|
|Much of the weavings about it are veiled as at this moment, this Existence is termed Helminth Ormra.|
The Mundis of Power within his Atlas of Existence buzzed and began to circle as his eyes shone brightly.

It was for no other reason other than the fact that at this time, a sufficiently different and complex Existence with a different System of Existence apart from what Noah already held...had appeared before him.

Within his First Mundi of Power that was further enhanced by the recent inclusion of the Systems of Existence of the Satyrus Nymph and the Faesinged Queen, the unfathomable authority of the Laborer was pulled upon by Noah as he wrapped it around his fist at this moment.
And from his floating position...the wings on his feet flapped lightly.
It instantly caused his figure to appear in front of the foremost Devouring Worm as directly on its obsidian carapace...Noah struck forth with his fist!
It felt like time had come to a stop.
Because for the first time since the advent of these terrifying creatures...
BZZT...CRACK!
The eyes of all beings nearly bulged out of their sockets as they saw the impenetrable carapace of a Devouring Worm actually shatter.
Shatter!
The fist of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor even went further to sink into its body as from it, a viscous obsidian cloud erupted out!
For the first time, a Devouring Worm was pushed back as if their eyes didn't deceive them...was it actually injured?

This question didn't just occur in the minds of the Imperium Exarchs and Autarchs behind Noah, but it also seemed to be buzzing within the Devouring Worm whose carapace was shattered...and even those behind it.

The sharp limbs and broken carapace of the injured Devouring Worm turned around to stare at those behind it, the viscous smoke leaking from it pulsing as its action held an intent that seemed to express to others a single sentence.
|Are you all fucking seeing this?|
It was that unbelievable!

sentences.text: It was a dazzling line up!
And wondrously, every single one radiated an aura of Autarchy aside from the central figure that many couldn't even gaze at for too long.
The Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor, followed by the Sanctus Autarch, Henry, Sona, Kazuhiko, Lilith, Piety, and Erikson!
A total of eight Entities estimated to be at the level of an Autarch appeared as the Exarchs of the Imperium wondered whether the current reality was an illusion first.
But their auras were irrefutable.
And they weren't the only ones who saw them and reacted as in the next moment.
WUU!
WUU!
WUU!
The wails of the terrifying obsidian Worms boomed out as their bodies were visibly vibrating.
Vibrating with an unimaginable and intense fervor!
These Entities were extremely mysterious as even their thoughts could not be easily discerned, and yet at this moment, all those here could definitively say that they sensed from them...excitement.
Their very bodies seemed to buzz with excitement as the thousands of Devouring Worms here...all turned their unfathomable intent toward a single location.
Towards the entity that had appeared first and was currently surrounded by multiple Autarchs.
They all seemed irresistibly pulled towards Noah's visage as like a swarming tide, they charged towards him while ignoring everything else!
|Oh boy...|
The large figure of Erikson whistled as he raised the flippers in his hands, his bare feet glinting with purple brilliance as he swung the slippers forth.
|The probability of you all reaching him...is infinitely close to zero!|
HUUM!
The slipper bloomed and expanded- covered by an austere colorless authority that sought to achieve its aims!
He wasn't the only one to move.
Stanchions of colorless golden light bloomed around Henry and barreled out like celestial Pillars of light while the Daughter of Hatred brought her hands to her chest as if she were praying.
And far above, a crimson rift tore as a massive illusory image of a demonic entity bloomed.
Stanchions of colorless golden light bloomed around Henry and barreled out like celestial Pillars of light while the Daughter of Hatred brought her hands to her chest as if she were praying.
And far above, a crimson rift tore as a massive illusory image of a demonic entity bloomed.
81 hands bloomed on it as its horns bloomed with colorless majesty, his face showing utmost fury and Hatred as wondrously...this image was of none other than Hatred himself.
From the memories of Lilith.
From the weavings of her Father.
An illusory construct formed above as a disastrous flood of authority gushed out towards the incoming tide of Devouring Worms!
The Sanctus Autarch, Kazuhiko, Piety, and Sona also moved as everything accumulated into an array of colorless brilliance that sought to block off every single Devouring Worm coming for Noah!
The impact was deafening.
BOOOM!
It felt like Existence itself was being smashed into and ground into a paste.
The attacks of the Autarchs were powerful, causing the swarm of thousands of Devouring Worms to actually be halted- but this was all.

Their advancement could ultimately not be hindered as in the face of these terrifying Autarchical Authorities, various parts of their bodies opened jaws shimmering with endless abyss as they devoured the surrounding authority- the blockage gradually being weakened while these Worms themselves...did not receive any viable observable injuries!
It was a terrifying reality as the center of the swarm faced a more concentrated attack, cracks forming on the massive illusory slipper of Erikson until it was punctured through!
An obsidian Devouring Worm rushed out from there to continue its advance toward the being that caused its whole body to tremble with excitement.
It had to devour him.
It had to!
Every part of what made it screamed out such a thought as deep within it, this need had long since been passed back towards the Source Worm.
Its sight held nothing else but Noah as compared to all others; he seemed like a radiant singularity of a panacea that others could not even compare.
His existence...Oh, his existence!
WUUU!
The wails of the Devouring Worms only became more pronounced as at this moment, the foremost one was captured closely in the eyes of Noah.
He saw it.
He analyzed it.
And he felt his Atlas of Existence churn.
|A new type of Existence has been discovered by the Atlas of Existence.|
|Much of the weavings about it are veiled as at this moment, this Existence is termed Helminth Ormra.|
The Mundis of Power within his Atlas of Existence buzzed and began to circle as his eyes shone brightly.

It was for no other reason other than the fact that at this time, a sufficiently different and complex Existence with a different System of Existence apart from what Noah already held...had appeared before him.

Within his First Mundi of Power that was further enhanced by the recent inclusion of the Systems of Existence of the Satyrus Nymph and the Faesinged Queen, the unfathomable authority of the Laborer was pulled upon by Noah as he wrapped it around his fist at this moment.
And from his floating position...the wings on his feet flapped lightly.
It instantly caused his figure to appear in front of the foremost Devouring Worm as directly on its obsidian carapace...Noah struck forth with his fist!
It felt like time had come to a stop.
Because for the first time since the advent of these terrifying creatures...
BZZT...CRACK!

Shatter!

chapters.title: Chapter 3166 The Worms of Existence! III
paragraphs: Unreal.
This was the reality that many entities were privy to at this moment as behind Noah, the figure of the Sanctus Autarch was extremely stern while watching the figure of Noah do what he just did!

This was because she had fought against and ran from these very same Devouring Worms as her Authority would not be capable of damaging them, and it would instead be devoured over time as she could kill any of these terrifying enemies.
The man before her had been looking for an answer since not too long ago.
On how to fight against things that their own power was ineffective against.
Even during the scenes they were shown while fused together, some only showed the collision between him and a massive Devouring Worm.
None had shown him damaging them!
But...had his answer truly been grasped by the terrifying Atlas of Existence that she only got a faint branding of on her own Existence?
The Sanctus Autarch touched her chest subconsciously while at the same time, she began to leave behind everything she knew while focusing on the branding of the Atlas of Existence within her!

Ahead of her, the swarm of Devouring Worms actually came to a stop after one of them was injured, and as if the whole dynamic had changed- these forefront one right before Noah moved back and became surrounded by dozens of others just like it.
The colorless Autarchical Authority released in the surroundings gradually became devoured and absorbed as the whole atmosphere was rapidly changing.
At such a time...
WAP!
Behind the Imperium Legions.
Space distorted as one terrifying aura after another rose- each one blazing with colorless brilliance as a total of Four Auras of Autarchs bloomed!
The core power of the Imperium who answered directly to the Imperium Autarch!
It was two men and two women adorned in golden Armaments that crackled with colorless inscriptions- multiple colorless Codexes of Extremity surrounding them.

The first one to arrive was a golden-haired man that Exarch Shavronne warped beside and bowed respectfully, a bundle of authority flowing from her to him as he was briefed on everything that had occurred so far!
He smiled coldly while looking at the foreboding enrichment of Devouring Worms and the figures of Noah and his people.

|Well now, it seems like all pertinent forces barring a few have gathered here...though these circumstances are truly, truly unfavorable. Do you all know what you have unleashed upon our peaceful Omniverse?|

As he spoke, a blinding golden light erupted from him and covered the many remaining Imperium Legions here- each of them being warped away rapidly to the extent that only the Exarchs and these four radiant beings would remain.
The man with pristine golden hair continued to speak while gazing coldly at the swarm of silent Devouring Worms- his eyes coming to lock onto Noah.
|Lumen was akin to a beacon of light for them as we did everything to snuff it out. But you....you had to go and dig it up, didn't you, young friend?|
These words were directed to Noah.
But great care and caution were being given to the Devouring Worms, whose behavior continued to be something out of the norm.
Noah continued studying the swarm of Devouring Worms ahead of him while he spoke without even gazing at the entrants of Autarchical Imperium Exarchs!
|I'm not the one that drew them here, old friend. You'll have to find a different scapegoat for that.|
He was gathering more information.
He confirmed that even while being near and even in contact with the Helminth Ormra, the Devouring Worm, none of his Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence was capable of being devoured!
It meant the unfolding reality was continuing to tip in the favor of the Protagonist as what he was doing was working.
But it still wasn't enough.
As of now, he was the only one who could even oppose their Existence!
|Lumen is the beacon that draws in these enemies. The least you can do is take responsibility, and we will leave you to do just that.|

The voice of the Autarchical Imperium Exarch echoed out as his body flashed again- the cold faces of Exarch Shavronne and others also beginning to disappear as the new entrants moved decisively to take away all of their forces here.

They seemed to understand the terror of the Devouring Worms as seeing them make a swift exit- Noah was preparing to do something similar as he prepared to enhance his Atlas of Existence to the extent that he could erase these Devouring Worms as he wished!
As for the reason why the Autarchical Imperium Exarchs and even Noah had the thought of leaving this place...
It was the same as the image that Noah had seen with the glimpse of Invictus Maximus.
WUUUU!
A heavy and piercing wail echoed out from the Devouring Worms that had grouped up this whole time.

In the surroundings, more swarms suddenly bloomed on all sides as swiftly, Noah waved his hands and caused the figures of Henry and other Autarchs from the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed to disappear!
He affirmed that the Devouring Worms could at least be hurt.
He didn't need to risk everything else now as he had to prepare to finish them!
WUUU!
The wails came out again as with their cold gazes remaining the same, only the Four Autarchical Imperium Exarchs remained as even their bodies were flickering with a unique spatial radiance.
|They will soon cover the ends of the Omniverse. If you wish to at least take responsibility, you know where the above of the glorious Imperium Autarch is.|
BOOM!
With the end of these words, their figures exploded out of existence while scattering the weavings and flow of reality here.
They didn't want to stay as far above, the massive outline of a Devouring Worm bigger than any others had begun to appear!
The Source Worm.
The one to truly be feared even more than any others.

In the surroundings, the Sentinels of Lumen stopped generating as every ounce of Authority was being sucked away, Noah's lone figure looking at all of this as before the full descent of the terrifying Source Worm, he gathered the rest of the weavings of Existence here before his figure also disappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 3167 The Worms of Existence! IV
paragraphs: The Devouring Worms were a force to be feared.
The forces of the Imperium knew this very well as they did not stay behind after pulling their people out.

Towards the complex swarms of Devouring Worms and even the hazy outline of an even more massive one...nearly all forces were gone in a short period of time as nobody seemed entirely ready to face them yet!
Within the Natal Omniverse that Noah knew as home.
In the vastness of the Source of the Imperium.
In a location veiled by layers of space and time, and even the weavings of the Autarchical Omniversal Authority of Aitiologia.
There was a small point of a pure gold singularity that very few held access to.
Within this space.

The auras of powerful Entities buzzing with multicolored radiance could be seen, each one shockingly radiating the aura of Paracosm as all of them without fail...were kneeling down with their knees on a clear gold sea.
The sea was seemingly endless, stretching out into a golden horizon.
Among those on their knees, the figures of Exarch Shavronne and Maligaro could be seen accompanied by other Exarchs in neat rows.

In the next moment, these rows were completed by the arrival of four Entities radiating a colorless brilliance- these Entities also came to kneel at the very front as 5 others were radiating a similar aura!
9 Autarchs.
Behind them, rows of Paracosm Exarchs.
They added up to 81 to make the Pillars of the Imperium as at this moment, they were all gathered and kneeling towards a single direction.
When one looks over here, though, one may see entirely different scenes.
To the common eye on the eyes of the Paracosm Exarchs like Shavronne, they could see absolutely nothing in front of them.
To the eyes of the 9 Autarchs, the outline of an utterly regal being could be seen!
An Entity whose sheer existence was so high that one had to be an Autarch just to be capable of seeing him.
"Naka, the one you referred to as a Young Friend is someone I cannot fully see the weavings or the future of."
His words caused Autarchical Imperium Exarch Naka to kneel down even further as he spoke out sternly.
|If I said anything out of line, I seel your punishment, O Imperium.|
HUUM!
In his face and in his heart, there was only profound reverence and respect as his words held utmost truth!
Yet the figure that only Autarchs could see smiled while waving his hands dismissively.
Of course, they were talking about the way Naka had referred to Noah earlier- everything that had played out before their eyes being something this Entity saw!
|The Lumen Emperor is also someone I couldn't see the weavings of, so it makes sense if his successor is the same way.|
As he spoke about the Lumen Emperor, his face changed to become reflective as he gazed out towards the endless expanse of gold all around them.
His hair flowed gold all the way to his shoulders, his figure slender like a scholar as he was adorned in pure white robes.
His face was one of extreme honor and beauty as he spoke with reminiscence.
"All those years back then after I knew of the terror chasing the Lumen Emperor, I undertook heavy actions to prevent it. For the sake of all living beings. For the sake of the Omniverse, I..."
Golden tears shockingly began to stream on his face.
He looked out onto the golden expanse as he continued while his tears flowed!

"For the sake of the Omniverse, I eradicated countless lives of Lumen. Entire families and clans. I wiped them all out as it was all for a single purpose- to prevent these Worms of Existence from ever finding this Omniverse. And now...all of that death was for naught."
WAA!
Genuine pain seemed to curse through him as he spoke of what he had done!

"All of them have now effectively died for nothing. This reality...burdens me greatly. And now, these unshakable enemies are here. I have been preparing you all as a contingency in case this day ever came...and you all are not yet ready."
|Forgive us, O Imperium!|
All Nine kneeling Autarchs bent even deeper as they felt genuine anger at their own uselessness!
Yet the man only they could see smiled as he spoke with grandiosity.

"No matter, we will get you all ready. The advent of this Noah Osmont, this new Lumen Emperor...is welcome news as it means the old Lumen Emperor didn't die for nothing. He will be like a beacon of light attracting them as this will give us time. And this time...I will use it to ensure that at least you 81 will gain the full capability to go against these Worms of Existence. Otherwise, what I sought to protect all those years ago and what we seek to protect now...will be lost to the weavings of endless nonexistence."
A brilliant golden light flourished.
The Paracosm Exarchs could not see or hear anything, but a shocking intent was transferred across their Lineage as they understood!
"It will be grueling, and since we are accelerating things, it will come at the cost of your own Existences. Are you all willing?"
He was telling supremely powerful existences that they would gain the strength to defeat their enemies in exchange for mortal injuries to their very own Existences!
And yet the Exarchs before him...
|For the Imperium!|
|For the Omniverse!|
HO! HO! HO!
They fearlessly agreed to move forward.
After all, they had to protect what was theirs no matter the cost.
The scholarly-looking man in robes nodded with seriousness as, with his hands behind his back, he gazed out into the vast halcyon horizon once more.
"And I will have to converse with this new Lumen Emperor. For a moment there, I nearly believed he was yet another Outsider delving into our Omniverse."
He nearly believed so!
After all, an Entity nobody had even heard of erupting to the upper echelons of power and status in mere days?
To stand toe to toe with the Sanctus Autarch and even have her seemingly move at his beck and call?
"And for that Eonic Uttera, a true Outsider, to want to talk with you from the weavings of Pompeii...what did he see?"
His gaze could see many things.
As the favored child of the Omniverse, the Greater Omniversal Authorities and Autarchical Omniversal Authorities told him many things!
Even though the Existence of this Entity itself was currently shrouded, his gaze was still deep.

The image of the devilishly handsome man with pairs of colorless wings flashed within his mind again and again as behind him, a formless authority leaked out and wrapped around the 81 Pillars of the Imperium, seeping into the depths of their Existence as something began to be altered!
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: Traverse into the Atlas! I & II

chapters.title: Chapter 3168 Traverse into the Atlas! I
paragraphs: The space distorted with layers upon layers of Existence, the gaze being pulled from the golden brilliance of the Imperium and back to the area that all forces had quickly made an exit from.
In this space, swarms of obsidian Worms floated calmly as their bodies seemed to be oscillating up and down- almost as if they were undergoing a ritual.
This whole time since their entry into this Omniverse, they had always moved and moved with great speed seeking anything and everything.
And yet today, they remained in this place calmly- oscillating with purpose.
Far above, the outline of the massive Source Worm as it floated in front of the Worm whose carapace was shattered.
Black smoke filled the surroundings of this injury as it did not heal.
HUUM!

Waves of vibrations and oscillations were traveling between the massive Source Worm and the one whose carapace was shattered; the obsidian segmented body of the Source Worm currently showed black feelers that were weaving around this space as every single weaving was captured.
They had been searching for a long time.
What they sought for the most was something potent in its existence, but not at all vibrant in its lethality.
Those that fit this category were few and far in between as at this time, they had come across an Existence that could injure them.
But...it was not yet a lethal one.
Their task was to devour it before this lethality increased- and before anything else ruined their playing field.
WUU!

The Source Worm let out a commanding wail as the injured obsidian worm before it floated forward- the segmented body of the Source Worm opening to reveal an endless abysmal expanse that the injured Worm was pulled into before this endless abyss closed!
CRUNCH!
Heavy sounds echoed out while the bodies of all Devouring Worms here continued to oscillate.
In the weavings of the Source Worm, an image gradually became clear.
An image of a man with colorless wings.

An image of tendrils of authority that covered his fist- authority that caused a heavy attractive sensation on the Source Worm while at the same time reminding it that its extensions could not heal once injured by this authority.
The target of its obsession within this Omniverse had revealed itself.
It was...

A heavy and guttural intent weaved out as it caused the surrounding space to twist and distort, the way it came out being enough to cause the existence of a common being to collapse by hearing this intent alone!
There was always a question of confidence in whether any leader knew what he was doing.
For Noah, his mindset was that he just had to make the right decisions 99% of the time, and everything would be alright.
From being able to discern what the weavings of the future may be, all the way to being able to analyze the current unfolding Existence.
Analyze.
When he thought of this, he stopped in his tracks and looked for certain prompts among fields of prompts that had constantly been bombarding him.

At this moment, his consciousness was being expressed through his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence inside the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that was actually being carried as something smaller than a grain of sand by his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist outside.

He was standing on an earth filled with golden grass and shimmering clouds of Dreams, the surroundings showing rising golden sand dunes in the distance and a stellar sky above that showed hanging golden sandy suns.
It was somewhere in the weavings of the Aletheian Dream Haven as he wasn't alone, the figures of all of those that had achieved Autarchy situated in front of him.
They were all waiting for him as he had stopped in his tracks to look for certain prompts relating to the analysis of Existence, his Will locating them quickly as they were magnified before him.
|The Analysis of the Weavings of the Sunwinged Leprachanus are at 77%, its illusory weaving not yet available for construction and usage.|
|The Analysis of the Weavings of the Faesinged Queen are at 65%, its illusory weaving not yet available for construction and usage.|
|The Analysis of the Weavings of the Satyrus Nymph are at 63%, its illusory weaving not yet available for construction and usage.|
He smiled at the prompts that continued to rise in percentage as there were a few things in life he never got tired of.
The ridiculous reality of being able to analyze the weavings of his killed enemies and be able to bring them back as illusory weavings for him to command was one of them!
But the weavings of an Autarch were much more complex as even within the expanded time of the now gone Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, the percentage had only reached where it was until this point.
There was still more to go.

Noah cleared his thoughts as he came to look at the beings who had attained Autarchy- the beings who may be of help to him and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed in the times to come as he spoke out.
"You've seen the Devouring Worms for yourselves. You've seen how your authority reacts against them. What is your analysis?"
His question was a light one that he spoke out freely, but to the Autarchs before him- it felt like a weighted hammer that nobody wanted to carry the weight of!
The Sanctus Autarch. Henry. Sona, Kazuhiko, Lilith, Piety, Erikson.
All of them seemed to ruminate on this question as it was his son who raised his head and replied to him in a straightforward manner.

"We could hold them at bay for a long time, but our Authorities cannot cross whatever barrier of Existence or Anti-Existence that they have. They'll devour our Authorities over this time as if we cannot escape without scattering traces of our Existence to lose them- we would likely die one by one over time."
His words were calm, and his assessment was a deadly one!
But it was the truth all of them knew as a sense of frustration bubbled within the depths of their Existence.
In his blue beach attire, Erikson picked his ears as he spoke.

"As frustrating as it is for your Extreme to not do its intended purpose simply because of the contrasting difference in a Source of Existence, there is likely a way past it. Is it possible for us to grasp it too? What you were able to do against them that allowed your authority to injure them?"
They were frustrated, yes. But they knew the man in front of them was only there as a friend and helper as he asked them what he did in order to guide them.

All eyes rose up and locked on Noah after such words as he smiled and waved his hands, Nine circles of light manifesting and beginning to spin in front of him as his figure emanated undeniable waves of ancientness and wonder.
Yes.
There was an answer.
And it lay within the Atlas of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3169 Traverse into the Atlas! II
paragraphs: "The Atlas of Existence."
His eyes were magnetic as he said this.
Nobody could take their eyes off of him, least of all Lilith who was still half in shock in the past few days.

Her figure was robed in a crimson demoness attire as her eyes were seeing everything occurring in front of her, but if one could see through them- they would see a shining crimson light that connected to another body of her in a vastly different location.
On top of a large bed filled with crimson gold pillows, another body of Lilith was in front of Ayame who used her finger to knock on Lilith's head lightly as she asked.
"Come on, continue. What's going on now?"
She was curious about everything that was going on as Lilith's Clone refocused while speaking to her sternly.
"The way for us to beat any Entities, even those who are of different Sources of Existence. Something called the Atlas of Existence..."
She was relaying some of her experiences to her friend as she needed someone to make sure she was sane while experiencing this crazy new reality!
Ayame nodded with visible excitement as the glow of Infinity pulsed in her eyes, her red lips opening with a sense of longing at something she knew she may never get close to.
"The Atlas of Existence..."

Her words overlapped with the weavings that Lilith was hearing as her attention fully got back into the field of sandy dreamy golden light where she was surrounded by other Autarchs and the man responsible for bringing them all here.
He indicated to the spinning circles of brilliance while his magnetic voice continued.

"Any single being has a Source of Existence. A System of Existence that their very being follows. For us, we have a Conceptual System of Existence bound by specific ideas. Natural Laws. Extremes. Omniversal Authorities. All are concepts coming together to present an extremely stable whole. From the little that I've managed to discover by comparing other Systems of Existence- ours is an extremely stable one that many forces share."
Many forces.
These words seemed to have captured and caught by all of them here as the Son of Osmont interjected.
"Forces?"
Which forces? Was he mentioning different Existences entirely from other Omniverses? That many were like them who utilized a Conceptual System of Existence?
Noah nodded at his interjection with a smile.

"Yes, we'll get to that. But the issue that arises next is that some Systems of Existence are inherently favorable or unfavorable against others. It is no indication of being weaker or stronger- but just that the type of Existence can be so different and incompatible that every ounce and power of one Source of Existence may not be able to do anything to another Source of Existence. This...is the case with the Devouring Worms. The Conceptual System of Existence is extremely mispaired against them."
As he spoke, the Nine circles in front of him expanded and formed into large portal-like constructs that rotated around him.

"And yet uniquely, to them, concepts are akin to a tonic that makes them even stronger. This is simply how their Existence, or to us, Anti-Existence, is. Simply put, we were unlucky to come across them. Now, if we seek to go against them...we have to change the dynamic and add things to ourselves that would erase this unfavorable relationship. Something like having a different Source of Existence, or adding the weavings of another Source of Existence to your current one."
The words caused their existence to buzz as they knew such a thing bordered on the lines of impossibility.
And yet...
"You've done it. With this Atlas of Existence."
The voice of Sona echoed out as Noah turned towards her and nodded- pointing to the Nine dazzling circles as, at this time, a single one showed its brightness.

"For now. In its initial stages, it has allowed me to change my Existence enough to now be capable of even damaging the Devouring Worms as against them, my authority is no longer nullified to nothingness. But...to get you all on the same stage is another impossibility. I got where I am because I already was not following the pathways of the Dominium Realm. Unless you all break your current weavings of Existence and start over, and even be lucky enough with the same opportunities I had...forging anything similar to the Atlas of Existence is another impossibility."
They couldn't do it themselves.
But if Noah was telling them they couldn't do so, it meant he saw a way of utilizing his own as if they couldn't construct it...they could be connected to his.
The only thing was that if he was explaining all of this, it meant that such a thing would never be so simple.
So they all looked up at him and waited for what they had to do.
They would follow whatever he told them to do!
Noah saw such an intent within all eyes gazing at him as he sighed.
The Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence was profound, but it couldn't just be shared or passed down simply like nothing.
He had tried to integrate it into his Lineage in the last days to no success as even his son, who carried the purest Lineage, could not access it.
No. The Authority of the Laborer was too pristine. Too sentient. For its authority to be utilized by any others apart from him, they had to be accepted and authorized by the Atlas of Existence.

For this, they had to prove their existence and gain the recognition of the Atlas of Existence- only then could they gain access to the Authority of the Laborer and stand a chance against other Sources of Existence!
"Prove your Existence to the Atlas, and you will stand to gain its recognition. One of you has it easy as such recognition is already branded and simply waiting to be unlocked."

Noah looked towards the Sanctus Empress whose mouth was open wide as she finally realized the distinction of the branded Nine circles of the Atlas of Existence that came as a result of her being fused to Noah during its conception!
Sona gazed at the Sanctus Autarch as a competitive light bloomed within her, her icy eyes radiating splendor as she spoke out.
"So we gain recognition of the Atlas of Existence, and then we can clear out the Devouring Worms."
She asked a critical question to gain affirmation for what they were doing.
She wanted to hear that after they did this, this threat could be taken care of!
But...was it ever so simple?
Her eyes flashed as she didn't hear Noah's confident reply right away.
He was smiling, but she could see the trace of seriousness within his eyes as he shook his head.
Immense silence descended.

Surrounded by the manifestations of the Nine Mundis of Power, Noah sighed as he peered deeply into the First Mundi while recalling all the memories he was unearthing from the analysis of the Sources of Existence of the Sunwinged Leprachanus, Faesinged Queen, and the Satyrus Nymph!
He thought about all of it before he spoke with a heavy tone.

"The Devouring Worms are a serious issue, yes. But...it is something else that is going to come along with their entry that will make things very hard. The ones who put the Faesinged Queen and other Artificial Omniversal Ankyras within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record we just left. The ones who caught traces and will make it infinitely hard to enter similar Eonic Omniverse Records without being caught. The ones whom all my weavings are currently telling me...will inevitably be making an entry into our Omniverse."
Heavy words echoed out.
With the Atlas of Existence, the things that Noah could see were expanded greatly.
This allowed him to prepare for what was to come, but the weavings of the future that he was seeing...were maddeningly drastic ones as there was a lot to do to prepare!
