chapters.title: Chapter 3170 Traverse into the Atlas! III
paragraphs: His words caused a sense of suffocation to spread out.
Only colorless authority flashed around their bodies in the golden sandy Domain, but even with all of its power and mystery, it seemed to carry hesitation.
The Devouring Worms that could nullify their Conceptual System of Existence had just now become one of the many issues plaguing them?
They all remained silent as Noah shifted his gaze between them.
A smile was on his face to portray his calmness still. To still show them that things were okay, but even they could feel the tension held in his words.
Just what had he seen? What did the memories of the Autarchs he had decimated show?

First, he affirmed that entering another Eonic Omniverse Record would very well lead to terrifying gazes pushed toward their direction after the destruction of Var-El, and he had to find a way to bypass this before he did it again!
This was only part of the intricate future that had risen as Noah sighed while turning to gaze up at the backdrop of sandy gold suns.
"Just...what exactly is coming?"
Amidst the silence, Sona wanted everything to be made clear as she asked.
With his hands behind his back, Noah opened his mouth to reply, and his words came out as if they were a grand prophecy.

"They will call themselves Protectors of Existence. They will not simply discover this Omniverse, but will become heavily invested in it as after they find it, it will no longer just be an Omniverse existing in its own weavings of rules and ideas."
WAA!

"Once they do arrive, the Devouring Worms will be less of an issue as, truly, these beings do the job just like their Distinctions, as Protectors of Existence say, but I still told you all that you would need the Atlas in order to be capable of fighting against those of different Sources of Existence. These coming Entities...many will have different Sources of Existence."
The Conceptual System of Existence was widespread as many would retain something like this.
But another majority held entirely different Systems of Existence as this posed a great issue!
Noah had seen glimpses of it.
As he stared out onto the blank openness, he continued.

"You may ask yourselves that even with all of this, what would make them enemies? And the very clear answer is that these Existences- these Protectors have a singularity main task. And that task is to ensure the purity of Sources of Existence. To ensure that a single Source of Existence does not seek or is ever successful is incorporating another System of Existence- that everything remains how it was born."
His words were akin to a booming hammer that shook the Autarchs before him, his son stroking his chin as he replied grimly!
"So the Atlas of Existence is something they would seek to destroy if ever they find it."
The critical point was laid out as Noah brought his gaze down and nodded.
Silence resumed once more before the visage of Kazuhiko raised his head with determination and spoke with clenched fists.
"How much time do we have?"
Time.
Something that everybody seemed to be running out of as there could never be too much of it.

Noah thought about such a question while the manifestations of the Nine Mundis of Power lined up behind him- the only one that was filled with brilliance coming to anchor itself beside him and radiating a heavy light as he replied.
"Could be a day, could be a few days. When they do come, things will get moving very quickly as we should be ready as best as we can."
It was a short period of time.

But Noah prepared them for what was to come as he beckoned towards the glowing portal to his right- intent on starting the process that would grant his people recognition to gain access to the Authority of the Laborer!
Henry was the first to rise and appear before Noah as between them, a prompt rose that everyone could see.
|The Incursion of the Atlas of Existence has opened.|

|Entrants who delve into the incursion and successfully prove the complexity of their Existence will be branded with the Atlas of Existence and granted the distinction of Wayfarer of the Atlas of Existence.|
They knew what was at stake.
They saw the indeterminate amount of time they held!
So without wasting any of it, Henry nodded to his father before he took a step into the vibrant colorless Mundi of Power- before he delved into the Incursion of the Atlas of Existence!
And all others rose and began to follow.
As soon as Henry stepped through the portal leading to the Incursion of the Atlas of Existence.
The weavings of Existence warped before him as he found himself being thrown across countless wormholes- his journey only coming to an end when his body smashed into the waters of a vast sea!
HUUM!
The surroundings shook as he rose up to the surface, his feet stably anchored to the surface of the water as if it were a floor as he looked around.
A deep blue sea. On this sea, a small Island could be seen as on it, a man with the likeness of his father could be seen.
He looked primal and ancient as he was adorned in animal skin, his fair skin glinting with brilliance as his hair...was dazzling white!
His eyes...held simple black pupils filled with a shocking amount of will that seemed to hold coldness and utter majesty.
He looked like a stark contrast to Noah- a contrast that Henrh felt was off as he couldn't sense any of the love and carefreeness of his father!
Such a being stood atop the island at the center of this vast blue sea as he raised his hand in the next moment, a crimson gold blade landing on it as Henry squinted his eyes.
Was that...Ruination?
He only had time to ask this question.
Because in the next moment...
WAP!

This distant figure that was on the island far away appeared in front of him while swinging the sword across Henry's chest, a cold voice booming out at the same time as it carried deadly decisiveness!
"Prove your worth."
BOOM!

sentences.text: His words caused a sense of suffocation to spread out.
Only colorless authority flashed around their bodies in the golden sandy Domain, but even with all of its power and mystery, it seemed to carry hesitation.
The Devouring Worms that could nullify their Conceptual System of Existence had just now become one of the many issues plaguing them?
They all remained silent as Noah shifted his gaze between them.
A smile was on his face to portray his calmness still.
To still show them that things were okay, but even they could feel the tension held in his words.
Just what had he seen?
What did the memories of the Autarchs he had decimated show?

First, he affirmed that entering another Eonic Omniverse Record would very well lead to terrifying gazes pushed toward their direction after the destruction of Var-El, and he had to find a way to bypass this before he did it again!
This was only part of the intricate future that had risen as Noah sighed while turning to gaze up at the backdrop of sandy gold suns.
"Just...what exactly is coming?"
Amidst the silence, Sona wanted everything to be made clear as she asked.
With his hands behind his back, Noah opened his mouth to reply, and his words came out as if they were a grand prophecy.
"They will call themselves Protectors of Existence.
They will not simply discover this Omniverse, but will become heavily invested in it as after they find it, it will no longer just be an Omniverse existing in its own weavings of rules and ideas."
WAA!

"Once they do arrive, the Devouring Worms will be less of an issue as, truly, these beings do the job just like their Distinctions, as Protectors of Existence say, but I still told you all that you would need the Atlas in order to be capable of fighting against those of different Sources of Existence.
These coming Entities...many will have different Sources of Existence."
The Conceptual System of Existence was widespread as many would retain something like this.
But another majority held entirely different Systems of Existence as this posed a great issue!
Noah had seen glimpses of it.
As he stared out onto the blank openness, he continued.
"You may ask yourselves that even with all of this, what would make them enemies?
And the very clear answer is that these Existences- these Protectors have a singularity main task.
And that task is to ensure the purity of Sources of Existence.
To ensure that a single Source of Existence does not seek or is ever successful is incorporating another System of Existence- that everything remains how it was born."
His words were akin to a booming hammer that shook the Autarchs before him, his son stroking his chin as he replied grimly!
"So the Atlas of Existence is something they would seek to destroy if ever they find it."
The critical point was laid out as Noah brought his gaze down and nodded.
Silence resumed once more before the visage of Kazuhiko raised his head with determination and spoke with clenched fists.
"How much time do we have?"
Time.
Something that everybody seemed to be running out of as there could never be too much of it.

Noah thought about such a question while the manifestations of the Nine Mundis of Power lined up behind him- the only one that was filled with brilliance coming to anchor itself beside him and radiating a heavy light as he replied.
"Could be a day, could be a few days.
When they do come, things will get moving very quickly as we should be ready as best as we can."
It was a short period of time.

But Noah prepared them for what was to come as he beckoned towards the glowing portal to his right- intent on starting the process that would grant his people recognition to gain access to the Authority of the Laborer!
Henry was the first to rise and appear before Noah as between them, a prompt rose that everyone could see.
|The Incursion of the Atlas of Existence has opened.|

|Entrants who delve into the incursion and successfully prove the complexity of their Existence will be branded with the Atlas of Existence and granted the distinction of Wayfarer of the Atlas of Existence.|
They knew what was at stake.
They saw the indeterminate amount of time they held!
So without wasting any of it, Henry nodded to his father before he took a step into the vibrant colorless Mundi of Power- before he delved into the Incursion of the Atlas of Existence!
And all others rose and began to follow.
As soon as Henry stepped through the portal leading to the Incursion of the Atlas of Existence.
The weavings of Existence warped before him as he found himself being thrown across countless wormholes- his journey only coming to an end when his body smashed into the waters of a vast sea!
HUUM!
The surroundings shook as he rose up to the surface, his feet stably anchored to the surface of the water as if it were a floor as he looked around.
A deep blue sea.
On this sea, a small Island could be seen as on it, a man with the likeness of his father could be seen.
He looked primal and ancient as he was adorned in animal skin, his fair skin glinting with brilliance as his hair...was dazzling white!
His eyes...held simple black pupils filled with a shocking amount of will that seemed to hold coldness and utter majesty.
He looked like a stark contrast to Noah- a contrast that Henrh felt was off as he couldn't sense any of the love and carefreeness of his father!
Such a being stood atop the island at the center of this vast blue sea as he raised his hand in the next moment, a crimson gold blade landing on it as Henry squinted his eyes.
Was that...Ruination?
He only had time to ask this question.
Because in the next moment...
WAP!

This distant figure that was on the island far away appeared in front of him while swinging the sword across Henry's chest, a cold voice booming out at the same time as it carried deadly decisiveness!
"Prove your worth."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3171 Traverse into the Atlas! IV
paragraphs: The strike of the blade held undeniable coldness as Henry's gaze changed quickly, his body erupting with colorless and golden grandeur as a massive explosive split apart the blue waters for miles.
BOOM!
His figure was akin to a rag doll that was thrown back, smashing into the surface of the water multiple times before he gained his bearings.
And even as his head rose...
SAA!

The figure of the white haired Noah was already right before him as his left hand slithered out like a snake- shattering any remaining weavings of the Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen as he came to grasp the neck of Henry!

His right hand held the pulsing crimson gold blade as his pupils gazed coldly at the shocked figure of Henry that was amassing power to fight back- the sharp tip of the blade being directed forward as it went towards the chest of his son!
SQUELCH!
The blade pierced deeply into the chest of Henry as golden blood gushed out freely.

Henry's eyes were unfocused as he felt his very existence shaking with instability, his soul unable to call upon his Autarchical Authority freely as when he looked deep into the eyes of the man who had injured him so greatly...he could affirmatively say that it was not his father.
|Who...are you?|
Henry's intent barely got out as he felt his Existence vibrating.
And yet the man before him didn't even bat an eye as he replied succinctly.
"The accumulation of power and wisdom. The road that must be traversed if ever there is to be a future. I am...Atlas."
HUUM!
His left hand swung out and threw the visage of Henry as his body smashed into the blue sea, golden blood freely mixing with the water as from all around, a voice thundered out.
"Prove your existence."
It was a shocking scene.
What went inside of the Incursion of the Atlas of Existence was not a mental body or Clone, but Henry's genuine Autarchical Body!
And yet it was already racked with heavy injuries even as waves of colorless authority sought to heal him.
And he wasn't the only one.
In another Incursion.

The visage of Lilith smashed into an erupting mountain of Apollyon as a huge gash was open from her right shoulder across her chest, her face that of utter rage and humiliation as above her, a figure with Noah's likeness and white hair holding a spear gazed down coldly!
"Prove your Existence."
She heard this over and over again as this being utterly trashed her.
The pain and injuries to her Existence were very real as she roared out while chains of Hatred flourished by the millions around her!
"How?! How can I prove my Existence?!"
Lilith roared out her words as the chains that had erupted by the millions...the visage of Atlas only swung his spear down as they all faded into nothingness.
His gaze was piercing as he stared at Lilith, his reply cold.
"You cannot."
"You are weak, and will not survive the change to come."
WAA!
The words smashed into Lilith and caused grievous injuries worse than any before as her eyes became blinded by Hatred, roaring out as she shot towards the visage of Atlas!

This was what occurred within the Incursions of the Atlas of Existence as those close to the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor sought to gain recognition to utilize an authority not limited to a single Source of Existence.
Around this same time.
In the location where Sentinels of Lumen rose no more, the massive obsidian body of the Source Worm could be seen.
Its feelers were commanding the many Worms around it for different tasks when, in the next moment, it paused and gazed towards a certain direction.
There was nothing there, but as if this worm could sense something occurring far in the distance...
WUUU!
It let out a wail seemingly filled with anger as around it, the worms of Existence began to disappear into the foldings of Existence!
At this same time, within the Source of the Imperium.
Atop an endless gold sea, the gaze of a scholarly-looking Entity changed from calm to stern as he gazed in the same direction relative to what the Source Worm had roared out towards.
"Impossible...it is not yet time..."
It was not yet time.
Something that should have happened much later down the line was brought forward if his senses were not lying to him!
Why? What could cause such a drastic change?
"Even the invasion of the Worms of Existence shouldn't have triggered any mechanisms yet..."
It was baffling.
It was something that threw a wrench into many plans, and if this was truly the case, he had to prepare!
SHAA!
With a glimmer of brilliance, he disappeared from the endlessly vast golden sea.
Within the vast Omniverse.
In the direction that multiple gazes had just turned towards.
Surrounded by an absence of light, in the crevices where the weavings of very few Autarchical Omniversal Authorities reached.
WAP!
Space was ripped apart as a flash of crimson lightning revealed a radiant figure with a ragged expression appearing at such a place!

His features were unique as they were humanoid for the most part, but he held lustrous crimson gold fur with the features of a monkey present on his face- and a golden tail weaving around from his waist.
He cracked his neck while stretching, his eyes lighting up when he looked around him as he quickly pulled out a device from a necklace around his neck.
|Where are we?|
His voice was melodious and sweet- filled with interminable power that caused the surroundings to vibrate!
A blue light flashed as the device he held floated up and radiated a burst of cerulean radiance before moments later, a feminine voice echoed out from it.
|An Undocumented Omniverse outside of our System. Preliminary findings show complexity and structure similar to most prized Omniverses under the Commonwealth.|
Words that caused the eyes of the crimson gold furred Entity to open wide echoed out, excitement rising on this being's face as he instantly waved his hands to pull out a flag.
A flag burning with a crimson gold insignia of an intricately designed wheel.
A wheel that held within it countless dots of light!

chapters.title: Chapter 3172 Existential Colonization! I
paragraphs: A flag was pulled out by the glorious entity with the features of a humanoid monkey, this being thrusting the tip of this flag onto the dark space right away!
DU! DU! DU!
It pulsed three times before it became fully anchored in this space, the insignia of a wheel on this flag beginning to spin as a fantastical weaving of light began to unfurl in the distance.
At its base, a flat golden surface began to spread as from it, golden Pillars pointing above bloomed.
As this occurred, the blue device this being had taken out continued to vocalize with an autonomous voice.

|The Undocumented Omniverse boasts great integrity as it has been deemed to be a type of Conceptual Omniverse governed by specific rules. It is determined that Authorities scaling up to Tier 9 of Existence hold the make up of this Omniverse. Much of their weavings of Existence have not been spurred by any catalyst, nor have their Products of Existence been procured.|
Everything was being analyzed rapidly as the smile on the humanoid monkey Entity only became larger, his voice echoing out in kind.
|We have found another treasure trove for the Commonwealth. A link will be established soon enough...what about the inhabitants?|

He asked with shining eyes as the Pillars that had risen from the golden flat surface burst into golden flames that illuminated everything, with these flames beginning to hum and resonate as above them- the outline of a massive portal began to form!

|An Infection of Neonatal Worms of Existence has been detected, but it is presumed to be in its early stages. The System of Existence of the Inhabitants may hold some effectiveness against them as it is estimated that there are over a dozen Tier 9 Existences within this Undocumented Omniverse. Contact will soon be made-|
|No.|
Before the device could continue, the humanoid monkey entity denied its request as he voiced out.

|I will make contact with the natives myself. For the Infection...those critters are extremely perceptive against us, especially when they are still in the Neonatal Stage. Begin the procurement and deployment of the Synthetic Existence Legions.|
|Understood, Protectors Antonio.|
The process was fast.

Following the commands of Protector Antonio, a flourish of blue and golden brilliance bloomed above the flaming golden Pillars; the outline of a portal gradually became more distinct as from it, space began to fluctuate as a massive avoid vessel floated out!

Colored crimson and gold, this vessel bore the same insignia of an incandescent wheel, and it floated out of the portal with interminable glory as moments after, its center opened to show a flurry of Entities stepping out from it.
In the lead was another Entity adorned in gold robes and with the likeness of a humanoid monkey, this one boasting dazzling gold hair and a feminine charm as she smiled toward Protector Antonio.
|Protector Antonio, it seems our positions will soon shift after your finding.|
She gazed around her as she spoke, a blue device flowing out from her as well.
Behind her, dozens of Entities adorned in blue robes followed- their robes holding an ecriture of a hammer as they looked around with shining eyes while awaiting for orders!
Protector Antonio smiled while waving his hands dismissively.

|A finding is a finding, no matter how big or small- it is all for the benefit of the Commonwealth, Protector Nia. For now, establish a base of operations while I track down the strongest natives and ensure no hostility forms. I will bring them the good news and let them know they no longer need to fear the Worms of Existence. I shall start the spread of the glory of the Commonwealth and prepare them and this Omniverse of the glorious times ahead.|
The glorious times ahead.
Glory for some, may not be glory for others.
But change was coming nonetheless.
Whether it was good or bad- well, this was another point entirely!
HUUM!
With a flash of golden light, Protector Antonio's body split into multiple parts that shot out in different directions.
He left behind another Protector and a massive vessel as at this moment, Protector Nia gave out a command that made the Entities behind her with the ecriture of hammers to begin moving.
|Get started. We have to prepare many things...|
A simple command.
And soon after, the glow of structures and massive constructs began to bloom in the surroundings as the weavings of a whole new civilization began to form!
Across the Omniverse.
A line of crimson gold light crossed unfathomable distances in a short period of time.
It was none other than Protector Antonio as at this moment, he was going towards the signature of the strongest life form that happened to be closer to his point of entry.
It was through veils of weavings of concepts, and yet his body tore through them like nothing as the blue device on his hand beeped constantly.
Within moments, he broke through a veil of a high Tier Authority of Existence as he came to observe a nest filled with titanic life forms!
Their existence buzzed as they turned up towards him in shock, some of them having their bodies glimmering with golden or Multicolored radiance.

Protector Antonio ignored all of them while flashing deeper into this area, heading straight for the signature of the strongest life form here as past massive mountains of authority, there was a throne made of the bones of Authority of Existence.

On top of this throne, the figure of a lone man sitting on it could be made out as he raised his head calmly at this moment, watching the arrival of Protector Antonio whose device beeped with a set of words only for him to hear!
|The observed life force holds a unique identifier that may not be entirely in line with this Omniverse, but much of his existence has already been influenced to be part of this Omniverse.|
It was a quick assessment made about the entity before them as after a moment, Protector Antonio nodded while voicing out.
"Hello, Native of this Omniverse. I am Protector Antonio bringing you the weavings of glory of the Commonwealth. How may we call you?"
The monkey-like visage bathed in the golden brilliance of Protector Antonio smiled as he ignored the tendrils of colorless authority that had erupted since his entry.
He didn't even bat an eye towards the rising sense of suffocation of multiple Autarchical Authority!
He only smiled while looking ahead as the man on the throne had his eyes flash sharply while he replied.
|Uterra...The Eonic Uterra.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3173 Existential Colonization! II
paragraphs: A Protector met someone he referred to as a native even though he could see there was something else there.
But the time spent in this Omniverse was enough to consider them a native!
As his Distinction revealed itself, the Protector nodded while the device in his hand voiced out something only for him to hear once more.
|Confirmed the Physiology of Existence of this Eonic Uterra to be based on a singular System of Existence. He matches the criteria to be included as a Citizen of the Commonwealth.|
A singular System of Existence.
This matched the criteria for this being to be taken as a Citizen of the Commonwealth!
The monkey-like figure of Commander Antonio smiled as he waved his hands and caused the flourishing of a massive golden page of light behind him.
Above, it had the words written in pure white that stated- {Contract of Existence}!
|Before I can continue any further, I will need Prospective Citizen Eonic Uterra to infuse a portion of your Existence in this area here.|
Under dozens of points of stipulations, there was a blank area for one to brand their very existence under!
The Eonic Uterra, sitting on his throne, looked at this with a sneer.
His figure was stout and filled with power, his hair dark gray while glimmering with a powerful stellar light.
He looked like a king in every possible aspect, and he spoke out while lying forward on his throne.
|Should I not at least know what I am signing my name to? And why should I do anything like this?|

As he spoke, the area behind his throne pulsed with interminable brilliance as six massive Omniversal Pillagers radiating a colorless aura appeared, along with Legions of thousands of Teracosm and a few dozen Paracosm Omniversal Pillagers surrounding everything else nearby!
And yet Protector Antonio seemed unfettered by this as he only smiled while pointing to the golden page above him.

"Most of it is a few rulings, the major ones to keep in mind being not to harm Citizens of the Commonwealth and, of course, not to leave your Natal Omniverse unless given strict permission to do so. Everything else is small stuff. As for why you should sign..."
HUUM!
The surroundings shook as a unique aura erupted from the monkey-like visage of Protector Antonio.

And this eruption of an aura alone caused a disruption in the flow of Omniversal Authorities, followed by a golden burst of waves of light from the golden tail of Protector Antonio that smashed into Teracosm, Paracosm, and even the Six Autarchical Omniversal Pillagers behind the Eonic Uterra!
And without fail...
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Every single one had their consciousness disrupted as horrifically, they...fainted.
Fainted.
Entities towards the very peak of the Dominium Realm.
And yet...the weavings of their very Existence were knocked out as they lost their consciousness!
The Eonic Uterra had stern eyes as his whole body pulsed multiple times over, looking towards Protector Antonio in shock as the fur of this being merely waved with brilliance crimson gold brilliance.

"We are here as Protectors. This is the task of the Commonwealth- to protect and ensure the vast throngs of Existence continue on to a glorious future. I would hate for you to not be a part of it, Friend."
It was a deadly situation.
One that Protector Antonio was smiling at as he pointed to the blank area of the golden page once more.
"Please, sign here."
A glorious wave of change was truly coming.
And it was hard to say just who would survive this change and be ushered into the future!
Far, far away from the area where the Eonic Uterra was.
Within the bounds of Cappadocia.
On a lone blue mountain floating near a Plane of Existence.
A young man was looking at a circle of Teracosm Stage Imperium Martial Kings and three Paracosm Stage Imperium Martial Emperors cultivating.
Every time they advanced, the young man felt an advancement in his own power.

His eyes flashed with tendrils of blue lightning as the earth filled with blue stones below him vibrated, and the figure of a devilishly handsome man with pairs of colorless wings appeared beside him!
"It's been some time, Eckert."
Noah's voice was calm as he spoke to the Great Usurper while looking out into the vast openness.

Eckert smiled and whistled while looking at the visage of Noah that put a strain on his ridiculously vast Soul just to look at, but after acclimating on this strain, he was able to gaze at him fine as he nodded.
"Yes. I reached out to you because of what seemed like an impossible problem with Worms that devoured everything, but my soul is telling me there is now something even more disastrous."
He could feel it.
But while Eckert could only vaguely feel something, Noah had bountiful information about it as he nodded!

"I thought there would be more time. But I feel something has already arrived. What I can tell you about it...is to bide your time. We are currently outclassed and outmatched as what has arrived is a heavy ordeal, but through it..."
Noah's eyes shone brightly.
He knew it.
With every insurmountable danger came an equally grand, if not grander, opportunity.

"Through this ordeal, a springboard to propel ourselves upwards in an unfathomable way can be made. But for now, bide our time and learn. Bide our time and collect information. Because the Omniverse is about to undergo a great change."
Immense silence descended at Noah's words as Eckert sighed.
His blue eyes pulsed again and again as he stared in the same direction as Noah and shook his head.
"You know, a dream of mine is to leave this constant struggle of power and retire on a farm. And yet just when I think it's right there within my grasp...it once more seems like an impossibility."
His hand reached out to something only he could see as he continued.
"You know, in your Infinite-"
His words were stopped.
Eckert felt Noah's hands on his shoulders as he went silent right after.
His gaze became stern.
Moments later, a crimson gold light flashed in the far distant area as the outline of a monkey-like humanoid Entity appeared.
His golden tail weaved with interest and uniqueness as he looked at Eckert while raising his brows, and he then turned towards Noah with shining eyes as he uttered a single word.
"Interesting."
On this day.
A Protector of the Commonwealth arrived before the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor.
What this simple meeting would lead to...even the most abstruse existences could not imagine!

chapters.title: Chapter 3174 Existential Colonization! III
paragraphs: Crimson gold fur and a monkey-like disposition.
The figure almost reminded Noah of the Bard of Quintessence, but when he locked onto its eyes...any possible similarity faded away completely.
Within those eyes, he saw the brightness that hid great pride and self-worth, unlike anything he had seen before.
The beings that the Faesinged Queen was so fearful of.
The beings that were scorched out of their records as not much information was obtained about them even as Noah perused these records again and again.
"Hello, Natives of this Omniverse. I am Protector Antonio bringing you the weavings of glory of the Commonwealth. How may we call you?"
The words were said with a smile, but Noah could feel their rigidity as if they had been rehearsed and said too many times before!
The one introducing themselves as Protector Antonio was looking between Noah and Eckert as Noah took the lead to reply, with Eckert squinting his eyes and following right after.
"Emperor Osmont."
"The Great Usurper."
A beaming smile bloomed on Protector Antonio as he looked at the two of them, waving his hand up as a radiant blue scroll of light unfurled above him.

"Wow! Emperor Osmont and The Great Usurper. I bring you glorious tidings of the Commonwealth, where we commend you for your hard work in stopping the spread of the Infection of the Worms of Existence so far, and are here to let you know that you can rest easy. The Commonwealth will take care of things from here."

Noah blinked at this Entity before him as his first sentences after learning of their Distinctions... was akin to that of an adult listening to a child call themselves a name as they seemingly played along.
In his repeat of the words Emperor Osmont and The Great Usurper, no matter how beaming his smile was...they couldn't feel any ounce of respect or honor.

"Before I can continue any further, I will need Prospective Citizens Emperor Osmont and The Great Usurper to infuse a portion of your Existence in this area here. Protocol dictates for us to offer this rite of Citizenship to Autarchs, but I believe an exception can be made for The Great Usurper."
WAA!

The eyes of the Protector Antonio gazed from Eckert's figure to those of the Paracosm and Teracosm Stage Entities behind them- as if he saw something others could not see and made a determination due to it!
Noah and Eckert stared at Protector Antonio silently as their wills observed the massive page that read [Contract of Existence], along with the many points of stipulations on it.
While reading it, Noah voiced out calmly.
"Why should we sign such a thing?"
Seemingly, a point of contention arose.
And the eyes of Protector Antonio twisted into a sharp smile!
Before the eyes of Protector Antonio.
The device that had returned to his neck flashed with a powerful blue light as it continued to give out readings.

|Confirmed the Physiology of Existence of both Emperor Osmont and The Great Usurper to be based on a singular System of Existence. Both match the criteria to be included as a Citizen of the Commonwealth. Additional information regarding Emperor Osmont has been discovered.|

Protector Antonio's eyes flashed sharply as he followed a blue hue that broke down the figures in front of him to great detail- this light coming to focus on a small circular ornament around Emperor Osmont's waist!
|A Unique Mobile Plane of Existence with slight similarities to those of Omniverse X-108 has been discovered on Emperor Osmont, with auras of more prospective citizens veiled inside.|
A tremendous finding.

The moment such a thing was ascertained, Protector Antonio smiled while turning into a thundering flash of lightning that disappeared instantly- its vector towards the simple looking round ornament on Emperor Osmont as Protector Antonio entered before anything could be done!
Under the means of the Commonwealth, nothing could be hidden.
Any secrets that the natives of an Omniverse believed were theirs to keep would be unveiled in a short period of time!
Protector Antonio spread out his Will the moment he entered the Unique Mobile Plane of Existence as his eyes lit up.
He saw clusters of Cosmos and Universes stretched throughout, and at the very center of it all, there was one particular cosmos that held powerful auras at the Autarch Equivalent Stage!

Protector Antonio flashed towards this Cosmos as he drilled into its depths and arrived at a domain where he saw the shocked eyes of Emperor Osmont gazing at him on a round table- a table which held other Autarchs who seemed to have been called here for a meeting!
"You asked why you should sign such a thing as this Contract of Existence."

Protector Antonio spoke with a smile as multiple blue scrolls of light unfurled, his eyes landing on Henry, Sona, the Sanctus Autarch, Kazuhiko, Erikson, Piety, and Lilith before they came back to lock onto the shocked visage of Emperor Osmont.

"You should sign because the Commonwealth is here to share its knowledge and resources, but only for its Citizens that it can protect. If you aren't Citizens or do not fall under the banner of one, it is hard to guarantee your protection."
A clearly veiled threat.

One that caused the billowing visage of Erikson to rise up, but Emperor Osmont placed his right hand on his shoulder while he sent a small portion of his existence under the line on the contract that had to be signed!
On it, the brand of Emperor Osmont appeared.

Protector Antonio only smiled deeper as similar Contracts of Existence came to float directly in front of the eyes of other Autarchs here, all of them looking towards Emperor Osmont initially before they signed with gritted teeth!
The moment it was done, these contracts collapsed into singularities of light as the voice of Protector Antonio echoed out grandly.

"Not to worry. The only things a Citizen of the Commonwealth is obligated to do is remain in their Natal Omniverse unless given strict permission otherwise, and to occasionally go where the Commonwealth directs you to. But this may never come to affect you. Let me be the first to welcome you as the Glorious Citizens of the Commonwealth!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3175 Existential Colonization! IV
paragraphs: The arms of the Protector were spread out wide as he spoke with a smile!

"Let me be first to welcome you, and we will soon be in contact again as the Commonwealth sets up Bases to protect you all against any threats in the future. You will also have the privilege of enjoying the boons of the Commonwealth soon enough, so be on the lookout for more news, O Glorious Citizens!"
His golden tail weaved maddeningly.
His smile was deep as his audience remained stern.
His figure began to flicker with radiance as he rose upwards, his sharp eyes coming to gaze at Emperor Osmont as he spoke out his last words.
"You really do have a nice home here, Citizen Emperor Osmont. You should do your best to protect it."
With a thundering boom, he was gone right after.
As he left the small Mobile Plane of Existence, Protector Antonio spoke to the device on his neck.
"See if this Omniverse has any more Mobile Planes of Existence. They're nice trinkets to have for storage..."
|Understood, Protector Antonio.|
Brilliance flourished.
And with a glimmer of brightness, Protector Antonio was gone!
Back on the makeshift round table.
HUUM!

Around Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence, his brilliant Halo returned along with his colorless wings as he breathed out heavily- the interminable Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence burning around him as his plans and contingencies came to a great success!
|All traces of the Intruders are gone, Master. A Unique Tool of unknown ranking and origins aids the so-called Protector as its capabilities to analyze Existence are extremely high.|
The voice of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed echoed out as around him, the gazes of his people were filled with anger and solemness.
But Noah...had a profound expression on his face as he had achieved a major victory!
Sensing that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed would be something hard to conceal under the gazes of these beings, he left it out in plain sight.
But only in a way that he wanted to. He left it out in plain sight, but when the Protector discovered it, the only thing they were able to discern was that it was a Plane of Existence!
The grandiose Aletheian Havens...we're able to escape the gaze of these terrifying beings that he wasn't ready for.
"These are the enemies we're going to be dealing with for the foreseeable future."
His voice was calm as he spoke towards his Son and all others here.
His Existence was analyzing the results of how effective the Authority of the Laborer was in veiling the weavings of Existence as he continued.

"They are currently more advanced than us, and they hold much greater numbers as just that single Protector alone is not someone I can guarantee the death of at this time, much the hundreds, or thousands, or tens of thousands of others that may be just like him."
They had very little information as of right now.
They didn't know much about the behemoth that was the Commonwealth and what its forces entailed, but one thing was clear!
"They hold sway over Sources and Systems of Existence as one of their stipulations..."
Noah waved his hands.
He recreated the Contract of Existence that Protector Antonio had brought before them.
There was a class among many that stated.

|Attempts to study other Systems of Existence or to emulate them are expressly forbidden. Should anyone be discovered even attempting the adoption of other Systems of Existence apart from the one belonging to their Native Omniverse, they will be stripped of their Citizenship and judged in the Courts of Existence for Execution. The purity of separate Sources of Existence must be maintained to ensure the equilibrium and longevity of all Existence- this being one of the core missions of the Commonwealth.
A single stipulation among many.
But this stipulation showed the terrifying reality of something Noah was already breaking! Within his Atlas of Existence.
Within his First Mundi of Power, there were the weavings of three other Sources of Existence apart from his own Conceptual System of Existence!
But it wasn't discovered.
"Everything we do will be in secret as we learn more about these Entities entering our Omniverse. The vastness of their Commonwealth, their numbers, their power. We will learn, adapt, and in time..."
HUUM!
His eyes burned brightly.
He could see a grand future ahead even with the challenges that would come alongside it.

"For now, continue seeking recognition of the Atlas of Existence. Until you all gain access to the Authority of the Laborer, you cannot sufficiently veil yourselves and move about freely in front of these beings."
He spoke out simply, yet the gazes of all those here changed as if they could feel the injuries they had suffered before rising up again.
Erikson cleared his throat as he spoke out hesitantly.
"Is it...possible to tell your other self to go a bit easier on us?"
His other self.
The Atlas of Existence itself!
Noah smiled while shaking his head at this, his Will expanding and entering the dazzling Atlas of Existence within him.
His vision changed gradually as he found himself standing on top of an endless blue sea.
Above it, Nine glorious circles of light flashed as at the very center, a colorless singularity spun with unfathomable brilliance.
In the center of this singularity, a figure that looked just like him with white hair could be seen.
His eyes opened just as Noah arrived, rising from the center of the Atlas of Existence as by the time Noah took a single step, he was right before this manifestation!
A manifestation that kneeled before him an instant later.
"Master."
HUUM!
His Atlas.
His wonder.
It came out of his wildest designs as it was something under his control, but it didn't mean he understood everything about it.
It didn't mean he could predict all the surprises that would come from it in the future!
Just the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, what lay ahead was a wonderful waiting to unfold.
Noah looked deeply at himself- at his Atlas as he commanded out.
"Let's see what analysis can be made regarding this Protector Antonio and his Source of Existence."
With steady steps and a careful weaving of his Will, Noah continued to prepare for a future full of possibilities and perils.
As he looked into the entity known as Protector Antonio, grand changes were beginning to be enacted within the Omniverse starting at a small area!

The place where Protector Antonio had appeared minutes ago had been dark and void of anything, but at this moment.. titanic structures had already begun to be enacted as from the major ones...a flag adorned with an interminable Wheel made itself present!

The purity of separate Sources of Existence must be maintained to ensure the equilibrium and longevity of all Existence- this being one of the core missions of the Commonwealth.
A single stipulation among many.
But this stipulation showed the terrifying reality of something Noah was already breaking!
Within his Atlas of Existence.
Within his First Mundi of Power, there were the weavings of three other Sources of Existence apart from his own Conceptual System of Existence!
But it wasn't discovered.
"Everything we do will be in secret as we learn more about these Entities entering our Omniverse.
The vastness of their Commonwealth, their numbers, their power.
We will learn, adapt, and in time..."
HUUM!
His eyes burned brightly.
He could see a grand future ahead even with the challenges that would come alongside it.
"For now, continue seeking recognition of the Atlas of Existence.
Until you all gain access to the Authority of the Laborer, you cannot sufficiently veil yourselves and move about freely in front of these beings."
He spoke out simply, yet the gazes of all those here changed as if they could feel the injuries they had suffered before rising up again.
Erikson cleared his throat as he spoke out hesitantly.
"Is it...possible to tell your other self to go a bit easier on us?"
His other self.
The Atlas of Existence itself!
Noah smiled while shaking his head at this, his Will expanding and entering the dazzling Atlas of Existence within him.
His vision changed gradually as he found himself standing on top of an endless blue sea.
Above it, Nine glorious circles of light flashed as at the very center, a colorless singularity spun with unfathomable brilliance.
In the center of this singularity, a figure that looked just like him with white hair could be seen.
His eyes opened just as Noah arrived, rising from the center of the Atlas of Existence as by the time Noah took a single step, he was right before this manifestation!
A manifestation that kneeled before him an instant later.
"Master."
HUUM!
His Atlas.
His wonder.
It came out of his wildest designs as it was something under his control, but it didn't mean he understood everything about it.
It didn't mean he could predict all the surprises that would come from it in the future!
Just the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, what lay ahead was a wonderful waiting to unfold.
Noah looked deeply at himself- at his Atlas as he commanded out.
"Let's see what analysis can be made regarding this Protector Antonio and his Source of Existence."
With steady steps and a careful weaving of his Will, Noah continued to prepare for a future full of possibilities and perils.
As he looked into the entity known as Protector Antonio, grand changes were beginning to be enacted within the Omniverse starting at a small area!

The place where Protector Antonio had appeared minutes ago had been dark and void of anything, but at this moment.. titanic structures had already begun to be enacted as from the major ones...a flag adorned with an interminable Wheel made itself present!

chapters.title: Chapter 3176 Existential Colonization! V
paragraphs: There were many ways to colonize.
The most efficient start when it came to colonization...was to enact laws in the place one wanted to colonize and have the Locals and all those there follow these laws.
So the Contract of Existence was the first thing that Protector Antonio spread as dozens of stipulations of the Commonwealth lay within- and the most powerful natives would all be governed by it!
This was the first step.
To create a set of rules.
Thereafter, the invaders- the very entrants who made these rules...would be the ones to enforce them upon the locals throughout time!
After this step, a great deal of things could be done as the methods of the Commonwealth were terrifying ones.
From the titanic golden portal above, hundreds of Pillars burn with glorious flames.
Equally massive figures of three monstrous creatures that seemed to be most similar to whales passed through.

Below them, blue flames burned endlessly as the moment they passed- the massive bodies opened their jaws and released a cluster of humanoid figures before they began to miniaturize and change an instant later!

The massive whales transformed with a binding light into the figures of two men and a single woman- all three with burning blue flames on their heads and feet as they came to stand in front of the thousands of humanoid figures they had spat out of their jaws.

Uniquely, the thousands of humanoid figures all had the same face and body, entirely identical in all aspects as even the clothes they adorned were spotlessly white robes- a single ecriture of a golden wheel branded on their back.
These were...Synthetic Existences of the Commonwealth who held no emotions and only listened to orders.

In front of one of the Legions of Synthetic Existences, the woman with cerulean flames dancing on her head appeared and breathed out a sigh, pulling out a metal tablet that glowed a similar hue of blue on its screen as she didn't even bat an eye down below where the figure of a Protector could be seen.
"Our orders have been given. Three focal points have been determined for this Omniverse as I am assigned to...the focal point where the highest ranking Citizen is...Emperor Osmont?"

The woman shook her head while speaking as she didn't waste any time, tendrils of light vibrating with the heavy brilliance of a truly powerful Autarch wrapping around the Legion of Synthetic Existences as they all turned into a streak of blue light towards a certain direction.

She traversed across this newly Documented Omniverse that had yet to be given a proper distinction, but for three of them to be sent here and all the others that were to come...this was bound to be a massive finding.
Within a few minutes, she had traversed great distances while obtaining some measurements as she quickly arrived before a massive Existential Domain.

After confirming she was where the coordinates stated, she sent her terrifying will into this Domain of Existence and located the ones who should be in the lead here, her figure disappearing again as by the time she and her Legion of Synthetic Existences reappeared, two enigmatic men were standing at an area of vibrant blue light!
The gorgeous woman with blue flames burning on her head gazed between the tablet and the visage of Entities ahead of her as if to confirm, eventually nodding as she spoke out.
"You must be Citizens Emperor Osmont and The Great Usurper. I am here to aid in the smooth transition from the lands you once knew to those under the protection of the Commonwealth."
"Oh?"
Simple words.
Ones that caused the brows of Noah to rise as he asked calmly.
"And who might you be?"
A new entrant after Protector Antonio.
But this one seemed distinctly different as when she spoke about the Commonwealth, Noah couldn't sense the same entitlement and pride in her words.

Yet her aura blazed with far more than the blue flames they could see, her entire physiology and Source of Existence drawing Noah's eyes as she was more powerful than the Sunwinged Leprachanus, Faesinged Queen, and Satyrus Nymph combined!
But towards his question, this being simply shook her head.

"I'm nobody, just here to do my job. We can get it done relatively quickly without all of these questions. I'll even do you a favor. This place, this Domain of Existence...what do you call it now? I can have its name remain the same after the Existential Terraforming."
Existential Terraforming.
These words instantly caused Noah's and Eckert's eyes to flash with a sharp light as Eckert replied calmly.
"Cappadocia."
"Alright, this region will retain the name Cappadocia after the Existential Terraforming."
The woman blazing with blue flames nodded as behind her, the identical Synthetic Existences moved with a beckoning of her hand as they began to spread out towards different corners of Cappadocia.

A silence hung in the air as this woman could see the hardened gazes of Noah and Eckert, and she gazed back and forth between them as if she were hesitating, and she eventually sighed as she floated forward- coming only a few meters away from them!
Her terrifying aura became even more prominent at this time as it was maddening for Eckert who had yet to subjugate an Autarchical Existence.
Within burning blue flames all around her, she spoke with her eyes focused on Noah.

"I always play a guessing game on what stage you all might be on right now. It's never acceptance. A lot of the time, it's denial. You don't believe nor accept what is occurring. And you're likely making many plans on how you can fight against the Commonwealth. Let me save you a lot of hard work and heartache and tell you early...just accept it."
Her words were straight.
Almost as if she wanted to help them, and she was going out of her way just to tell them this!

"Many others have been in the same positions as you. Emperors. Kings. Rulers. Some had the entire Omniverse under their grasp. But after the Commonwealth claimed their Omniverses...none of those titles mattered. There was only the Commonwealth after that."

chapters.title: Chapter 3177 Existential Colonization! VI
paragraphs: There was only the Commonwealth.
Even if you reigned at the very top of your Omniverse before all of this, it didn't matter now!
Her words were meant to help as at this moment, Noah smiled while asking probingly.
"Is that what they did to you, Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales?"
BOOM!

A typhoon of blue flames instantly seethed as Noah brought his figure forward, standing in front of Eckert as the flames passed by his Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen and caused it to flicker with brightness as the woman before him became stern!
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales.
This was the identity Noah had managed to discern with the elevated capabilities as the Weaver of Existence!
"Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales...Irene, is it? Is this the same thing they did to your Omniverse? Does your title no longer matter?"
He felt a gap with the entrant of this new being here as he poked at it.
The Protectors were too powerful and reserved as not much could be gained by them currently.
But more information and weavings of the Commonwealth could be obtained if it was from beings like the one before him who seemed to only be working under a certain directive from the Commonwealth!
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales, Irene, gazed at Noah coldly as she shook her head.

"Emperor Osmont...as soon as I saw that title of Emperor in your distinction, I knew you were going to be trouble. You have an eye for quickly analyzing Existence, good for you. But I only see you bringing yourself and your people waves of trouble if you continue acting like this."
As she spoke, she moved back while tapping on the tablet in her hands.
From different ends of Cappadocia, the Synthetic Existences seemed to have been stationed as at this moment, dazzling blue light began to flourish from different directions.
"As of right now, I will carry out my mission of raising one of the core areas of the Factions of this Omniverse under the light of the Commonwealth."
HUUM!
The moment her words finished, she pressed a few buttons on her glowing tablet.

And instantly, waves of cerulean light burst from different directions where the Synthetic Existences were- thin blue lines shooting out and converging towards the figure of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales, Irene!
Noah and Eckert observed silently, and an instant later, they began to observe a wondrous scene.
All around them were wisps of weavings of Omniversal Authorities.
Those more powerful, like Noah, could even sense the heavy but silent Autarchical Omniversal Authorities and the extension of their influence on everything.
At this moment, amidst the spread of dazzling waves of blue light, the makeup of these Omniversal Authorities began to fluctuate.

If a few million Existential Extremity Authorities were moving in a complex manner to make up an Omniversal Authority, something got on between their weavings as these few million Existential Extremity Authorities...multiplied.
BOOM!
The density of Existential Extremity Authorities in the surroundings instantly began to shoot up.
Space distorted and began to permanently expand!
Cappadocia...trembled before moments later, it began to undergo a process of expansion and enlargement as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
"Existential Terraforming."
Surrounded by blinding waves of blue light, Irene spoke out calmly.
"A Process of artificially expanding and increasing the breadth of Domains of Existence, and by extension- the Omniverse itself."
"Starting now is just the first phase that will greatly alter this entire Omniverse."
Reality stretched out.
The countless lines moving together to form weavings of Omniversal Authorities multiplied again and again as an eruption of multicolored brilliance spread out!

And the figure of The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales, Irene, lifted her hand up and released a gorgeous blue singularity that anchored itself in this expanding space- a singularity that pulled in all of the blue waves that were catalyzing the ongoing reaction as it soon began to sprout into a massive tree!
A tree whose trunk burst out of Cappadocia, its roots drinking the glow of the artificially expanded Omniversal Authorities and continuing its growth.

The roots curved around the massive Domain of Existence as if it were a globe, its roots wrapping around it for innumerable light years as if a truly powerful being were to be looking from a far, far distance, they would see the blooming of a gorgeous ancient cerulean tree- and its roots were bulbous and wrapping around a vast globe that was a Domain of Existence!
And this sprouting tree was growing larger and larger, affecting everything around it as it continued to expand- growing bigger than any Existential Domain.
And with every expansion...
DUM!
It pulsed like a beating heart.
DUM!
And with every pulse...invisible strings of light were spread out for uncountable light years.
Strings.

Strings that formed into waves that disrupted the weavings of any Omniversal Authorities they came across- doing something to catalyze a process that caused the breadth of the Existential Extremity Authorities all around to multiply, expand, and enlarge!
It was a shocking process as Noah's powerful will had spread out of his body within the changing Cappadocia and captured every ounce of change occurring all around based on what Irene had initiated.
Noah had found the first thing he had to fully study and replicate with the advent of the Protectors and forces of this unfathomable Commonwealth.
Something that could expand and accelerate the Source of Domains of Existence themselves.
And in extension...the Omniverse itself!
If he could obtain these means and apply them to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself...
"This whole Omniverse is about to change in its entirety."
Back in the changing Cappadocia.
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales continued to speak from beside the trunk of the massive cerulean Tree whose waves were spreading out in the surroundings.

"Inclusion into the Commonwealth means an influx population of Entities as powerful as you all will appear- and as the phases of the Existential Terraforming occur, the Purity of Existence of this Omniverse will be determined, and its Nectar of Existence...what should have been forming the simple Fruits of Existence for you all...will start to be harvested. Be careful in the times to come, and start thinking of how you can simply fall in line."

chapters.title: Chapter 3178 Existential Terraforming! I
paragraphs: The scene could be frozen and encapsulated in time as a moment of paramount change.

Noah looked at the figure of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales after she had initiated the first phase of Existential Terraforming- something which would irreversibly alter their current Omniverse.
He looked at her while he continued to send out his will- wrapped in tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer to study exactly how this change was catalyzed.
His voice echoed out after her words telling him to start thinking how he should fall in line.
"You talking to us like this...does it come from experience? Did you once fight for your Omniverse? Your people?"
The words could be akin to a blade in the heart of someone else, but the blue flames around The Empress of the Orcanium Whales were still as she looked up at the expanding tree.
"I did fight. I devised and made up plans. I ushered in an uprising with all of my people...only for half of them to be erased with a single tap of a finger."
WAA!

"Amidst such devastation and power, I finally realized something that may take you a long time to realize- maybe until you face painful losses yourself. Do you know how those in power, more often than not, believe they have that power because it is their right? That they were chosen for a great purpose? That even though there are trillions and quintillions all around them, they are somehow the center of all records? The belief that everything moves, rotates, and reacts around them..do you know something about that?"
She brought her head down to look at Noah as she didn't like his ever-present smile.
As if he knew everything.
As if he could overcome everything.
He didn't know anything!
So she asked.
And Noah couldn't help but smile because this being was describing what he had adorned on himself as a distinction!
The Protagonist!
So he nodded towards her while around them, Cappadocia had already expanded to be three times the size it used to be.
"I know something about that."
As the one with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist, he knew it too well!
And the Empress of the Orcanium Whales nodded as she continued.

"Even if such a thing held a hint of truth before, it is about to lose all of its value. There is no single central figure that reality revolves around with the Commonwealth. There is no one being that is somehow destined for glory- someone who can do whatever they want and overcome any challenges ahead of them. There is only the vast Commonwealth and its rules. The sooner many natives of discovered Omniverses accept this, the less pain there will be."
Her words danced in the space around her with the ever-expanding waves of Existence as she made one thing clear.
There was no Protagonist.
There was no main character.
There was only the Commonwealth!
These words resounded in the surroundings as in the distance, Eckert looked on calmly as he seemed to be doing something silently with his robust Dominium Soul.
And Noah smiled while nodding to the visage of the Empress bathed in flames as he spoke out.
"Alright, you have convinced me! There is only the Commonwealth!"
"Now, as Citizens of the Commonwealth, we can be friends, right? I would love to ask my new friend here about what she's doing exactly."
Bathed in flames, the Empress squinted her eyes and paused.
The mannerism of Emperor Osmont.
His words.
His carefree smile.
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales smacked her lips as she knew didn't convince him of anything.
She shook her head and instead focused on the massive expanding tree beside her as his voice echoed out while coming close to it.

"The Existential Terraforming...is this something unique to your Omniverse that the Commonwealth has you oversee? What exactly are you utilizing to catalyze the weavings of existence themselves to multiply and expand many times over?"
The question sought the heart of the process of Existential Terraforming.
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales blinked as she gazed at Noah's interested figure. Frankly, even if she told him anything, he wouldn't be able to use the knowledge for himself in any way.

His only Omniverse was now under the banner of the Commonwealth as he wouldn't even be able to leave it without their permission, and even if he had the knowledge...what it required to be done was something she had designed over eons.
She didn't see a harm in speaking about her work- the work that the Commonwealth utilized and allowed her to gain her position right now to freely traverse across different Omniverses!
So she sighed as she explained.

"The Synthetic Existences I've sent out to multiple different parts are the key, and the Nucleus I threw out is another. For Existential Terraforming...it was a base concept from my Omniverse when we were trying to save the seas from endless corruption. We sought to expand and enhance the existence of other parts of the Omniverse- to rapidly expand its breadth and reveal just how pure and glorious it could be."

"After eons, my search bore fruits as I discovered the method to affect the Weavings of Existence and start them on an irreversible path. If done wrong, it could effectively destroy the whole Omniverse. If done right...these are the results."
She pointed towards the expanding Cappadocia and the waves of tumultuous Existential Extremity Authorities that were only gaining more and more to their complex weavings.
Noah nodded with bright eyes as he beckoned for her to get to the good parts.
Her blue eyes burning with flames seemed to be remembering her glorious times as she spoke freely.

"The process of constant initiation of Existential Nuclear Fission and Fusion. Entities like you and I cannot do it as I finally figured out that the constant calculations and permutations needed to catalyze the very weavings of Existence...required a consciousness devoid of any emotions or attachments to the Weavings of Existence. The answer was Synthetic Existences."

sentences.text: The scene could be frozen and encapsulated in time as a moment of paramount change.

Noah looked at the figure of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales after she had initiated the first phase of Existential Terraforming- something which would irreversibly alter their current Omniverse.
He looked at her while he continued to send out his will- wrapped in tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer to study exactly how this change was catalyzed.
His voice echoed out after her words telling him to start thinking how he should fall in line.
"You talking to us like this...does it come from experience?
Did you once fight for your Omniverse?
Your people?"
The words could be akin to a blade in the heart of someone else, but the blue flames around The Empress of the Orcanium Whales were still as she looked up at the expanding tree.
"I did fight.
I devised and made up plans.
I ushered in an uprising with all of my people...only for half of them to be erased with a single tap of a finger."
WAA!
"Amidst such devastation and power, I finally realized something that may take you a long time to realize- maybe until you face painful losses yourself.
Do you know how those in power, more often than not, believe they have that power because it is their right?
That they were chosen for a great purpose?
That even though there are trillions and quintillions all around them, they are somehow the center of all records?
The belief that everything moves, rotates, and reacts around them..do you know something about that?"
She brought her head down to look at Noah as she didn't like his ever-present smile.
As if he knew everything.
As if he could overcome everything.
He didn't know anything!
So she asked.
And Noah couldn't help but smile because this being was describing what he had adorned on himself as a distinction!
The Protagonist!
So he nodded towards her while around them, Cappadocia had already expanded to be three times the size it used to be.
"I know something about that."
As the one with the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist, he knew it too well!
And the Empress of the Orcanium Whales nodded as she continued.
"Even if such a thing held a hint of truth before, it is about to lose all of its value.
There is no single central figure that reality revolves around with the Commonwealth.
There is no one being that is somehow destined for glory- someone who can do whatever they want and overcome any challenges ahead of them.
There is only the vast Commonwealth and its rules.
The sooner many natives of discovered Omniverses accept this, the less pain there will be."
Her words danced in the space around her with the ever-expanding waves of Existence as she made one thing clear.
There was no Protagonist.
There was no main character.
There was only the Commonwealth!
These words resounded in the surroundings as in the distance, Eckert looked on calmly as he seemed to be doing something silently with his robust Dominium Soul.
And Noah smiled while nodding to the visage of the Empress bathed in flames as he spoke out.
"Alright, you have convinced me!
There is only the Commonwealth!"
"Now, as Citizens of the Commonwealth, we can be friends, right?
I would love to ask my new friend here about what she's doing exactly."
Bathed in flames, the Empress squinted her eyes and paused.
The mannerism of Emperor Osmont.
His words.
His carefree smile.
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales smacked her lips as she knew didn't convince him of anything.
She shook her head and instead focused on the massive expanding tree beside her as his voice echoed out while coming close to it.
"The Existential Terraforming...is this something unique to your Omniverse that the Commonwealth has you oversee?
What exactly are you utilizing to catalyze the weavings of existence themselves to multiply and expand many times over?"
The question sought the heart of the process of Existential Terraforming.
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales blinked as she gazed at Noah's interested figure.
Frankly, even if she told him anything, he wouldn't be able to use the knowledge for himself in any way.

His only Omniverse was now under the banner of the Commonwealth as he wouldn't even be able to leave it without their permission, and even if he had the knowledge...what it required to be done was something she had designed over eons.
She didn't see a harm in speaking about her work- the work that the Commonwealth utilized and allowed her to gain her position right now to freely traverse across different Omniverses!
So she sighed as she explained.
"The Synthetic Existences I've sent out to multiple different parts are the key, and the Nucleus I threw out is another.
For Existential Terraforming...it was a base concept from my Omniverse when we were trying to save the seas from endless corruption.
We sought to expand and enhance the existence of other parts of the Omniverse- to rapidly expand its breadth and reveal just how pure and glorious it could be."
"After eons, my search bore fruits as I discovered the method to affect the Weavings of Existence and start them on an irreversible path.
If done wrong, it could effectively destroy the whole Omniverse.
If done right...these are the results."
She pointed towards the expanding Cappadocia and the waves of tumultuous Existential Extremity Authorities that were only gaining more and more to their complex weavings.
Noah nodded with bright eyes as he beckoned for her to get to the good parts.
Her blue eyes burning with flames seemed to be remembering her glorious times as she spoke freely.
"The process of constant initiation of Existential Nuclear Fission and Fusion.

Entities like you and I cannot do it as I finally figured out that the constant calculations and permutations needed to catalyze the very weavings of Existence...required a consciousness devoid of any emotions or attachments to the Weavings of Existence.
The answer was Synthetic Existences."

chapters.title: Chapter 3179 Existential Terraforming! II
paragraphs: Synthetic Existences!
This was the answer that the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales arrived at for the process of expanding and increasing the breadth of Existence itself!

"Since the process itself can go very wrong and destroy Existence quickly, the factor of emotion or the factor of attachment can never truly be erased in its entirety as this always brought discrepancies during the process of Existential Nuclear Fission and Fusion. Discrepancies led to issues. But with Synthetic Existences...Existential Terraforming became a reality."

The words of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales caused Noah's will that was already observing everything in this region to focus on the identical Synthetic Existences that looked like anchors.

From them, string-like vibrations could be seen lashing out to their surroundings as when they came in contact with the complex weavings of existence that were akin to countless threads...they brought two threads together as if they were undergoing Fusion.
Fusion.
When two particles collide and join together to form an even heavier and more pristine particle- a large amount of energy being released in the process!
It was the same process taken by countless stellar systems with suns that power up entire systems with their constant process of Fusion.
The Synthetic Existences catalyzed the process of Nuclear Fusion as when two weavings of Existence were joining, large amounts of Existential Extremity Authority were produced.
But the moment this Fusion was about to complete, another string-like vibration would come out from the Synthetic Existences and cause the two fusing strings to split apart.

But when they split apart, the dense amount of authority produced during the prior Fusion was pulled in from the surroundings, and instead of the joining strings splitting back into two...they split into four strings of Existence!
Four weavings of Existence.
Fission.
A process of splitting a single, denser particle into two lighter ones.
This process was used in conjunction with Fusion, and manipulated in a way that it yielded four split particles from a single one!
In totality, there was an overall increase in the weavings of existence.

"These Synthetic Existences that the Commonwealth helped me design are able to manipulate these dangerous processes to increase the concentration and breadth of Existence itself- this process applicable to Domains of Existence with a 99% success rate on any relatively stable Omniverse with a strict set of rules. Omniverses like yours...are perfect candidates for this."

"The Nucleus I released, which allowed for the Emergence of the Tree of Existence, is merely an Existence Modulator of the Commonwealth that further enhances this process by providing more energy- more Authority to ensure that no discrepancy occurs and causes a chain reaction that turns all weavings of Existence unstable."
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales spoke as towards all of this...
"Is that so?"
Noah's eyes were shining brightly.
So bright that it radiated a blinding light that even the Empress squinted at, her gaze coming to lock on him as she harrumphed while speaking out.

"Don't look at this and get any wild ideas. It was found viable with a high success rate for Domains of Existence and Omniverses overall, but had a 0% success rate when trying to do the same thing to the weavings of an Entity's Existence. The Stability of their Existence is nowhere close to that of an Omniverse. Don't go and explode yourself based on something you heard from me without a full understanding."
Her words were meant to be a kind warning as Noah nodded lightly.
"Of course..."
His body was nodding here, but on the circular ornament by his waist.
Within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...
Another one of his bodies appeared in a space locked away across the weavings of space and time.
In a place where a multicolored throne sat amidst storms of interconnected Existential Extremity Authorities.
Noah appeared near the throne connected to all the weavings of the Aletheian Havens and rules that made the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as he spoke out.
"How is it? If the process of Existential Terraforming was applied to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed?"
The first possible boon from the intrusion, nay, the invasion of the so called Commonwealth.

Countless calculations had already been made the moment this was mentioned as behind Noah, a humanoid manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed arose from the dense multicolored streams of light surging towards the throne, her monotone voice echoing out.

|The predictability and accuracy of this process are viable for the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, with the job that Synthetic Existences are carrying out being something I can personally do across all of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed. But as I study the initial process of Fusion and the subsequent process of Fission- the newly split apart strings of Existence are more in number, yes, but they still hold minute differences.|
Noah listened silently for the discrepancies even he had begun to uncover.

|The newly added weavings of existence are 50% less stable, and if an entire Omniverse undergoes this process...while it will explode in efficiency and power, it will be like a flame that has been caused to burn brighter momentarily before some time later, this flame is extinguished.|
A heavy assertion of reality was made.

|This is why they utilize the so called Existential Modulator that makes way to the Tree of Existence. This provides a unique influx of authority to stabilize the weaker products of the process of Fission. They will have to continue providing more and more Existential Modulators in the future if they want to maintain the explosive rate of expansion and acceleration of Existence as they harvest the Nectar of Existence within this Omniverse. If this influx of energy is not there, the instabilities of this whole process will unveil themselves. By that time, the expanded breadth of Existence will no longer be sustainable and stable by itself, and then...|
Boom. The end.
This was the analysis that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed made towards the methods of the Commonwealth!
After they conducted the Process of Terraforming, the Omniverse itself would be dependent on the Commonwealth for its sustainability and future Existence.
|Of course, were we to proceed with the Existential Terraforming of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, something that could provide a source of energy to ensure stability endlessly...|
The Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed did finish.
It didn't need to finish!
Noah smiled as he took a seat on the throne connected to all Authorities within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, his words light as he gave the go-ahead.
"Let's get started."
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had been a Seed for what seemed like too long.
As new entrants came and powerful invaders appeared, it was time for this Seed to sprout.
The Question of an Existential Modulator that could provide an endless source of Energy...did this even need to be posed to the man possessing Infinite Mana?!
